title: Yesterday Was Busy
story_description: 兩位同學在聊昨天做了什麼。馬克昨天非常忙，做了很多事情。
story_intro: 今天是星期一。
馬克和大衛在學校見面。
大衛問馬克昨天過得怎麼樣。
馬克告訴大衛他昨天做了很多事情。
他們練習使用過去的時間表達。

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 馬克，早安！你昨天過得怎麼樣？
dialogue.py: mǎ kè, zǎo ān! nǐ zuó tiān guò de zěn me yàng?
dialogue.en: Mark, morning! How was your yesterday?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 早安，大衛。我昨天真的非常忙。
dialogue.py: zǎo ān, dà wèi. wǒ zuó tiān zhēn de fēi cháng máng.
dialogue.en: Morning, David. I was really very busy yesterday.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 是嗎？你昨天都做了些什麼？
dialogue.py: shì ma? nǐ zuó tiān dōu zuò le xiē shén me?
dialogue.en: Really? What did you do all day yesterday?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我早上七點就起床了，先去公園跑了一個小時步。
dialogue.py: wǒ zǎo shang qī diǎn jiù qǐ chuáng le, xiān qù gōng yuán pǎo le yī gè xiǎo shí bù.
dialogue.en: I got up at 7:00, and first went to the park for an hour run.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 那麼早！運動以後呢？
dialogue.py: nà me zǎo! yùn dòng yǐ hòu ne?
dialogue.en: So early! What about after exercising?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 運動以後，我回家吃了早飯，然後去圖書館寫功課。
dialogue.py: yùn dòng yǐ hòu, wǒ huí jiā chī le zǎo fàn, rán hòu qù tú shū guǎn xiě gōng kè.
dialogue.en: After exercising, I went home and ate breakfast, then went to the library to do homework.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 你在圖書館待了多久？
dialogue.py: nǐ zài tú shū guǎn dāi le duō jiǔ?
dialogue.en: How long did you stay at the library?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我從上午十點一直待到下午三點。
dialogue.py: wǒ cóng shàng wǔ shí diǎn yī zhí dāi dào xià wǔ sān diǎn.
dialogue.en: I stayed from 10:00 AM all the way until 3:00 PM.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 哇，那在那裡待了五個小時啊！
dialogue.py: wa, nà zài nà lǐ dāi le wǔ gè xiǎo shí a!
dialogue.en: Wow, you stayed there for five hours!

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 對，功課很多。後來，我還去超市買了一些生活用品。
dialogue.py: duì, gōng kè hěn duō. hòu lái, wǒ hái qù chāo shì mǎi le yī xiē shēng huó yòng pǐn.
dialogue.en: Yes, lots of homework. Later, I also went to the supermarket to buy some daily necessities.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 晚上呢？你休息了嗎？
dialogue.py: wǎn shang ne? nǐ xiū xi le ma?
dialogue.en: What about the evening? Did you rest?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 晚上我和朋友一起吃了晚飯，然後看了一部電影。
dialogue.py: wǎn shang wǒ hé péng you yī qǐ chī le wǎn fàn, rán hòu kàn le yī bù diàn yǐng.
dialogue.en: In the evening I ate dinner with a friend, then watched a movie.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 難怪你今天看起來有點兒累。
dialogue.py: nán guài nǐ jīn tiān kàn qǐ lái yǒu diǎn r lèi.
dialogue.en: No wonder you look a bit tired today.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 是啊，我昨晚十一點半才睡覺。你呢？你昨天做了什麼？
dialogue.py: shì a, wǒ zuó wǎn shí yī diǎn bàn cái shuì jiào. nǐ ne? nǐ zuó tiān zuò le shén me?
dialogue.en: Yeah, I didn't sleep until 11:30 last night. How about you? What did you do?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 我昨天在家休息了一整天，哪兒也沒去。
dialogue.py: wǒ zuó tiān zài jiā xiū xi le yī zhěng tiān, nǎ r yě méi qù.
dialogue.en: I rested at home all day yesterday and didn't go anywhere.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 真羨慕你！我也想好好休息一下。
dialogue.py: zhēn xiàn mù nǐ! wǒ yě xiǎng hǎo hǎo xiū xi yī xià.
dialogue.en: I envy you! I want to have a good rest too.

key_sentences.zh: 我從上午十點一直待到下午三點。
key_sentences.en: I stayed from 10 AM until 3 PM.
No wonder you look tired today.

speaking.part_b: Role-play: 問你的朋友昨天做了什麼。他告訴你他去爬山了，你表示羨慕並問他待了多久。
part_c: 你昨天忙不忙？
你昨天幾點睡覺？

comprehension.q: 馬克昨天早上幾點起床？
馬克在圖書館待了幾個小時？
馬克去超市買了什麼？
大衛昨天做了什麼？
馬克為什麼今天看起來累？
options: B. 因為他昨晚十一點半才睡

true_false.q: 馬克昨天過得很輕鬆。
馬克運動後吃了早飯。
大衛昨天也去圖書館了。
馬克晚上看了一部電影。
大衛覺得馬克的生活很令人羨慕。

passage.title: Yesterday Was Busy Listening Passage
passage.zh: 今天是星期一。馬克和大衛在學校見面。大衛問馬克昨天過得怎麼樣。馬克告訴大衛他昨天做了很多事情。他們練習使用過去的時間表達。
passage.en: Mark, morning! How was your yesterday? Morning, David. I was really very busy yesterday. Really? What did you do all day yesterday? I got up at 7:00, and first went to the park for an hour run. So early! What about after exercising? After exercising, I went home and ate breakfast, then went to the library to do homework.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: 請寫 3 到 5 句話描述你昨天的生活。包含你幾點起床、做了哪些重要的事情，以及你的感覺。

grammar.explanation: 使用 '了' 表示動作完成。時間長度放在動詞後面。'才' 用於強調動作發生得晚或費時。
examples: 我跑了一個小時步。 (I ran for an hour.)
我看了一部電影。 (I watched a movie.)
他十點才來。 (He didn't come until 10.)
待了多久？ (How long did you stay?)

practice.q: Translate: I studied for two hours.
Complete: 他三點___到。 (He didn't arrive until 3:00.)
Translate: I watched a good book.
Complete: 我在家___了一天。 (I stayed home for a day.)
Translate: No wonder he is happy.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 你昨天去哪兒玩了？
expansion_dialogue.py: nǐ zuó tiān qù nǎ r wán le?
expansion_dialogue.en: Where did you go to play yesterday?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 我和家人去郊外野餐了。
expansion_dialogue.py: wǒ hé jiā rén qù jiāo wài yě cān le.
expansion_dialogue.en: I went to the outskirts for a picnic with my family.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 天氣好嗎？
expansion_dialogue.py: tiān qì hǎo ma?
expansion_dialogue.en: Was the weather good?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 非常好，所以玩得很開心。
expansion_dialogue.py: fēi cháng hǎo, suǒ yǐ wán de hěn kāi xīn.
expansion_dialogue.en: Extremely good, so we had a very happy time.

review.speaking: Describe 3 things you did yesterday in Chinese.
review.writing: Write a short diary entry for yesterday.
review.self_check: 你能用 '了' 和 '才' 描述昨天的活動嗎？

title: My Last Weekend
story_description: 馬克向朋友描述他上週末的旅行。他去了海邊，經歷了有趣的事情。
story_intro: 上週末馬克去旅行了。
他剛回到學校。
他告訴朋友大衛他的旅行經歷。
他談到了天氣、活動和食物。
他們練習使用順序詞：先、然後、最後。

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 馬克，歡迎回來！聽說你上週末去海邊了？
dialogue.py: mǎ kè, huān yíng huí lái! tīng shuō nǐ shàng zhōu mò qù hǎi biān le?
dialogue.en: Mark, welcome back! I heard you went to the seaside last weekend?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 對，我和幾個朋友去了墾丁。那裡真的太美了！
dialogue.py: duì, wǒ hé jǐ gè péng you qù le kěn dīng. nà lǐ zhēn de tài měi le!
dialogue.en: Yes, a few friends and I went to Kenting. It was really so beautiful there!

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 墾丁？那很遠吧。你們在那裡做了什麼？
dialogue.py: kěn dīng? nà hěn yuǎn ba. nǐ men zài nà lǐ zuò le shén me?
dialogue.en: Kenting? That's quite far. What did you do there?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我們先在海灘上曬太陽，然後去潛水看魚。
dialogue.py: wǒ men xiān zài hǎi tān shàng shài tài yáng, rán hòu qù qián shuǐ kàn yú.
dialogue.en: We first sunbathed on the beach, then went diving to see the fish.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 潛水？好玩嗎？我一直想試試。
dialogue.py: qián shuǐ? hǎo wán ma? wǒ yī zhí xiǎng shì shi.
dialogue.en: Diving? Was it fun? I've always wanted to try.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 非常好玩！水很清澈，能看見很多五顏六色的魚。
dialogue.py: fēi cháng hǎo wán! shuǐ hěn qīng chè, néng kàn jiàn hěn duō wǔ yán liù sè de yú.
dialogue.en: Extremely fun! The water was very clear, and we could see many colorful fish.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 太棒了。你們晚餐吃了什麼？海鮮嗎？
dialogue.py: tài bàng le. nǐ men wǎn cān chī le shén me? hǎi xiān ma?
dialogue.en: Great. What did you eat for dinner? Seafood?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 對，我們去夜市吃了很多海鮮，最後還喝了當地的特色果汁。
dialogue.py: duì, wǒ men qù yè shì chī le hěn duō hǎi xiān, zuì hòu hái hē le dāng dì de tè sè guǒ zhī.
dialogue.en: Yes, we went to the night market and ate lots of seafood, and finally drank the local specialty juice.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 聽起來是一個完美的週末。你拍照片了嗎？
dialogue.py: tīng qǐ lái shì yī gè wán měi de zhōu mò. nǐ pāi zhào piàn le ma?
dialogue.en: Sounds like a perfect weekend. Did you take photos?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 拍了很多！等一下我發給你看看。
dialogue.py: pāi le hěn duō! děng yī xià wǒ fā gěi nǐ kàn kàn.
dialogue.en: Took a lot! I'll send them to you in a bit to take a look.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 好。不過墾丁太陽很大，你有沒有曬傷？
dialogue.py: hǎo. bù guò kěn dīng tài yáng hěn dà, nǐ yǒu méi yǒu shài shāng?
dialogue.en: Okay. But the sun is strong in Kenting, did you get sunburned?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 有一點兒。雖然塗了防曬油，但還是曬黑了。
dialogue.py: yǒu yī diǎn r. suī rán tú le fáng shài yóu, dàn shì hái shì shài hēi le.
dialogue.en: A little bit. Although I applied sunscreen, I still got tanned.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 曬黑一點兒看起來更健康。
dialogue.py: shài hēi yī diǎn r kàn qǐ lái gèng jiàn kāng.
dialogue.en: Getting a bit tanned makes you look healthier.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我也這麼想。下次我們一起去吧！
dialogue.py: wǒ yě zhè me xiǎng. xià cì wǒ men yī qǐ qù ba!
dialogue.en: I think so too. Let's go together next time!

key_sentences.en: I'll send [them] to you to see.

vocabulary.example: 花園裡開滿了五顏六色的花。

speaking.part_b: Role-play: 告訴朋友你上週末去了墾丁。描述你先做了什麼（海灘），然後做了什麼（潛水），以及晚餐吃了什麼。朋友問你有沒有曬黑。
part_c: 你喜歡去海邊嗎？
你上週末去哪兒了？

comprehension.q: 馬克上週末去了哪裡？
馬克和朋友在海灘上先做了什麼？
海裡的魚是怎麼樣的？
馬克拍的照片要怎麼給大衛看？
馬克為什麼曬黑了？
options: A. 因為他沒塗防曬油
B. 因為墾丁太陽很大

true_false.q: 大衛上週末也去了墾丁。
馬克覺得潛水很好玩。
墾丁的水很不乾淨。
馬克晚上去了夜市。

passage.title: My Last Weekend Listening Passage
passage.zh: 上週末馬克去旅行了。他剛回到學校。他告訴朋友大衛他的旅行經歷。他談到了天氣、活動和食物。他們練習使用順序詞：先、然後、最後。
passage.en: Mark, welcome back! I heard you went to the seaside last weekend? Yes, a few friends and I went to Kenting. It was really so beautiful there! Kenting? That's quite far. What did you do there? We first sunbathed on the beach, then went diving to see the fish. Diving? Was it fun? I've always wanted to try. Extremely fun! The water was very clear, and we could see many colorful fish.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: 請寫 3 到 5 句話描述你上一次旅行的經歷。你去了哪裡？做了什麼？吃到了什麼好吃的？（請使用 '先...然後...' 的結構）。

grammar.explanation: 使用順序詞 '先 (xiān)'、'然後 (rán hòu)'、'最後 (zuì hòu)'。使用 '雖然 (suī rán)...但是 (dàn shì)...' 表轉折。
examples: 我先吃飯，然後看電視。 (I first eat, then watch TV.)
雖然下雨，但我還是去了。 (Although it rained, I still went.)

practice.q: Translate: First go to school, then come home.
Translate: I'll send it to you later.
Complete: 我___拍了一張照片。 (I just took...)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 你的假期過得怎麼樣？
expansion_dialogue.py: nǐ de jià qī guò de zěn me yàng?
expansion_dialogue.en: How was your vacation?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 過得很愉快。我去了日本，玩了十天。
expansion_dialogue.py: guò de hěn yú kuài. wǒ qù le rì běn, wán le shí tiān.
expansion_dialogue.en: Very pleasant. I went to Japan and played for ten days.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 哇，那一定很有趣。你買了很多東西嗎？
expansion_dialogue.py: wa, nà yī dìng hěn yǒu qù. nǐ mǎi le hěn duō dōng xi ma?
expansion_dialogue.en: Wow, that must have been interesting. Did you buy a lot of things?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 對，買了很多當地的小吃和紀念品。
expansion_dialogue.py: duì, mǎi le hěn duō dāng dì de xiǎo chī hé jì niàn pǐn.
expansion_dialogue.en: Yes, bought lots of local snacks and souvenirs.

review.speaking: Tell a short story about your last weekend using 'First', 'Then', and 'Finally'.
review.writing: Write a 5-sentence paragraph about a trip you took.
review.self_check: 你能用順序詞描述過去的活動嗎？

title: I Forgot My Homework
story_description: 馬克忘記帶作業了。他向老師解釋原因並誠懇道歉。
story_intro: 現在是中文課。
老師正在收大家的作業。
馬克發現他忘記帶作業了。
他感到很抱歉，並向老師說明情況。
他們練習使用道歉和承諾的表達。

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 各位同學，請把昨天的作業交上來。
dialogue.py: gè wèi tóng xué, qǐng bǎ zuó tiān de zuò yè jiāo shàng lái.
dialogue.en: Class, please hand in yesterday's homework.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: （小聲地）糟糕，我的作業呢？
dialogue.py: (xiǎo shēng de) zāo gāo, wǒ de zuò yè ne?
dialogue.en: (Softly) Oh no, where is my homework?

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 馬克，你的作業在哪裡？大家都交了。
dialogue.py: mǎ kè, nǐ de zuò yè zài nǎ lǐ? dà jiā dōu jiāo le.
dialogue.en: Mark, where is your homework? Everyone else has handed theirs in.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 老師，非常抱歉。我忘記帶了。
dialogue.py: lǎo shī, fēi cháng bào qiàn. wǒ wàng jì dài le.
dialogue.en: Teacher, I'm very sorry. I forgot to bring it.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 忘記帶了？你做了嗎？
dialogue.py: wàng jì dài le? nǐ zuò le ma?
dialogue.en: Forgot to bring it? Did you do it?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我真的做了。但我今早出門太急，把它留在書桌上了。
dialogue.py: wǒ zhēn de zuò le. dàn wǒ jīn zǎo chū mén tài jí, bǎ tā liú zài shū zhuō shàng le.
dialogue.en: I really did it. But I was in such a hurry leaving this morning, I left it on my desk.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 這已經是本學期第二次了。你應該更細心一點。
dialogue.py: zhè yǐ jīng shì běn xué qī dì èr cì le. nǐ yīng gāi gèng xì xīn yī diǎn.
dialogue.en: This is already the second time this semester. You should be a bit more careful.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我知道。對不起，我保證下次不會再犯了。
dialogue.py: wǒ zhī dào. duì bù qǐ, wǒ bǎo zhèng xià cì bù huì zài fàn le.
dialogue.en: I know. I'm sorry; I promise I won't do it again next time.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 那你打算怎麼辦？這份作業今天必須交。
dialogue.py: nà nǐ dǎ suàn zěn me bàn? zhè fèn zuò yè jīn tiān bì xū jiāo.
dialogue.en: So what do you plan to do? This assignment must be handed in today.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我下課後馬上回宿舍拿，下午三點前交給您，可以嗎？
dialogue.py: wǒ xià kè hòu mǎ shàng huí sù shè ná, xià wǔ sān diǎn qián jiāo gěi nín, kě yǐ ma?
dialogue.en: I'll go back to the dorm to get it immediately after class and give it to you before 3:00 PM; is that okay?

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 好吧。既然你保證了，我就再給你一次機會。
dialogue.py: hǎo ba. jì rán nǐ bǎo zhèng le, wǒ jiù zài gěi nǐ yī cì jī huì.
dialogue.en: Okay then. Since you promised, I'll give you one more chance.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 謝謝老師！我一定會準時交的。
dialogue.py: xiè xie lǎo shī! wǒ yī dìng huì zhǔn shí jiāo de.
dialogue.en: Thank you, teacher! I will definitely hand it in on time.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 記住，態度比分數更重要。
dialogue.py: jì zhù, tài dù bǐ fēn shù gèng zhòng yào.
dialogue.en: Remember, attitude is more important than grades.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 明白了，我會記住的。
dialogue.py: míng bai le, wǒ huì jì zhù de.
dialogue.en: Understood, I'll keep that in mind.

key_sentences.en: Promise not to repeat next time.
Attitude is more important than grades.

passage.title: I Forgot My Homework Listening Passage
passage.zh: 現在是中文課。老師正在收大家的作業。馬克發現他忘記帶作業了。他感到很抱歉，並向老師說明情況。他們練習使用道歉和承諾的表達。
passage.en: Class, please hand in yesterday's homework. (Softly) Oh no, where is my homework? Mark, where is your homework? Everyone else has handed theirs in. Teacher, I'm very sorry. I forgot to bring it. Forgot to bring it? Did you do it? I really did it. But I was in such a hurry leaving this morning, I left it on my desk.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: 請寫一封簡短的道歉信給老師或朋友。說明你忘記了什麼、原因是什麼，以及你打算怎麼補救（40 到 60 個字）。

grammar.explanation: 使用 '把 (bǎ)' 字句描述對事物的處理。使用 '必須 (bì xū)' 表達必要性。比較級 'A 比 B + Adjective'。
examples: 把書交給老師。 (Hand the book to the teacher.)
我必須去開會。 (I must go to the meeting.)
他比我細心。 (He is more careful than me.)
既然如此 (Since it's like this)

title: Finding a Lost Wallet
story_description: 馬克在路上撿到了一個錢包。他把它送到捷運站的服務台。
story_intro: 馬克在捷運站門口發現一個錢包。
他不知道是誰的。
他把錢包交給了服務台的職員。
他描述了錢包的樣子和裡面的東西。
他們練習描述物品的外觀和內容。

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 你好，我在捷運站入口撿到了一個錢包。
dialogue.py: nǐ hǎo, wǒ zài jié yùn zhàn rù kǒu jiǎn dào le yī gè qián bāo.
dialogue.en: Hello, I found a wallet at the MRT station entrance.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.zh: 太感謝你了！你真是一位好市民。請把它交給我吧。
dialogue.py: tài gǎn xiè nǐ le! nǐ zhēn shì yī wèi hǎo shì mín. qǐng bǎ tā jiāo gěi wǒ ba.
dialogue.en: Thank you so much! You are truly a good citizen. Please hand it to me.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。這是剛才撿到的。
dialogue.py: méi wèn tí. zhè shì gāng cái jiǎn dào de.
dialogue.en: No problem. This was just found.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.zh: 這個錢包是什麼樣子的？我們需要登記一下。
dialogue.py: zhè ge qián bāo shì shén me yàng zi de? wǒ men xū yào dēng jì yī xià.
dialogue.en: What does this wallet look like? We need to register it.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 這是一個黑色的皮革錢包，長方形的，看起來有點兒舊。
dialogue.py: zhè shì yī gè hēi sè de pí gé qián bāo, cháng fāng xíng de, kàn qǐ lái yǒu diǎn r jiù.
dialogue.en: It's a black leather wallet, rectangular, and looks a bit old.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.zh: 好的。裡面除了錢，還有別的東西嗎？
dialogue.py: hǎo de. lǐ miàn chú le qián, hái yǒu bié de dōng xi ma?
dialogue.en: Okay. Besides money, is there anything else inside?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我剛才看了一下，裡面有幾張信用卡、一張學生證，還有一張照片。
dialogue.py: wǒ gāng cái kàn le yī xià, lǐ miàn yǒu jǐ zhāng xìn yòng kǎ, yī zhāng xué sheng zhèng, hái yǒu yī zhāng zhào piàn.
dialogue.en: I just took a look; inside there are a few credit cards, a student ID, and a photo.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.zh: 學生證上有名字嗎？
dialogue.py: xué sheng zhèng shàng yǒu míng zi ma?
dialogue.en: Is there a name on the student ID?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 有的，上面寫著'李華'。
dialogue.py: yǒu de, shàng miàn xiě zhe 'lǐ huá'.
dialogue.en: Yes, it says 'Li Hua' on it.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.zh: 太好了，這樣我們就能聯繫到失主了。
dialogue.py: tài hǎo le, zhè yàng wǒ men jiù néng lián xì dào shī zhǔ le.
dialogue.en: Great, that way we can contact the owner.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 希望他能快點找回自己的錢包。丟了錢包一定很著急。
dialogue.py: xī wàng tā néng kuài diǎn zhǎo huí zì jǐ de qián bāo. diū le qián bāo yī dìng hěn zháo jí.
dialogue.en: I hope he can find his wallet back soon. Losing a wallet must be very worrying.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.zh: 是的。謝謝你的熱心幫助。請留下你的電話，方便我們聯繫你。
dialogue.py: shì de. xiè xie nǐ de rè xīn bāng zhù. qǐng liú xià nǐ de diàn huà, fāng biàn wǒ men lián xì nǐ.
dialogue.en: Yes. Thank you for your warm help. Please leave your phone number so it's easy for us to contact you.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.py: méi wèn tí, wǒ de hào mǎ shì líng jiǔ yī èr, sān sì wǔ liù qī bā.
dialogue.en: No problem; my number is 0912-345678.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.zh: 記下來了。再次感謝你！
dialogue.py: jì xià lái le. zài cì gǎn xiè nǐ!
dialogue.en: Recorded. Thanks again!

passage.title: Finding a Lost Wallet Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克在捷運站門口發現一個錢包。他不知道是誰的。他把錢包交給了服務台的職員。他描述了錢包的樣子和裡面的東西。他們練習描述物品的外觀和內容。

What does this wallet look like? We need to register it. It's a black leather wallet, rectangular, and looks a bit old. Okay. Besides money, is there anything else inside?

grammar.explanation: 使用 '...寫著...' 表示狀態。描述形狀 (長方形)。複合趨向補語 (撿到、找回)。
examples: 牆上寫著他的名字。 (The name is written on the wall.)
我撿到了一支筆。 (I picked up a pen.)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A

expansion_dialogue.py: qǐng wèn yǒu rén jiǎn dào yī gè hóng sè de yǔ sǎn ma?
expansion_dialogue.en: Excuse me, has anyone found a red umbrella?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 有的，剛才有一位學生送過來。是這一把嗎？
expansion_dialogue.py: yǒu de, gāng cái yǒu yī wèi xué sheng sòng guò lái. shì zhè yī bǎ ma?
expansion_dialogue.en: Yes, a student just brought one over. Is it this one?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 對，就是這一把！太好了，謝謝你。
expansion_dialogue.py: duì, jiù shì zhè yī bǎ! tài hǎo le, xiè xie nǐ.
expansion_dialogue.en: Yes, this is exactly the one! Great, thank you.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 不客氣，請在登記簿上簽個名。
expansion_dialogue.py: bù kè qì, qǐng zài dēng jì bù shàng qiān gè míng.
expansion_dialogue.en: You're welcome; please sign your name in the registry book.

title: My Phone Battery Died
story_description: 馬克的手機沒電了，但他需要聯繫朋友。他向路人尋求幫助。
story_intro: 馬克在街上等朋友。
突然他的手機自動關機了。
他發現手機沒電了。
他沒有帶充電器。
他必須找人幫忙打一個電話。

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 糟了，手機怎麼黑屏了？
dialogue.py: zāo le, shǒu jī zěn me hēi píng le?
dialogue.en: Oh no, why has the phone screen gone black?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: （按按鈕）沒反應...原來是沒電了。
dialogue.py: (àn àn niǔ) méi fǎn yìng... yuán lái shì méi diàn le.
dialogue.en: (Pressing button) No response... turns out it's out of battery.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，請問附近有可以充電的地方嗎？
dialogue.py: bù hǎo yì si, qǐng wèn fù jìn yǒu kě yǐ chōng diàn de dì fang ma?
dialogue.en: Excuse me, is there a place nearby to charge a phone?

dialogue.speaker: Passerby
dialogue.zh: 你可以去對面的便利商店看看，那裡通常有共享行動電源。
dialogue.py: nǐ kě yǐ qù duì miàn de biàn lì shāng diàn kàn kàn, nà lǐ tōng cháng yǒu gòng xiǎng xíng dòng diàn yuán.
dialogue.en: You can check the convenience store opposite; they usually have shared power banks.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好的，謝謝。但我現在急著聯繫朋友，我的手機已經關機了。
dialogue.py: hǎo de, xiè xie. dàn wǒ xiàn zài jí zhe lián xì péng you, wǒ de shǒu jī yǐ jīng guān jī le.
dialogue.en: Okay, thanks. But I'm in a hurry to contact a friend, and my phone has already shut down.

dialogue.speaker: Passerby
dialogue.zh: 發生了什麼急事嗎？
dialogue.py: fā shēng le shén me jí shì ma?
dialogue.en: Did something urgent happen?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我們約好在這裡見面，我怕他找不到我。能不能借您的手機打個電話？
dialogue.py: wǒ men yuē hǎo zài zhè lǐ jiàn miàn, wǒ pà tā zhǎo bù dào wǒ. néng bù néng jiè nín de shǒu jī dǎ gè diàn huà?
dialogue.en: We agreed to meet here, and I'm afraid he won't find me. Could I borrow your phone to make a call?

dialogue.speaker: Passerby
dialogue.zh: 可以。給你，用吧。
dialogue.py: kě yǐ. gěi nǐ, yòng ba.
dialogue.en: Yes. Here, use it.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: （撥號）喂，大衛嗎？我是馬克。我的手機沒電關機了。
dialogue.py: (bō hào) wéi, dà wèi ma? wǒ shì mǎ kè. wǒ de shǒu jī méi diàn guān jī le.
dialogue.en: (Dialing) Hello, David? It's Mark. My phone ran out of power and shut down.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我現在就在咖啡店門口等你。好，待會兒見。
dialogue.py: wǒ xiàn zài jiù zài kā fēi diàn mén kǒu děng nǐ. hǎo, dāi huì r jiàn.
dialogue.en: I'm right at the coffee shop entrance waiting for you. Okay, see you in a bit.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 太謝謝您了！這是您的手機。
dialogue.py: tài xiè xie nín le! zhè shì nín de shǒu jī.
dialogue.en: Thank you so much! Here is your phone.

dialogue.speaker: Passerby
dialogue.zh: 沒關係，小事一樁。下次記得帶上充電寶。
dialogue.py: méi guān xi, xiǎo shì yī zhuāng. xià cì jì de dài shàng chōng diàn bǎo.
dialogue.en: No problem, it's a small thing. Remember to bring a power bank next time.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 一定。您真是個熱心腸的人。
dialogue.py: yī dìng. nín zhēn shì gè rè xīn cháng de rén.
dialogue.en: Definitely. You are really a warm-hearted person.

dialogue.speaker: Passerby
dialogue.zh: 哪裡，祝你們玩得開心。
dialogue.py: nǎ lǐ, zhù nǐ men wán de kāi xīn.
dialogue.en: Not at all, wish you two a happy time.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B

title: Making a Simple Appointment
story_description: 馬克牙痛，他打電話給牙醫診所預約看診時間。
story_intro: 馬克的牙齒很不舒服。
他決定去看醫生。
他找了一家附近的牙醫診所。
他打電話詢問醫生的看診時間。
他成功預約了明天的時間。

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.zh: 你好，這裡是大愛牙醫診所。請問有什麼可以幫您的？
dialogue.py: nǐ hǎo, zhè lǐ shì dà ài yá yī zhěn suǒ. qǐng wèn yǒu shén me kě yǐ bāng nín de?
dialogue.en: Hello, this is Great Love Dental Clinic. How can I help you?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 你好，我想預約看牙醫。我的牙齒疼得厲害。
dialogue.py: nǐ hǎo, wǒ xiǎng yù yuē kàn yá yī. wǒ de yá chǐ téng de lì hai.
dialogue.en: Hello, I'd like to make an appointment to see a dentist. My tooth hurts badly.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.zh: 好的。您是第一次來我們診所嗎？
dialogue.py: hǎo de. nín shì dì yī cì lái wǒ men zhěn suǒ ma?
dialogue.en: Okay. Is this your first time at our clinic?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 對，我是新病患。
dialogue.py: duì, wǒ shì xīn bìng huàn.
dialogue.en: Yes, I'm a new patient.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。請問您想預約什麼時候？
dialogue.py: méi wèn tí. qǐng wèn nín xiǎng yù yuē shén me shí hou?
dialogue.en: No problem. When would you like to make the appointment?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 今天下午有空嗎？最好是四點以後。
dialogue.py: jīn tiān xià wǔ yǒu kòng ma? zuì hǎo shì sì diǎn yǐ hòu.
dialogue.en: Are you free this afternoon? Preferably after 4:00.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，今天下午醫生的時間都滿了。明天上午十點可以嗎？
dialogue.py: bào qiàn, jīn tiān xià wǔ yī shēng de shí jiān dōu mǎn le. míng tiān shàng wǔ shí diǎn kě yǐ ma?
dialogue.en: Sorry, the doctor is fully booked this afternoon. Is tomorrow morning at 10:00 okay?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 明天上午十點...好的，沒問題。
dialogue.py: míng tiān shàng wǔ shí diǎn... hǎo de, méi wèn tí.
dialogue.en: Tomorrow morning at 10:00... okay, no problem.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.zh: 請留下您的姓名和聯絡電話。
dialogue.py: qǐng liú xià nín de xìng míng hé lián luò diàn huà.
dialogue.en: Please leave your name and contact number.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.py: wǒ jiào mǎ kè, diàn huà shì líng jiǔ yī èr, sān sì wǔ liù qī bā.
dialogue.en: My name is Mark, phone is 0912-345678.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.zh: 好的，馬克先生。請明天準時到達。如果有事不能來，請提前通知我們。
dialogue.py: hǎo de, mǎ kè xiān sheng. qǐng míng tiān zhǔn shí dào dá. rú guǒ yǒu shì bù néng lái, qǐng tí qián tōng zhī wǒ men.
dialogue.en: Okay, Mr. Mark. Please arrive on time tomorrow. If you can't come for any reason, please notify us in advance.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好的，謝謝。明天見。
dialogue.py: hǎo de, xiè xie. míng tiān jiàn.
dialogue.en: Okay, thanks. See you tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.zh: 再見。
dialogue.py: zài jiàn.
dialogue.en: Goodbye.

key_sentences.en: I'd like to make an appointment to see a dentist.
If you can't come, notify in advance.

speaking.part_b: Role-play: 你想預約看內科醫生。打電話給診所，問今天下午三點有沒有空。職員說三點沒空，四點半可以。你接受了，並留下姓名（馬克）。

passage.title: Making a Simple Appointment Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克的牙齒很不舒服。他決定去看醫生。他找了一家附近的牙醫診所。他打電話詢問醫生的看診時間。他成功預約了明天的時間。

Yes, I'm a new patient. No problem. When would you like to make the appointment? Are you free this afternoon? Preferably after 4:00.

writing: 請寫一封簡短的簡訊給診所預約時間。說明你想看什麼病（如感冒、牙痛）、想預約的時間，以及你的姓名（40 到 60 個字）。

grammar.explanation: 使用 '...得厲害' 表示程度深。使用 '第一次'、'第二次' 表頻率。表達建議時使用 '最好是...'。

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 請問王醫生在嗎？我沒預約。
expansion_dialogue.py: qǐng wèn wáng yī shēng zài ma? wǒ méi yù yuē.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A

expansion_dialogue.en: That long! Then I'll just make an appointment for tomorrow first.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B

expansion_dialogue.py: hǎo de, míng tiān xià wǔ sān diǎn yǒu kòng wèi, kě yǐ ma?

title: Changing an Appointment
story_description: 馬克因為學校有急事，不得不打電話更改原本的牙醫預約。
story_intro: 馬克原本明天要去診所。
但剛才老師通知明天要考試。
他不能按時去診所了。
他打電話請求更改時間。
他們練習委婉地解釋原因並商量新時間。

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.zh: 你好，大愛牙醫。馬克先生，是您嗎？
dialogue.py: nǐ hǎo, dà ài yá yī. mǎ kè xiān sheng, shì nín ma?
dialogue.en: Hello, Great Love Dental. Mr. Mark, is that you?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 你好，是我。不好意思，我明天上午不能來了。
dialogue.py: nǐ hǎo, shì wǒ. bù hǎo yì si, wǒ míng tiān shàng wǔ bù néng lái le.
dialogue.en: Hello, it's me. I'm sorry; I can't come tomorrow morning anymore.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.zh: 發生了什麼事嗎？需要取消預約嗎？
dialogue.py: fā shēng le shén me shì ma? xū yào qǔ xiāo yù yuē ma?
dialogue.en: Did something happen? Do you need to cancel the appointment?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 不用取消，我想更改一下時間。因為明天臨時有個考試。
dialogue.py: bù yòng qǔ xiāo, wǒ xiǎng gēng gǎi yī xià shí jiān. yīn wèi míng tiān lín shí yǒu gè kǎo shì.
dialogue.en: No need to cancel; I'd like to change the time. Because there's a temporary exam tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.zh: 我明白了。學業很重要。那您想改到什麼時候？
dialogue.py: wǒ míng bai le. xué yè hěn zhòng yào. nà nín xiǎng gǎi dào shén me shí hou?
dialogue.en: I understand. School is important. Then when would you like to change it to?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 明天下午或者後天上午都可以。請問哪天有空位？
dialogue.py: míng tiān xià wǔ huò zhě hòu tiān shàng wǔ dōu kě yǐ. qǐng wèn nǎ tiān yǒu kòng wèi?
dialogue.en: Tomorrow afternoon or the day after tomorrow morning are both fine. Which day has an opening?

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.zh: 我查一下...明天下午四點半有一個空位，可以嗎？
dialogue.py: wǒ chá yī xià... míng tiān xià wǔ sì diǎn bàn yǒu yī gè kòng wèi, kě yǐ ma?
dialogue.en: Let me check... there's an opening tomorrow afternoon at 4:30; is that okay?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 四點半...那時候考試應該結束了。好的，可以。
dialogue.py: sì diǎn bàn... nà shí hou kǎo shì yīng gāi jié shù le. hǎo de, kě yǐ.
dialogue.en: 4:30... the exam should be over by then. Okay, that works.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.zh: 好的。我已經幫您把預約改到明天下午四點半了。
dialogue.py: hǎo de. wǒ yǐ jīng bāng nín bǎ yù yuē gǎi dào míng tiān xià wǔ sì diǎn bàn le.
dialogue.en: Okay. I've already changed your appointment to 4:30 tomorrow afternoon for you.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 太感謝你了！給你添麻煩了。
dialogue.py: tài gǎn xiè nǐ le! gěi nǐ tiān má fan le.
dialogue.en: Thank you so much! Sorry to trouble you.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.zh: 沒關係。祝您考試順利！
dialogue.py: méi guān xi. zhù nín kǎo shì shùn lì!
dialogue.en: No problem. Good luck on your exam!

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，明天見。
dialogue.py: xiè xie, míng tiān jiàn.
dialogue.en: Thanks, see you tomorrow.

key_sentences.en: Sorry for the trouble (lit. added trouble to you).

speaking.part_b: Role-play: 你原本預約了明天修手機。但你明天要跟朋友去圖書館。打電話給維修店，問能不能改到週五下午。職員幫你改了，你表示感謝。
part_c: 你常更改原本的計劃嗎？
當你需要更改預約時，你會覺得不好意思嗎？

馬克想取消預約還是更改預約？

options: B. 考試那時候應該結束了

馬克對職員說了什麼表示客氣？

passage.title: Changing an Appointment Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克原本明天要去診所。但剛才老師通知明天要考試。他不能按時去診所了。他打電話請求更改時間。他們練習委婉地解釋原因並商量新時間。
passage.en: Hello, Great Love Dental. Mr. Mark, is that you? Hello, it's me. I'm sorry; I can't come tomorrow morning anymore. Did something happen? Do you need to cancel the appointment? No need to cancel; I'd like to change the time. Because there's a temporary exam tomorrow. I understand. School is important. Then when would you like to change it to? Tomorrow afternoon or the day after tomorrow morning are both fine. Which day has an opening?
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: 請寫一封簡短的訊息給你的朋友，解釋你為什麼不能參加原本約好的聚會，並提議一個新的見面時間（40 到 60 個字）。

grammar.explanation: 使用 '應該' 表示推測或建議。使用 '添麻煩' 表達歉意。使用 '...前' 或 '...後' 表示時間點。
examples: 明天應該會下雨。 (It should rain tomorrow.)
給你添麻煩了。 (Caused trouble for you.)
下課後見。 (See you after class.)

expansion_dialogue.en: What time was it changed to? I didn't look at my inbox just now.

expansion_dialogue.py: gǎi dào jīn tiān xià wǔ liǎng diǎn, zài sān lóu huì yì shì.
expansion_dialogue.en: Changed to 2:00 this afternoon, in the conference room on the third floor.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B

expansion_dialogue.py: hǎo de, wǒ zhī dào le. xiè xie nǐ tōng zhī wǒ.
expansion_dialogue.en: Okay, I got it. Thanks for notifying me.

title: At the Hair Salon
story_description: 馬克的頭髮長了，他去理髮店想剪一個清爽的髮型。
story_intro: 馬克的頭髮太長了。
他覺得有點兒熱。
他走進一家理髮店。
他向理髮師說明他想要的長度和風格。
理髮師給了他一些專業的建議。

dialogue.speaker: Barber
dialogue.zh: 你好！歡迎光臨。想怎麼剪？
dialogue.py: nǐ hǎo! huān yíng guāng lín. xiǎng zěn me jiǎn?
dialogue.en: Hello! Welcome. How would you like to cut [it]?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 你好。我最近覺得頭髮太長了，想剪短一點兒。
dialogue.py: nǐ hǎo. wǒ zuì jìn jué de tóu fa tài cháng le, xiǎng jiǎn duǎn yī diǎn r.
dialogue.en: Hello. I've felt my hair is too long recently; I want to cut it a bit shorter.

dialogue.speaker: Barber
dialogue.zh: 好的。想剪什麼樣的髮型？有照片可以參考嗎？
dialogue.py: hǎo de. xiǎng jiǎn shén me yàng de fǎ xíng? yǒu zhào piàn kě yǐ cān kǎo ma?
dialogue.en: Okay. What kind of hairstyle would you like? Do you have a photo for reference?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 沒有照片。我想要兩邊剪短，上面留長一點兒。
dialogue.py: méi yǒu zhào piàn. wǒ xiǎng yào liǎng biān jiǎn duǎn, shàng miàn liú cháng yī diǎn r.
dialogue.en: No photo. I want the sides cut short and the top left a bit longer.

dialogue.speaker: Barber
dialogue.zh: 我明白了。也就是現在很流行的這種清爽髮型，對吧？
dialogue.py: wǒ míng bai le. yě jiù shì xiàn zài hěn liú xíng de zhè zhǒng qīng shuǎng fǎ xíng, duì ba?
dialogue.en: I understand. That is, this kind of refreshing hairstyle that's very popular now, right?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 對，看起來精神一點兒就好。
dialogue.py: duì, kàn qǐ lái jīng shén yī diǎn r jiù hǎo.
dialogue.en: Yes, as long as it looks more energetic/neat.

dialogue.speaker: Barber
dialogue.zh: 好的。要洗頭嗎？我們這裡洗剪吹一共是五百塊。
dialogue.py: hǎo de. yào xǐ tóu ma? wǒ men zhè lǐ xǐ jiǎn chuī yī gòng shì wǔ bǎi kuài.
dialogue.en: Okay. Do you want a hair wash? Our wash, cut, and dry is 500 dollars total.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 要洗，謝謝。水溫可以幫我調低一點兒嗎？我怕熱。
dialogue.py: yào xǐ, xiè xie. shuǐ wēn kě yǐ bāng wǒ tiáo dī yī diǎn r ma? wǒ pà rè.
dialogue.en: Yes, please. Could you help me lower the water temperature a bit? I'm sensitive to heat.

dialogue.speaker: Barber
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。請到這邊躺下。我們先洗頭。
dialogue.py: méi wèn tí. qǐng dào zhè biān tǎng xià. wǒ men xiān xǐ tóu.
dialogue.en: No problem. Please lie down over here. We'll wash the hair first.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: （洗頭中）力度剛好，很舒服。
dialogue.py: (xǐ tóu zhōng) lì dù gāng hǎo, hěn shū fu.
dialogue.en: (During washing) The pressure is just right; very comfortable.

dialogue.speaker: Barber
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。剪完後您看看滿不滿意。
dialogue.py: xiè xie. jiǎn wán hòu nín kàn kàn mǎn bù mǎn yì.
dialogue.en: Thanks. See if you're satisfied after the cut.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好的。麻煩你了。
dialogue.py: hǎo de. má fan nǐ le.
dialogue.en: Okay. Thank you for your trouble.

key_sentences.en: Want to cut it a bit shorter.
Leave the top a bit longer.

speaking.part_b: Role-play: 你去理髮店。告訴理髮師你想要剪一個流行的髮型。你拿出一張照片給他看。問他洗頭要不要另外加錢。

comprehension.q: 馬克希望剪完頭髮後看起來怎麼樣？

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 你染頭髮了嗎？這個顏色很襯你的膚色。
expansion_dialogue.py: nǐ rǎn tóu fa le ma? zhè ge yán sè hěn chèn nǐ de fū sè.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B

expansion_dialogue.en: Just the one by the school's back gate, called 'Beauty Hair House'.

title: At the Bank
story_description: 馬克想開一個銀行帳戶。他去銀行諮詢手續和需要的證件。
story_intro: 馬克需要一個當地的銀行帳戶。
他帶上了他的護照。
他走進銀行取號排隊。
他向櫃檯職員詢問開戶的流程。
他填寫了一些表格並辦理了手續。

dialogue.speaker: Teller
dialogue.zh: 您好！請坐。請問要辦理什麼業務？
dialogue.py: nín hǎo! qǐng zuò. qǐng wèn yào bàn lǐ shén me yè wù?
dialogue.en: Hello! Please sit down. What business would you like to handle?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 你好。我想開一個新的銀行帳戶。
dialogue.py: nǐ hǎo. wǒ xiǎng kāi yī gè xīn de yín háng zhàng hù.
dialogue.en: Hello. I'd like to open a new bank account.

dialogue.speaker: Teller
dialogue.zh: 好的。請問您帶身分證件了嗎？我們需要護照和居留證。
dialogue.py: hǎo de. qǐng wèn nín dài shēn fèn zhèng jiàn le ma? wǒ men xū yào hù zhào hé jū liú zhèng.
dialogue.en: Okay. Did you bring your identification? We need your passport and residency permit.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 帶了，這是在我的護照，這是我的居留證。
dialogue.py: dài le, zhè shì zài wǒ de hù zhào, zhè shì wǒ de jū liú zhèng.
dialogue.en: Brought them; here is my passport, and here is my residency permit.

dialogue.speaker: Teller
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。請填寫這張開戶申請表。這裡需要您的中文名字和聯絡地址。
dialogue.py: xiè xie. qǐng tián xiě zhè zhāng kāi hù shēn qǐng biǎo. zhè lǐ xū yào nín de zhōng wén míng zi hé lián luò dì zhǐ.
dialogue.en: Thank you. Please fill out this account opening application form. Your Chinese name and contact address are needed here.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好的。可以用英文地址嗎？我不記得宿舍的中文地址。
dialogue.py: hǎo de. kě yǐ yòng yīng wén dì zhǐ ma? wǒ bù jì de sù shè de zhōng wén dì zhǐ.
dialogue.en: Okay. Can I use an English address? I don't remember the Chinese address of the dorm.

dialogue.speaker: Teller
dialogue.zh: 最好填中文的。如果您不確定，可以先查一下手機。
dialogue.py: zuì hǎo tián zhōng wén de. rú guǒ nín bù què dìng, kě yǐ xiān chá yī xià shǒu jī.
dialogue.en: It's best to fill in Chinese. If you aren't sure, you can check your phone first.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 喔，好。我查到了。填好了，給您。
dialogue.py: ō, hǎo. wǒ chá dào le. tián hǎo le, gěi nín.
dialogue.en: Oh, okay. I've found it. Filled out, here you go.

dialogue.speaker: Teller
dialogue.zh: 請在這裡簽名。還需要設定一個六位數的提款密碼。
dialogue.py: qǐng zài zhè lǐ qiān míng. hái xū yào shè dìng yī gè liù wèi shù de tí kuǎn mì mǎ.
dialogue.en: Please sign here. Also, a six-digit withdrawal password needs to be set.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好的。我現在可以在這裡存錢嗎？
dialogue.py: hǎo de. wǒ xiàn zài kě yǐ zài zhè lǐ cún qián ma?
dialogue.en: Okay. Can I deposit money here now?

dialogue.speaker: Teller
dialogue.zh: 可以。手續辦好後，您可以直接在櫃檯存，也可以用自動提款機。
dialogue.py: kě yǐ. shǒu xù bàn hǎo hòu, nín kě yǐ zhí jiē zài guì tái cún, yě kě yǐ yòng zì dòng tí kuǎn jī.
dialogue.en: Yes. After the procedures are handled, you can deposit directly at the counter or use an ATM.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 明白了。那提款卡什麼時候能拿到？
dialogue.py: míng bai le. nà tí kuǎn kǎ shén me shí hou néng ná dào?
dialogue.en: Understood. When can I get the debit card?

dialogue.speaker: Teller
dialogue.zh: 現在就能拿。請稍等五分鐘。
dialogue.py: xiàn zài jiù néng ná. qǐng shāo děng wǔ fēn zhōng.
dialogue.en: You can get it right now. Please wait for five minutes.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 太好了，謝謝！
dialogue.py: tài hǎo le, xiè xie!
dialogue.en: Great, thanks!

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 你好，我想換點兒人民幣。
expansion_dialogue.py: nǐ hǎo, wǒ xiǎng huàn diǎn r rén mín bì.
expansion_dialogue.en: Hello, I'd like to exchange some RMB.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 好的。今天的匯率是一比四點五。您要換多少？
expansion_dialogue.py: hǎo de. jīn tiān de huì lǜ shì yī bǐ sì diǎn wǔ. nín yào huàn duō shǎo?
expansion_dialogue.en: Okay. Today's exchange rate is 1 to 4.5. How much do you want to exchange?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 我要換兩千塊台幣的人民幣。
expansion_dialogue.py: wǒ yào huàn liǎng qiān kuài tái bì de rén mín bì.
expansion_dialogue.en: I want to exchange 2,000 NTD for RMB.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 好的，請出示證件並填寫換匯單。
expansion_dialogue.py: hǎo de, qǐng chū shì zhèng jiàn bìng tián xiě huàn huì dān.
expansion_dialogue.en: Okay; please show your ID and fill out the exchange slip.

title: At the Post Office
story_description: 馬克想寄一個包裹給他在加拿大的朋友。他去郵局詢問價格和運送時間。
story_intro: 馬克買了一些禮物。
他要把禮物寄到國外。
他來到當地的郵局。
他向職員詢問快遞和普通空運的區別。
他選擇了合適的運送方式並付了款。

dialogue.speaker: Teller
dialogue.zh: 您好！請問要寄信還是寄包裹？
dialogue.py: nín hǎo! qǐng wèn yào jì xìn hái shì jì bāo guǒ?
dialogue.en: Hello! Would you like to send a letter or a package?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 你好。我想寄這個包裹到加拿大。
dialogue.py: nǐ hǎo. wǒ xiǎng jì zhè ge bāo guǒ dào jiā ná dà.
dialogue.en: Hello. I'd like to send this package to Canada.

dialogue.speaker: Teller
dialogue.zh: 好的。裡面裝的是什麼？有違禁品嗎？
dialogue.py: hǎo de. lǐ miàn zhuāng de shì shén me? yǒu wéi jìn pǐn ma?
dialogue.en: Okay. What's inside? Are there any prohibited items?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 裡面是一些衣服和幾本中文書。沒有違禁品。
dialogue.py: lǐ miàn shì yī xiē yī fu hé jǐ běn zhōng wén shū. méi yǒu wéi jìn pǐn.
dialogue.en: Inside are some clothes and a few Chinese books. No prohibited items.

dialogue.speaker: Teller
dialogue.zh: 請把包裹放在秤上，我稱一下重量... 二點五公斤。
dialogue.py: qǐng bǎ bāo guǒ fàng zài chèng shàng, wǒ chēng yī xià zhòng liàng... èr diǎn wǔ gōng jīn.
dialogue.en: Please put the package on the scale; let me weigh it... 2.5 kilograms.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 請問寄到加拿大大概要多久？
dialogue.py: qǐng wèn jì dào jiā ná dà dà gài yào duō jiǔ?
dialogue.en: Excuse me, roughly how long will it take to send to Canada?

dialogue.speaker: Teller
dialogue.zh: 快遞大概一週能到。普通空運大約需要兩到三週。
dialogue.py: kuài dì dà gài yī zhōu néng dào. pǔ tōng kōng yùn dà yuē xū yào liǎng dào sān zhōu.
dialogue.en: Express can arrive in about a week. Regular airmail takes about two to three weeks.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 價格差多少？
dialogue.py: jià gé chà duō shǎo?
dialogue.en: How much is the price difference?

dialogue.speaker: Teller
dialogue.zh: 快遞是一千二百塊，普通空運是八百塊。
dialogue.py: kuài dì shì yī qiān èr bǎi kuài, pǔ tōng kōng yùn shì bā bǎi kuài.
dialogue.en: Express is 1200 dollars, regular airmail is 800 dollars.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 那寄普通的吧，我不急。地址寫在這裡嗎？
dialogue.py: nà jì pǔ tōng de ba, wǒ bù jí. dì zhǐ xiě zài zhè lǐ ma?
dialogue.en: Then send it regular; I'm not in a hurry. Do I write the address here?

dialogue.speaker: Teller
dialogue.zh: 對。請用正楷寫清楚收件人的姓名、地址和電話。
dialogue.py: duì. qǐng yòng zhèng kǎi xiě qīng chu shōu jiàn rén de xìng míng, dì zhǐ hé diàn huà.
dialogue.en: Yes. Please write the recipient's name, address, and phone number clearly in block letters.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 寫好了。還需要買郵票嗎？
dialogue.py: xiě hǎo le. hái xū yào mǎi yóu piào ma?
dialogue.en: Written. Do I still need to buy stamps?

dialogue.speaker: Teller
dialogue.zh: 不用。運費已經包含了。這是您的收據，請收好。
dialogue.py: bù yòng. yùn fèi yǐ jīng bāo hán le. zhè shì nín de shōu jù, qǐng shōu hǎo.
dialogue.en: No. The shipping fee already includes them. Here is your receipt; please keep it.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，辛苦了。再見！
dialogue.py: xiè xie, xīn kǔ le. zài jiàn!
dialogue.en: Thanks; thanks for your hard work. Goodbye!

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B

title: Receiving a Package
story_description: 馬克訂的包裹到了，但他人不在家。快遞員打電話跟他商量送貨方式。
story_intro: 馬克在幾天前網購了一些東西。
今天包裹送到了。
快遞員來到馬克宿舍門口。
馬克正在圖書館學習。
他們通過電話溝通如何簽收包裹。

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 喂，請問是哪位？
dialogue.py: wéi, qǐng wèn shì nǎ wèi?
dialogue.en: Hello, who is this?

dialogue.speaker: Courier
dialogue.zh: 你好，我是順豐快遞。你有一件包裹到了，我現在在你宿舍門口。
dialogue.py: nǐ hǎo, wǒ shì shùn fēng kuài dì. nǐ yǒu yī jiàn bāo guǒ dào le, wǒ xiàn zài zài nǐ sù shè mén kǒu.
dialogue.en: Hello, I'm from SF Express. You have a package; I'm at your dorm entrance now.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 啊，不好意思。我現在在圖書館，不在宿舍。
dialogue.py: ā, bù hǎo yì si. wǒ xiàn zài zài tú shū guǎn, bù zài sù shè.
dialogue.en: Ah, I'm sorry. I'm at the library now, not at the dorm.

dialogue.speaker: Courier
dialogue.zh: 那這件包裹需要本人簽收嗎？還是我可以放門口？
dialogue.py: nà zhè jiàn bāo guǒ xū yào běn rén qiān shōu ma? hái shì wǒ kě yǐ fàng mén kǒu?
dialogue.en: Does this package need to be signed for in person? Or can I leave it at the door?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 裡面是電子產品，比較貴。請不要放門口，我怕丟了。
dialogue.py: lǐ miàn shì diàn zǐ chǎn pǐn, bǐ jiào guì. qǐng bù yào fàng mén kǒu, wǒ pà diū le.
dialogue.en: Inside are electronic products, quite expensive. Please don't leave it at the door; I'm afraid it might get lost.

dialogue.speaker: Courier
dialogue.zh: 明白了。那我可以放在宿舍管理處嗎？那裡有人幫忙收包裹嗎？
dialogue.py: míng bai le. nà wǒ kě yǐ fàng zài sù shè guǎn lǐ chù ma? nà lǐ yǒu rén bāng māng shōu bāo guǒ ma?
dialogue.en: Understood. Then can I leave it at the dorm management office? Is there someone there to help receive packages?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 有。請你把它交給管理處的王先生，我待會兒回去領。
dialogue.py: yǒu. qǐng nǐ bǎ tā jiāo gěi guǎn lǐ chù de wáng xiān sheng, wǒ dāi huì r huí qù lǐng.
dialogue.en: Yes. Please hand it to Mr. Wang at the management office; I'll go back to pick it up in a bit.

dialogue.speaker: Courier
dialogue.zh: 好的。我現在就送過去。需要我拍張照片發給你嗎？
dialogue.py: hǎo de. wǒ xiàn zài jiù sòng guò qù. xū yào wǒ pāi zhāng zhào piàn fā gěi nǐ ma?
dialogue.en: Okay. I'll send it over right now. Do you need me to take a photo and send it to you?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 如果方便的話，請發一張給我。謝謝你，辛苦了！
dialogue.py: rú guǒ fāng biàn de huà, qǐng fā yī zhāng gěi wǒ. xiè xie nǐ, xīn kǔ le!
dialogue.en: If it's convenient, please send one to me. Thank you; thanks for your hard work!

dialogue.speaker: Courier
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，一會兒見。再見。

passage.title: Receiving a Package Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克在幾天前網購了一些東西。今天包裹送到了。快遞員來到馬克宿舍門口。馬克正在圖書館學習。他們通過電話溝通如何簽收包裹。
passage.en: Hello, who is this? Hello, I'm from SF Express. You have a package; I'm at your dorm entrance now. Ah, I'm sorry. I'm at the library now, not at the dorm. Does this package need to be signed for in person? Or can I leave it at the door? Inside are electronic products, quite expensive. Please don't leave it at the door; I'm afraid it might get lost. Understood. Then can I leave it at the dorm management office? Is there someone there to help receive packages?

title: Buying a Gift
story_description: 馬克的朋友大衛要過生日了。馬克去商場挑選一份特別的禮物。
story_intro: 大衛的生日快到了。
馬克想買一個他喜歡的東西。
馬克在百貨公司逛了很久。
他不知道選耳機還是運動手錶。
他向店員詢問這兩樣東西的優缺點。

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 你好。我想買一份生日禮物送給朋友。你有什麼推薦嗎？
dialogue.py: nǐ hǎo. wǒ xiǎng mǎi yī fèn shēng rì lǐ wù sòng gěi péng you. nǐ yǒu shén me tuī jiàn ma?
dialogue.en: Hello. I'd like to buy a birthday gift for a friend. Do you have any recommendations?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 好的。請問您的朋友是男生還是女生？他有什麼愛好？
dialogue.py: hǎo de. qǐng wèn nín de péng you shì nán shēng hái shì nǚ shēng? tā yǒu shén me ài hào?
dialogue.en: Okay. Is your friend male or female? What are his hobbies?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 是個男生。他很喜歡聽音樂，也喜歡戶外運動。
dialogue.py: shì gè nán shēng. tā hěn xǐ huan tīng yīn yuè, yě xǐ huan hù wài yùn dòng.
dialogue.en: He's male. He really likes listening to music and also likes outdoor sports.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 那我推薦您看看這款無線降噪耳機，或者這款智能運動手錶。
dialogue.py: nà wǒ tuī jiàn nín kàn kàn zhè kuǎn wú xiàn jiàng zào ěr jī, huò zhě zhè kuǎn zhì néng yùn dòng shǒu biǎo.
dialogue.en: Then I recommend you look at these wireless noise-canceling headphones, or this smart sports watch.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 耳機的音質怎麼樣？電池耐用嗎？
dialogue.py: ěr jī de yīn zhì zěn me yàng? diàn chí nài yòng ma?
dialogue.en: How is the sound quality of the headphones? Is the battery durable?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 音質非常好，充電一次可以聽三十個小時。而且它是防水的。
dialogue.py: yīn zhì fēi cháng hǎo, chōng diàn yī cì kě yǐ tīng sān shí gè xiǎo shí. ér qiě tā shì fáng shuǐ de.
dialogue.en: The sound quality is excellent; one charge allows 30 hours of listening. And it's waterproof.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 那運動手錶呢？有什麼特別的功能？
dialogue.py: nà yùn dòng shǒu biǎo ne? yǒu shén me tè bié de gōng néng?
dialogue.en: What about the sports watch? What special functions does it have?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 它可以記錄心率和步數，還有GPS導航功能，非常適合戶外運動。
dialogue.py: tā kě yǐ jì lù xīn lǜ hé bù shù, hái yǒu GPS dǎo háng gōng néng, fēi cháng shì hé hù wài yùn dòng.
dialogue.en: It can record heart rate and steps; it also has GPS navigation, which is very suitable for outdoor sports.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 兩樣東西看起來都很棒。價格是多少？
dialogue.py: liǎng yàng dōng xi kàn qǐ lái dōu hěn bàng. jià gé shì duō shǎo?
dialogue.en: Both things look great. What are the prices?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 耳機是三千六百塊，手錶現在特價五千塊。
dialogue.py: ěr jī shì sān qiān liù bǎi kuài, shǒu biǎo xiàn zài tè jià wǔ qiān kuài.
dialogue.en: Headphones are 3600; the watch is currently on special for 5000 dollars.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 嗯...我想大衛可能更需要耳機。我要這款黑色的耳機。
dialogue.py: en... wǒ xiǎng dà wèi kě néng gèng xū yào ěr jī. wǒ yào zhè kuǎn hēi sè de ěr jī.
dialogue.en: Hmm... I think David might need the headphones more. I'll take this black pair of headphones.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 好的。需要幫您包裝成禮物嗎？
dialogue.py: hǎo de. xū yào bāng nín bāo zhuāng chéng lǐ wù ma?
dialogue.en: Okay. Do you need help wrapping it as a gift?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 需要的，麻煩你了。
dialogue.py: xū yào de, má fan nǐ le.
dialogue.en: Yes, please; sorry to trouble you.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。請跟我來結帳。
dialogue.py: méi wèn tí. qǐng gēn wǒ lái jié zhàng.
dialogue.en: No problem. Please follow me to pay.

title: Returning an Item
story_description: 馬克買的襯衫尺寸不合適，他回到商店請求退貨或者換貨。
story_intro: 馬克昨天買了一件襯衫。
回家試穿後發現太大了。
他帶著收據回到了商店。
他向店員解釋情況並希望更換尺寸。
他們練習退換貨的禮貌表達。

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 您好！有什麼可以幫您的嗎？
dialogue.py: nín hǎo! yǒu shén me kě yǐ bāng nín de ma?
dialogue.en: Hello! How can I help you?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 你好。我昨天在這裡買了這件襯衫，但是回家試穿後發現尺寸不合適。
dialogue.py: nǐ hǎo. wǒ zuó tiān zài zhè lǐ mǎi le zhè jiàn chèn shān, dàn shì huí jiā shì chuān hòu fā xiàn chǐ cùn bù hé shì.
dialogue.en: Hello. I bought this shirt here yesterday, but after trying it on at home, I found the size isn't right.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 是太大了還是太小了？
dialogue.py: shì tài dà le hái shì tài xiǎo le?
dialogue.en: Is it too big or too small?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 太大了。我覺得我需要中號的，這件是大號。
dialogue.py: tài dà le. wǒ jué de wǒ xū yào zhōng hào de, zhè jiàn shì dà hào.
dialogue.en: Too big. I think I need a medium; this one is a large.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 好的。您帶收據了嗎？我們換貨需要看收據。
dialogue.py: hǎo de. nín dài shōu jù le ma? wǒ men huàn huò xū yào kàn shōu jù.
dialogue.en: Okay. Did you bring the receipt? We need to see the receipt for an exchange.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 帶了，在這裡。還有標籤我也沒剪掉。
dialogue.py: dài le, zài zhè lǐ. hái yǒu biāo qiān wǒ yě méi jiǎn diào.
dialogue.en: Brought it; here it is. Also, I haven't cut off the tag.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 非常好。標籤沒剪的話，七天內都可以換。我查一下庫存。
dialogue.py: fēi cháng hǎo. biāo qiān méi jiǎn de huà, qī tiān nèi dōu kě yǐ huàn. wǒ chá yī xià kù cún.
dialogue.en: Excellent. If the tag isn't cut, you can exchange it within seven days. Let me check the stock.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: （查電腦）抱歉，中號的這款剛好賣完了。你要換別的顏色嗎？
dialogue.py: (chá diàn nǎo) bào qiàn, zhōng hào de zhè kuǎn gāng hǎo mài wán le. nǐ yào huàn bié de yán sè ma?
dialogue.en: (Checking computer) Sorry, the medium for this model just sold out. Do you want to change to another color?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我不喜歡別的顏色。那可以退貨嗎？
dialogue.py: wǒ bù xǐ huan bié de yán sè. nà kě yǐ tuì huò ma?
dialogue.en: I don't like other colors. Then can I return it?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 可以退貨。我們會按照原來的支付方式退款給您。
dialogue.py: kě yǐ tuì huò. wǒ men huì àn zhào yuán lái de zhī fù fāng shì tuì kuǎn gěi nín.
dialogue.en: It can be returned. We will refund you according to the original payment method.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我是用信用卡付的。
dialogue.py: wǒ shì yòng xìn yòng kǎ fù de.
dialogue.en: I paid with a credit card.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 好的，請在這裡簽個名。退款大約在三個工作日後到帳。
dialogue.py: hǎo de, qǐng zài zhè lǐ qiān gè míng. tuì kuǎn dà yuē zài sān gè gōng zuò rì hòu dào zhàng.
dialogue.en: Okay; please sign here. The refund will arrive in your account in about three working days.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好的，謝謝。辛苦了。
dialogue.py: hǎo de, xiè xie. xīn kǔ le.
dialogue.en: Okay, thanks. Thanks for your work.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 不客氣。歡迎下次再來。
dialogue.py: bù kè qì. huān yíng xià cì zài lái.
dialogue.en: You're welcome. Welcome back next time.

expansion_dialogue.en: There are still white ones; I'll go get them for you now.

title: The Product Is Broken
story_description: 馬克新買的耳機有雜音，他去維修中心反映問題並要求修理。
story_intro: 馬克買耳機才一週。
他發現耳機的左邊沒有聲音。
而且聽音樂時有很大的雜音。
他來到售後服務中心。
他向技術員描述了耳機的故障。

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.zh: 您好！請問您的電子設備出了什麼問題？
dialogue.py: nín hǎo! qǐng wèn nín de diàn zǐ shè bèi chū le shén me wèn tí?
dialogue.en: Hello! What is the problem with your electronic device?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 你好。我上週剛買的耳機好像壞了。左邊聽不到聲音。
dialogue.py: nǐ hǎo. wǒ shàng zhōu gāng mǎi de ěr jī hǎo xiàng huài le. zuǒ biān tīng bù dào shēng yīn.
dialogue.en: Hello. The headphones I just bought last week seem broken. I can't hear any sound on the left side.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.zh: 除了聽不到聲音，還有別的故障嗎？
dialogue.py: chú le tīng bù dào shēng yīn, hái yǒu bié de gù zhàng ma?
dialogue.en: Besides not being able to hear sound, are there any other malfunctions?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 有，右邊的聲音也很小，而且有很大的雜音。
dialogue.py: yǒu, yòu biān de shēng yīn yě hěn xiǎo, ér qiě yǒu hěn dà de zá yīn.
dialogue.en: Yes, the sound on the right is also very quiet, and there is a lot of static/noise.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.zh: 我檢查一下...連接線看起來沒問題。可能是內部的零件壞了。
dialogue.py: wǒ jiǎn chá yī xià... lián jiē xiàn kàn qǐ lái méi wèn tí. kě néng shì nèi bù de líng jiàn huài le.
dialogue.en: Let me check... the connecting cable looks fine. It might be that an internal component is broken.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 那能修好嗎？還在保修期內嗎？
dialogue.py: nà néng xiū hǎo ma? hái zài bǎo xiū qī nèi ma?
dialogue.en: Can it be fixed? Is it still under warranty?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.zh: 耳機的保修期通常是一年。請出示您的保修卡或收據。
dialogue.py: ěr jī de bǎo xiū qī tōng cháng shì yī nián. qǐng chū shì nín de bǎo xiū kǎ huò shōu jù.
dialogue.en: The warranty for headphones is usually one year. Please show your warranty card or receipt.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 都在這裡。這能免費維修嗎？
dialogue.py: dōu zài zhè lǐ. zhè néng miǎn fèi wéi xiū ma?
dialogue.en: They are all here. Can this be fixed for free?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.zh: 如果是質量問題，我們是免費維修的。如果是人為損壞，就需要付費。
dialogue.py: rú guǒ shì zhì liàng wèn tí, wǒ men shì miǎn fèi wéi xiū de. rú guǒ shì rén wéi sǔn huài, jiù xū yào fù fèi.
dialogue.en: If it's a quality issue, we repair it for free. If it's man-made damage, you'll need to pay.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我一直用得很小心，沒有摔過也沒有碰過水。
dialogue.py: wǒ yī zhí yòng de hěn xiǎo xīn, méi yǒu shuāi guò yě méi yǒu pèng guò shuǐ.
dialogue.en: I've always used it carefully; I haven't dropped it or gotten it wet.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.zh: 好的。我們需要留下來檢測一下，大約需要三天時間。
dialogue.py: hǎo de. wǒ men xū yào liú xià lái jiǎn cè yī xià, dà yuē xū yào sān tiān shí jiān.
dialogue.en: Okay. We need to keep it for testing; it will take about three days.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 三天？那我怎麼知道修好了沒？
dialogue.py: sān tiān? nà wǒ zěn me zhī dào xiū hǎo le méi?
dialogue.en: Three days? How will I know if it's fixed?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.zh: 我們會給您打電話或發簡訊。請在這裡填寫您的聯絡信息。
dialogue.py: wǒ men huì gěi nín dǎ diàn huà huò fā jiǎn xùn. qǐng zài zhè lǐ tián xiě nín de lián luò xìn xī.
dialogue.en: We will call you or send a text message. Please fill in your contact info here.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好的，麻煩你了。謝謝。
dialogue.py: hǎo de, má fan nǐ le. xiè xie.
dialogue.en: Okay, thank you for your trouble. Thanks.

key_sentences.en: What's the problem with the device?

speaking.part_b: Role-play: 你買了一台電腦，但是螢幕有黑點。去維修中心找技術員，描述問題並詢問修理需要多久。技術員說需要一週，你覺得太久了。
part_c: 你買電子產品時會看保修期嗎？
你覺得產品質量重要還是價格重要？

grammar.explanation: 使用 '好像' 表推測。使用 'V + 不到' 表無法達到目的。'如果...就...' 的條件句。
examples: 他好像不高興。 (He seems unhappy.)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 我的筆記型電腦開不了機了，怎麼辦？
expansion_dialogue.py: wǒ de bǐ jì xíng diàn nǎo kāi bù liǎo jī le, zěn me bàn?
expansion_dialogue.en: My laptop won't turn on; what should I do?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 你有沒有檢查過電源線？
expansion_dialogue.py: nǐ yǒu méi yǒu jiǎn chá guò diàn yuán xiàn?
expansion_dialogue.en: Have you checked the power cord?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 檢查過了，電是滿的。可能真的是主板壞了。
expansion_dialogue.py: jiǎn chá guò le, diàn shì mǎn de. kě néng zhēn de shì zhǔ bǎn huài le.
expansion_dialogue.en: Checked it; the power is full. It might really be the motherboard that's broken.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 那你快去品牌售後點看看吧，別耽誤了工作。
expansion_dialogue.py: nà nǐ kuài qù pǐn pái shòu hòu diǎn kàn kàn ba, bié dān wù le gōng zuò.
expansion_dialogue.en: Then hurry to the brand's after-sales point and take a look; don't let it delay your work.

title: At the Market
story_description: 馬克去傳統市場買菜。他比較了不同攤位的價格和質量，並嘗試講價。
story_intro: 今天是週末。
馬克想自己動手做頓飯。
他來到熱鬧的傳統市場。
他想買一些新鮮的蔬菜和肉類。
他在不同的攤位之間走動，尋找最好的產品。

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 老闆，這青菜怎麼賣？新鮮嗎？
dialogue.py: lǎo bǎn, zhè qīng cài zěn me mài? xīn xiān ma?
dialogue.en: Boss, how do you sell these greens? Are they fresh?

dialogue.speaker: A (Seller)
dialogue.zh: 一斤二十五，三斤五十。都是今天早上剛採的，非常嫩。
dialogue.py: yī jīn èr shí wǔ, sān jīn wǔ shí. dōu shì jīn tiān zǎo shang gāng cǎi de, fēi cháng nèn.
dialogue.en: 25 for one jin, 50 for three. They were all just picked this morning; very tender.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 那給我拿三斤吧。還有那邊的西紅柿呢？
dialogue.py: nà gěi wǒ ná sān jīn ba. hái yǒu nà biān de xī hóng shì ne?
dialogue.en: Then give me three jin. What about the tomatoes over there?

dialogue.speaker: A (Seller)
dialogue.zh: 西紅柿一斤三十，很甜。
dialogue.py: xī hóng shì yī jīn sān shí, hěn tián.
dialogue.en: Tomatoes are 30 per jin; very sweet.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 對面的攤位好像只要二十五。你的有點兒貴啊。
dialogue.py: duì miàn de tān wèi hǎo xiàng zhǐ yào èr shí wǔ. nǐ de yǒu diǎn r guì a.
dialogue.en: The stall opposite only wants 25, it seems. Yours is a bit expensive.

dialogue.speaker: A (Seller)
dialogue.zh: 馬克，你看看我的西紅柿，個頭大，顏色紅。質量肯定比那邊的好。
dialogue.py: mǎ kè, nǐ kàn kàn wǒ de xī hóng shì, gè tóu dà, yán sè hóng. zhì liàng kěn dìng bǐ nà biān de hǎo.
dialogue.en: Mark, look at my tomatoes: big size, red color. The quality is definitely better than those over there.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好吧。買兩斤西紅柿。能送我幾根蔥嗎？
dialogue.py: hǎo ba. mǎi liǎng jīn xī hóng shì. néng sòng wǒ jǐ gēn cōng ma?
dialogue.en: Okay then. Buying two jin of tomatoes. Can you give me a few sprigs of green onion for free?

dialogue.speaker: A (Seller)
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，送你一把蔥。一共八十塊。
dialogue.py: méi wèn tí, sòng nǐ yī bǎ cōng. yī gòng bā shí kuài.
dialogue.en: No problem; giving you a bunch of green onions. Total is 80 dollars.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: （走到肉攤）老闆，這豬肉新鮮嗎？我要瘦一點兒的。
dialogue.py: (zǒu dào ròu tān) lǎo bǎn, zhè zhū ròu xīn xiān ma? wǒ yào shòu yī diǎn r de.
dialogue.en: (Walking to meat stall) Boss, is this pork fresh? I want a leaner cut.

dialogue.speaker: B (Butcher)
dialogue.zh: 絕對新鮮！你要哪一部分？這是排骨，這是里脊肉。
dialogue.py: jué duì xīn xiān! nǐ yào nǎ yī bù fèn? zhè shì pái gǔ, zhè shì lǐ ji ròu.
dialogue.en: Absolutely fresh! Which part do you want? This is ribs, and this is tenderloin.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我要一斤里脊肉。多少錢？
dialogue.py: wǒ yào yī jīn lǐ ji ròu. duō shǎo qián?
dialogue.en: I want one jin of tenderloin. How much?

dialogue.speaker: B (Butcher)
dialogue.zh: 一百八十塊。我幫你切好嗎？
dialogue.py: yī bǎi bā shí kuài. wǒ bāng nǐ qiě hǎo ma?
dialogue.en: 180 dollars. Shall I cut it for you?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好，麻煩切成絲。謝謝。
dialogue.py: hǎo, má fan qiě chéng sī. xiè xie.
dialogue.en: Yes, please shred it (cut into strips). Thanks.

dialogue.speaker: B (Butcher)
dialogue.zh: 好了，給您。慢走！
dialogue.py: hǎo le, gěi nín. màn zǒu!
dialogue.en: Finished, here you go. Take care!

key_sentences.en: Can you give me onions for free?
I want something a bit leaner.

speaking.part_b: Role-play: 你在市場買蘋果。老闆說一斤五十。你說太貴了，能不能便宜一點。老闆說買三斤算你一百二十。你同意了並請老闆拿個袋子。
part_c: 你喜歡去超市還是傳統市場？為什麼？
你覺得講價難不難？

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A

expansion_dialogue.py: nà tiáo dà de. bāng wǒ bǎ yú lín guā gān jìng, xiè xie.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B

expansion_dialogue.py: méi wèn tí, yī huì r jiù hǎo.

title: Cooking with a Friend
story_description: 馬克和大衛在宿舍一起做飯。他們分工合作，準備做一道美味的中國菜。
story_intro: 馬克從市場買了食材回來。
大衛來幫他一起做飯。
他們準備做'青椒肉絲'。
他們談到了切菜、炒菜和調味的步驟。
他們享受共同勞動的樂趣。

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 大衛，食材都買齊了。我們開始做飯吧！
dialogue.py: dà wèi, shí cái dōu mǎi qí le. wǒ men kāi shǐ zuò fàn ba!
dialogue.en: David, all the ingredients are bought. Let's start cooking!

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 太好了！今天做什麼菜？
dialogue.py: tài hǎo le! jīn tiān zuò shén me cài?
dialogue.en: Great! What dish are we making today?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我們做青椒肉絲，這道菜很下飯。
dialogue.py: wǒ men zuò qīng jiāo ròu sī, zhè dào cài hěn xià fàn.
dialogue.en: We're making shredded pork with green peppers; this dish goes great with rice.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 好。我來幫你切青椒吧，我切菜還不錯。
dialogue.py: hǎo. wǒ lái bāng nǐ qiě qīng jiāo ba, wǒ qiě cài hái bù cuò.
dialogue.en: Okay. I'll help you cut the peppers; my chopping isn't bad.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。我已經請肉攤的老闆把里脊肉切成絲了，現在只要醃一下就好。
dialogue.py: méi wèn tí. wǒ yǐ jīng qǐng ròu tān de lǎo bǎn bǎ lǐ ji ròu qiě chéng sī le, xiàn zài zhǐ yào yān yī xià jiù hǎo.
dialogue.en: No problem. I've already asked the butcher to shred the tenderloin; now I just need to marinate it a bit.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 醃肉要放什麼調料？
dialogue.py: yān ròu yào fàng shén me tiáo liào?
dialogue.en: What seasonings do we put in to marinate the meat?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 放點生抽、料酒，還有一點點澱粉。這樣肉質會更嫩。
dialogue.py: fàng diǎn shēng chōu, liào jiǔ, hái yǒu yī diǎn diǎn diàn fěn. zhè yàng ròu zhì huì gèng nèn.
dialogue.en: Put some light soy sauce, cooking wine, and a little bit of starch. This way the meat will be more tender.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 知道了。青椒要切成什麼樣？也是絲嗎？
dialogue.py: zhī dào le. qīng jiāo yào qiě chéng shén me yàng? yě shì sī ma?
dialogue.en: Got it. How should I cut the peppers? Also into strips?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 對，切成細絲。等一下我來掌勺，你幫我準備蔥薑蒜。
dialogue.py: duì, qiě chéng xì sī. děng yī xià wǒ lái zhǎng sháo, nǐ bāng wǒ zhǔn bèi cōng jiāng suàn.
dialogue.en: Yes, cut into fine strips. I'll take charge of the cooking (handle the ladle) in a bit; you help me prepare onion, ginger, and garlic.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。鍋熱了嗎？油煙味好像出來了。
dialogue.py: méi wèn tí. guō rè le ma? yóu yān wèi hǎo xiàng chū lái le.
dialogue.en: No problem. Is the pan hot? Seems like the smell of cooking oil/smoke is coming out.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 熱了。先下肉絲，炒到變色，再放青椒。快去開抽油煙機！
dialogue.py: rè le. xiān xià ròu sī, chǎo dào biàn sè, zài fàng qīng jiāo. kuài qù kāi chōu yóu yān jī!
dialogue.en: Hot now. First put in the shredded pork, stir-fry until it changes color, then add the peppers. Hurry and turn on the range hood!

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 好嘞！這道菜聞起來真香啊。
dialogue.py: hǎo lei! zhè dào cài wén qǐ lái zhēn xiāng a.
dialogue.en: Got it! This dish smells really fragrant.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 大功告成！我們端上桌開飯吧。
dialogue.py: dà gōng gào chéng! wǒ men duān shàng zhuō kāi fàn ba.
dialogue.en: Mission accomplished! Let's bring it to the table and start eating.

key_sentences.en: This dish goes well with rice.
Just marinate it for a bit.
The meat will be more tender.

vocabulary.meaning: to be the chef / take charge of cooking

speaking.part_b: Role-play: 你教朋友做一道簡單的麵條。告訴他先燒水，然後放麵條，最後加調料。朋友問要不要加雞蛋。
part_c: 你喜歡在家做飯嗎？為什麼？
你覺得做飯時最難的步驟是什麼？

comprehension.q: 馬克和大衛今天準備做哪道菜？
大衛主動提出幫馬克做什麼？
馬克用了什麼東西來醃肉，讓肉質更嫩？
炒菜的正確順序是什麼？
options: A. 先下青椒，再下肉絲
B. 先下肉絲，炒到變色再放青椒
C. 同時放下肉絲和青椒

comprehension.q: 大衛聞到菜的味道後說了什麼？

true_false.q: 馬克和大衛在飯店吃飯。
肉絲是馬克自己切的。
青椒要切成塊。
大衛負責準備蔥、薑和蒜。
做完菜後，他們準備端上桌吃飯。

passage.title: Cooking with a Friend Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克從市場買了食材回來。大衛來幫他一起做飯。他們準備做'青椒肉絲'。他們談到了切菜、炒菜和調味的步驟。他們享受共同勞動的樂趣。
passage.en: David, all the ingredients are bought. Let's start cooking! Great! What dish are we making today? We're making shredded pork with green peppers; this dish goes great with rice. Okay. I'll help you cut the peppers; my chopping isn't bad. No problem. I've already asked the butcher to shred the tenderloin; now I just need to marinate it a bit. What seasonings do we put in to marinate the meat?
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: 請寫 3 到 5 句話描述你做一道簡單菜餚或飲品的步驟（例如：泡茶、煮麵、拌沙拉）。請使用 '先...然後...最後...' 的結構。

grammar.explanation: 使用 'V + 齊' 表示備齊或到齊。使用 '...到' 表示動作的程度或結果。使用 'V + 起來' 表示感知 (聞起來、看起來)。
examples: 這花聞起來很香。 (This flower smells fragrant.)

practice.q: Complete: 燒水___開。 (Boil until it opens/boils.)
Complete: 幫我___一下。 (Help me marinate...)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 你會包餃子嗎？我想學。
expansion_dialogue.py: nǐ huì bāo jiǎo zi ma? wǒ xiǎng xué.
expansion_dialogue.en: Do you know how to make dumplings? I want to learn.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 會呀。包餃子不難，就是準備餡兒比較麻煩。
expansion_dialogue.py: huì ya. bāo jiǎo zi bù nán, jiù shì zhǔn bèi xiàn r bǐ jiào má fan.
expansion_dialogue.en: Yes. Making dumplings isn't hard; it's just preparing the filling that's quite troublesome.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 那我們週末一起做吧，我來準備餡兒，你來教我包。
expansion_dialogue.py: nà wǒ men zhōu mò yī qǐ zuò ba, wǒ lái zhǔn bèi xiàn r, nǐ lái jiāo wǒ bāo.
expansion_dialogue.en: Then let's do it together this weekend; I'll prepare the filling, and you teach me how to wrap them.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 一言為定！自家包的餃子最好吃了。
expansion_dialogue.py: yī yán wéi dìng! zì jiā bāo de jiǎo zi zuì hǎo chī le.
expansion_dialogue.en: It's a deal! Homemade dumplings are the most delicious.

title: My Favorite Recipe
story_description: 馬克向朋友介紹他最喜歡的一道家鄉菜的做法：番茄炒蛋。
story_intro: 馬克學會了做幾道中國菜。
他最喜歡的是'番茄炒蛋'。
這道菜既簡單又營養。
他向朋友詳細介紹了食材和步驟。
他們練習給出具體的指令和建議。

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 你知道哪道中國菜最容易學嗎？
dialogue.py: nǐ zhī dào nǎ dào zhōng guó cài zuì róng yì xué ma?
dialogue.en: Do you know which Chinese dish is easiest to learn?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 是番茄炒蛋吧？我常看到有人做。
dialogue.py: shì fān qié chǎo dàn ba? wǒ cháng kàn dào yǒu rén zuò.
dialogue.en: Is it tomato and scrambled eggs? I often see people making it.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 沒錯！這就是我的'拿手好菜'。我教你怎麼做吧。
dialogue.py: méi cuò! zhè jiù shì wǒ de 'ná shǒu hǎo cài'. wǒ jiāo nǐ zěn me zuò ba.
dialogue.en: Exactly! This is my 'signature dish'. Let me teach you how to make it.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 好啊，需要準備什麼食材？
dialogue.py: hǎo a, xū yào zhǔn bèi shén me shí cái?
dialogue.en: Sure, what ingredients do we need to prepare?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 只需要三個雞蛋、兩個番茄，還有一點蔥和蒜。
dialogue.py: zhǐ xū yào sān gè jī dàn, liǎng gè fān qié, hái yǒu yī diǎn cōng hé suàn.
dialogue.en: Just three eggs, two tomatoes, and a little onion and garlic.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 第一步做什麼？
dialogue.py: dì yī bù zuò shén me?
dialogue.en: What's the first step?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 先把雞蛋打在碗裡，攪拌均勻。番茄切成塊。
dialogue.py: xiān bǎ jī dàn dǎ zài wǎn lǐ, jiǎo bàn jūn yún. fān qié qiě chéng kuài.
dialogue.en: First crack the eggs into a bowl and beat them evenly. Cut the tomatoes into chunks.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 然後呢？
dialogue.py: rán hòu ne?
dialogue.en: And then?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 鍋裡放油，先炒雞蛋。雞蛋熟了以後先盛出來。
dialogue.py: guō lǐ fàng yóu, xiān chǎo jī dàn. jī dàn shú le yǐ hòu xiān chéng chū lái.
dialogue.en: Put oil in the pan and fry the eggs first. Once the eggs are cooked, take them out first.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 接下來是炒番茄嗎？
dialogue.py: jiē xià lái shì chǎo fān qié ma?
dialogue.en: Next is stir-frying the tomatoes?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 對。炒番茄的時候加一點兒水和糖，這樣湯汁更多更好喝。
dialogue.py: duì. chǎo fān qié de shí hou jiā yī diǎn r shuǐ hé táng, zhè yàng tāng zhī gèng duō gèng hǎo hē.
dialogue.en: Yes. Add a bit of water and sugar while frying the tomatoes; this way there's more juice and it's tastier.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 最後把雞蛋放回去混在一起？
dialogue.py: zuì hòu bǎ jī dàn fàng huí qù hùn zài yī qǐ?
dialogue.en: Finally put the eggs back in and mix them together?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 沒錯！最後撒上蔥花，這道紅紅黃黃的菜就做好了。
dialogue.py: méi cuò! zuì hòu sā shàng cōng huā, zhè dào hóng hóng huáng huáng de cài jiù zuò hǎo le.
dialogue.en: Correct! Finally sprinkle with chopped green onions, and this red and yellow dish is finished.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 聽起來很簡單，但我總覺得火候很難掌握。
dialogue.py: tīng qǐ lái hěn jiǎn dān, dàn wǒ zǒng jué de huǒ hou hěn nán zhǎng wò.
dialogue.en: It sounds simple, but I always feel the heat control is hard to master.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 多做幾次就有經驗了。下次我帶你實踐一下。
dialogue.py: duō zuò jǐ cì jiù yǒu jīng yàn le. xià cì wǒ dài nǐ shí jiàn yī xià.
dialogue.en: You'll gain experience after doing it a few times. I'll take you to practice next time.

key_sentences.en: Heat control is hard to master.
Do it more to get experience.

vocabulary.example: 紅燒牛肉是他的拿手好菜。

speaking.part_b: Role-play: 教朋友泡一杯完美的茶。告訴他先放茶葉，然後倒熱水，最後等三分鐘。朋友問要不要加奶或糖。

passage.title: My Favorite Recipe Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克學會了做幾道中國菜。他最喜歡的是'番茄炒蛋'。這道菜既簡單又營養。他向朋友詳細介紹了食材和步驟。他們練習給出具體的指令和建議。
passage.en: Do you know which Chinese dish is easiest to learn? Is it tomato and scrambled eggs? I often see people making it. Exactly! This is my 'signature dish'. Let me teach you how to make it. Sure, what ingredients do we need to prepare? Just three eggs, two tomatoes, and a little onion and garlic. What's the first step?
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: 請寫下你最擅長做的一道菜的名稱和主要食材，並簡單描述它的特色（40 到 60 個字）。

grammar.explanation: 使用 '...吧' 表示提議。數量短語 '三個雞蛋'。'V + 成' 表示轉換 (切成塊)。
examples: 我們去吃飯吧。 (Let's go eat.)
打在碗裡 (Crack into the bowl)

practice.q: Translate: Cut the apple into pieces.
Complete: 湯汁___好喝。 (Juice even tastier.)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 這米飯太硬了，是不是水放少了？
expansion_dialogue.py: zhè mǐ fàn tài yìng le, shì bù shì shuǐ fàng shǎo le?
expansion_dialogue.en: This rice is too hard; did we not put enough water?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 可能是。我剛學用電飯煲，不太熟練。
expansion_dialogue.py: kě néng shì. wǒ gāng xué yòng diàn fàn bǎo, bù tài shú liàn.
expansion_dialogue.en: Maybe. I just learned how to use the rice cooker; I'm not very skilled.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 沒關係，下次多加一點點水，煮出來就軟了。
expansion_dialogue.py: méi guān xi, xià cì duō jiā yī diǎn diǎn shuǐ, zhǔ chū lái jiù ruǎn le.
expansion_dialogue.en: No problem; add a little bit more water next time, and it will be soft when cooked.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 好的，我記住了。火候和水量真的很重要。
expansion_dialogue.py: hǎo de, wǒ jì zhù le. huǒ hou hé shuǐ liàng zhēn de hěn zhòng yào.
expansion_dialogue.en: Okay, I've noted it down. Heat and water volume are really important.

title: Eating at a Friend’s Home
story_description: 馬克受邀去大衛家吃晚飯。他帶了小禮物，並在那裡度過了一個愉快的夜晚。
story_intro: 大衛邀請馬克去他家玩。
馬克買了一盒點心作為禮物。
大衛的家人熱情地歡迎他。
馬克稱讚了大衛家人的廚藝。
他們練習做客時的禮貌用語。

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: （按門鈴）大衛，你好！我來了。
dialogue.py: (àn mén líng) dà wèi, nǐ hǎo! wǒ lái le.
dialogue.en: (Pressing doorbell) David, hello! I'm here.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 快請進！歡迎歡迎。這是我爸爸和媽媽。
dialogue.py: kuài qǐng jìn! huān yíng huān yíng. zhè shì wǒ bà ba hé mā ma.
dialogue.en: Quick, please come in! Welcome, welcome. This is my dad and mom.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 叔叔、阿姨，您們好！這是我的一點兒小意思，請收下。
dialogue.py: shū shu, ā yí, nín men hǎo! zhè shì wǒ de yī diǎn r xiǎo yì si, qǐng shōu xià.
dialogue.en: Uncle, Auntie, hello! This is a little something from me; please accept it.

dialogue.speaker: Mom
dialogue.zh: 哎呀，來就來吧，還帶什麼禮物呀！太客氣了。
dialogue.py: āi yā, lái jiù lái ba, hái dài shén me lǐ wù ya! tài kè qì le.
dialogue.en: Oh, just coming is fine; why bring a gift! You're too kind.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 這是一盒當地的特色點心，希望您們喜歡。
dialogue.py: zhè shì yī hé dāng dì de tè sè diǎn xīn, xī wàng nín men xǐ huan.
dialogue.en: It's a box of local specialty snacks; I hope you'll like them.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。你先在客廳坐一會兒，晚飯馬上就好。
dialogue.py: xiè xie. nǐ xiān zài kè tīng zuò yī huì r, wǎn fàn mǎ shàng jiù hǎo.
dialogue.en: Thanks. Sit in the living room for a bit; dinner will be ready shortly.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: （晚飯桌上）哇，這桌菜看起來太豐富了！聞起來也真香。
dialogue.py: (wǎn fàn zhuō shàng) wa, zhè zhuō cài kàn qǐ lái tài fēng fù le! wén qǐ lái yě zhēn xiāng.
dialogue.en: (At the dinner table) Wow, this spread looks so abundant! It smells really fragrant too.

dialogue.speaker: Mom
dialogue.zh: 沒什麼好菜，都是些家常便飯。馬克，多吃點兒。
dialogue.py: méi shén me hǎo cài, dōu shì xiē jiā cháng biàn fàn. mǎ kè, duō chī diǎn r.
dialogue.en: Nothing special; just home-cooked meals. Mark, eat more.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: （嚐了一口）這道魚做得太鮮美了！阿姨，您的廚藝真棒。
dialogue.py: (cháng le yī kǒu) zhè dào yú zuò de tài xiān měi le! ā yí, nín de chú yì zhēn bàng.
dialogue.en: (Tries a bite) This fish is made so deliciously! Auntie, your cooking skills are excellent.

dialogue.speaker: Mom
dialogue.zh: 喜歡就多吃點。別客氣，就當在自己家一樣。
dialogue.py: xǐ huan jiù duō chī diǎn. bié kè qì, jiù dāng zài zì jǐ jiā yī yàng.
dialogue.en: If you like it, eat more. Don't be polite; just act as if you're in your own home.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好的，謝謝。這頓飯我吃得太開心了。
dialogue.py: hǎo de, xiè xie. zhè dùn fàn wǒ chī de tài kāi xīn le.
dialogue.en: Okay, thanks. I'm so happy eating this meal.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 吃完飯我們去露台坐坐，喝杯茶。
dialogue.py: chī wán fàn wǒ men qù lù tái zuò zuo, hē bēi chá.
dialogue.en: Let's go sit on the balcony after eating and have a cup of tea.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好主意，我很期待。
dialogue.py: hǎo zhǔ yì, wǒ hěn qī dài.
dialogue.en: Good idea; I'm looking forward to it.

key_sentences.en: This is a little something (modest gift expression).
Just act as if you're at your own home.

vocabulary.example: 對他來說，熬夜是家常便飯。
她的廚藝在朋友中很有名。

vocabulary.meaning: to act as / treat as / when

大衛的媽媽對馬克送禮物的行為說了什麼？
馬克是怎麼稱讚晚餐的？
options: A. 很豐富、聞起來很香

comprehension.q: 大衛家人的廚藝怎麼樣？
飯後大衛打算帶馬克去哪裡喝茶？

true_false.q: 馬克在大衛家門口按了門鈴。
大衛的媽媽覺得馬克應該帶更貴的禮物。
馬克覺得那道魚做得很鮮美。

passage.title: Eating at a Friend’s Home Listening Passage
passage.zh: 大衛邀請馬克去他家玩。馬克買了一盒點心作為禮物。大衛的家人熱情地歡迎他。馬克稱讚了大衛家人的廚藝。他們練習做客時的禮貌用語。
passage.en: (Pressing doorbell) David, hello! I'm here. Quick, please come in! Welcome, welcome. This is my dad and mom. Uncle, Auntie, hello! This is a little something from me; please accept it. Oh, just coming is fine; why bring a gift! You're too kind. It's a box of local specialty snacks; I hope you'll like them. Thanks. Sit in the living room for a bit; dinner will be ready shortly.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: 請寫一封簡短的感謝信給邀請你吃晚飯的朋友及其家人。稱讚他們的款待和食物（40 到 60 個字）。

grammar.explanation: 謙辭 '小意思'。'就當...' 的比喻結構。'得' 補語表程度 (吃得開心)。
examples: 小意思，別客氣。 (A small thing, don't be polite.)
就把我當你哥哥。 (Just treat me as your brother.)

title: Family Dinner Conversation
story_description: 大衛一家人在吃晚飯。他們邊吃邊聊今天發生了什麼，分享彼此的心情。
story_intro: 全家人圍坐在餐桌旁。
大衛的爸爸剛下班回來。
大衛的媽媽做好了豐盛的晚餐。
大衛和妹妹在聊學校的事情。
他們練習在家庭環境中分享日常經歷。

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.zh: 今天這頓飯真香！老婆，辛苦了。
dialogue.py: jīn tiān zhè dùn fàn zhēn xiāng! lǎo po, xīn kǔ le.
dialogue.en: This meal smells so good today! Wife, thanks for your hard work.

dialogue.speaker: Mom
dialogue.zh: 不辛苦。大衛，小麗，你們今天在學校怎麼樣？
dialogue.py: bù xīn kǔ. dà wèi, xiǎo lì, nǐ men jīn tiān zài xué xiào zěn me yàng?
dialogue.en: Not hard at all. David, Xiaoli, how was school for you two today?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 還不錯。我今天在中文課上學了幾個新成語。
dialogue.py: hái bù cuò. wǒ jīn tiān zài zhōng wén kè shàng xué le jǐ gè xīn chéng yǔ.
dialogue.en: Not bad. I learned a few new idioms in Chinese class today.

dialogue.speaker: Mom
dialogue.zh: 是嗎？說來聽聽。
dialogue.py: shì ma? shuō lái tīng tīng.
dialogue.en: Really? Tell us about them.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 比如'大功告成'和'一言為定'。我覺得很有意思。
dialogue.py: bǐ rú 'dà gōng gào chéng' hé 'yī yán wéi dìng'. wǒ jué de hěn yǒu yì si.
dialogue.en: For example, 'Mission Accomplished' and 'It's a Deal'. I find them very interesting.

dialogue.speaker: Sister (Lili)
dialogue.zh: 我也學了新東西！我今天在體育課上學會了打排球。
dialogue.py: wǒ yě xué le xīn dōng xi! wǒ jīn tiān zài tǐ yù kè shàng xué huì le dǎ pái qiú.
dialogue.en: I learned something new too! I learned how to play volleyball in PE class today.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.zh: 小麗真棒！那打得累不累？
dialogue.py: xiǎo lì zhēn bàng! nà dǎ de lèi bù lèi?
dialogue.en: Xiaoli, you're great! Was it tiring playing?

dialogue.speaker: Sister (Lili)
dialogue.zh: 有一點兒累，但是跟同學一起玩很開心。
dialogue.py: yǒu yī diǎn r lèi, dàn shì gēn tóng xué yī qǐ wán hěn kāi xīn.
dialogue.en: A little bit, but playing together with classmates was very fun.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.zh: 我今天公司也很忙，開了一整天的會。
dialogue.py: wǒ jīn tiān gōng sī yě hěn máng, kāi le yī zhěng tiān de huì.
dialogue.en: I was very busy at the company today too; I was in meetings all day long.

dialogue.speaker: Mom
dialogue.zh: 難怪你回來這麼晚。快多吃點肉補補體力。
dialogue.py: nán guài nǐ huí lái zhè me wǎn. kuài duō chī diǎn r ròu bǔ bu tǐ lì.
dialogue.en: No wonder you came back so late. Eat more meat to regain some strength.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 對了，馬克剛才給我發訊息，說他今天去領那個很貴的包裹了。
dialogue.py: duì le, mǎ kè gāng cái gěi wǒ fā xùn xī, shuō tā jīn tiān qù lǐng nà gè hěn guì de bāo guǒ le.
dialogue.en: By the way, Mark just sent me a message saying he went to pick up that expensive package today.

dialogue.speaker: Mom
dialogue.zh: 就是上次那個電子產品嗎？
dialogue.py: jiù shì shàng cì nà gè diàn zǐ chǎn pǐn ma?
dialogue.en: Is it those electronic products from last time?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 對。他還說週末想請我們去他新家參觀呢。
dialogue.py: duì. tā hái shuō zhōu mò xiǎng qǐng wǒ men qù tā xīn jiā cān guān ne.
dialogue.en: Yes. He also said he wants to invite us to visit his new home this weekend.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.zh: 好啊，週末大家放鬆放鬆也挺好。
dialogue.py: hǎo a, zhōu mò dà jiā fàng sōng fàng sōng yě tǐng hǎo.
dialogue.en: Sure; it's also good for everyone to relax a bit on the weekend.

title: Helping at Home
story_description: 大衛家裡要來客人了。全家人一起幫忙做家務，分工明確。
story_intro: 今天晚上大衛家有客人。
全家人都在忙著打掃衛生。
大衛負責擦桌子和倒垃圾。
妹妹在收拾客廳的雜物。
他們練習分配任務和表達必須完成的事情。

dialogue.speaker: Mom
dialogue.zh: 大衛，小麗，今晚叔叔阿姨要來家裡吃飯。我們得快點兒打掃一下。
dialogue.py: dà wèi, xiǎo lì, jīn wǎn shū shu ā yí yào lái jiā lǐ chī fàn. wǒ men děi kuài diǎn r dǎ sǎo yī xià.
dialogue.en: David, Xiaoli, Uncle and Auntie are coming for dinner tonight. We have to clean up quickly.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 沒問題！媽，您分配任務吧。我們要負責做什麼？
dialogue.py: méi wèn tí! mā, nín fēn pèi rèn wu ba. wǒ men yào fù zé zuò shén me?
dialogue.en: No problem! Mom, assign the tasks. What are we responsible for?

dialogue.speaker: Mom
dialogue.zh: 大衛，你先把地掃了，然後把垃圾倒掉。特別是廚房的垃圾。
dialogue.py: dà wèi, nǐ xiān bǎ dì sǎo le, rán hòu bǎ lā jī dào diào. tè bié shì chú fáng de lā jī.
dialogue.en: David, sweep the floor first, then take out the trash. Especially the kitchen trash.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 好，我馬上就去。那擦桌子呢？
dialogue.py: hǎo, wǒ mǎ shàng jiù qù. nà cā zhuō zi ne?
dialogue.en: Okay, I'll go right away. What about wiping the tables?

dialogue.speaker: Mom
dialogue.zh: 桌子等一下小麗來擦。小麗，你先去把客廳的玩具和書收拾好。
dialogue.py: zhuō zi děng yī xià xiǎo lì lái cā. xiǎo lì, nǐ xiān qù bǎ kè tīng de wán jù hé shū shōu shi hǎo.
dialogue.en: Xiaoli will wipe the tables in a bit. Xiaoli, first go tidy up the toys and books in the living room.

dialogue.speaker: Sister (Lili)
dialogue.zh: 好的，媽。我還要幫您洗菜嗎？
dialogue.py: hǎo de, mā. wǒ hái yào bāng nín xǐ cài ma?
dialogue.en: Okay, Mom. Do I still need to help you wash vegetables?

dialogue.speaker: Mom
dialogue.zh: 洗菜不用急，等我開始做飯的時候再說。你先保證客廳整潔。
dialogue.py: xǐ cài bù yòng jí, děng wǒ kāi shǐ zuò fàn de shí hou zài shuō. nǐ xiān bǎo zhèng kè tīng zhěng jié.
dialogue.en: No rush for washing vegetables; we'll talk about that when I start cooking. First ensure the living room is neat and tidy.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 爸呢？爸在忙什麼？
dialogue.py: bà ne? bà zài máng shén me?
dialogue.en: What about Dad? What's he busy with?

dialogue.speaker: Mom
dialogue.zh: 你爸在陽台整理花草，一會兒他會去買飲料和水果。
dialogue.py: nǐ bà zài yáng tái zhěng lǐ huā cǎo, yī huì r tā huì qù mǎi yǐn liào hé shuǐ guǒ.
dialogue.en: Your dad is organizing the plants on the balcony; in a while, he'll go buy drinks and fruit.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 我們必須在五點前全部做完嗎？
dialogue.py: wǒ men bì xū zài wǔ diǎn qián quán bù zuò wán ma?
dialogue.en: Must we finish everything before 5:00?

dialogue.speaker: Mom
dialogue.zh: 對，客人五點半左右到。大家動作快一點兒！
dialogue.py: duì, kè rén wǔ diǎn bàn zuǒ yòu dào. dà jiā dòng zuò kuài yī diǎn r!
dialogue.en: Yes, the guests will arrive around 5:30. Everyone, move a bit faster!

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 收到！加油！
dialogue.py: shōu dào! jiā yóu!
dialogue.en: Received! Go for it!
