title: Buying a Phone
story_description: 馬克想換一部新手機。他在電子產品商店比較了兩款熱門機型，並向店員詢問建議。
story_intro: 馬克的舊手機壞了。
他來到一家電子商場。
他對新款的手機很感興趣。
他在考慮買華為還是蘋果的手機。
他比較了性能、拍照效果和價格。

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 你好！我想看看最近出的這幾款智能手機。
dialogue.py: nǐ hǎo! wǒ xiǎng kàn kàn zuì jìn chū de zhè jǐ kuǎn zhì néng shǒu jī.
dialogue.en: Hello! I'd like to see these latest smart phone models.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 好的。您現在看的是今年最熱銷的兩款。這款是最新出的，這款是上個月出的。
dialogue.py: hǎo de. nín xiàn zài kàn de shì jīn nián zuì rè xiāo de liǎng kuǎn. zhè kuǎn shì zuì xīn chū de, zhè kuǎn shì shàng gè yuè chū de.
dialogue.en: Okay. You're looking at the two best-sellers of this year. This model is the newest; this one came out last month.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 這兩款有什麼區別？哪一個性能更好？
dialogue.py: zhè liǎng kuǎn yǒu shén me qū bié? nǎ yī gè xìng néng gèng hǎo?
dialogue.en: What's the difference between these two? Which one has better performance?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 新款的處理器更快，運行大型遊戲非常流暢。而且螢幕是曲面的，視覺效果很棒。
dialogue.py: xīn kuǎn de chǔ lǐ qì gèng kuài, yùn xíng dà xíng yóu xì fēi cháng liú chàng. ér qiě yíng mù shì qū miàn de, shì jué xiào guǒ hěn bàng.
dialogue.en: The new model's processor is faster; it runs large games very smoothly. Also, the screen is curved; the visual effect is great.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 那拍照功能呢？我平時很喜歡拍照。
dialogue.py: nà pāi zhào gōng néng ne? wǒ píng shí hěn xǐ huan pāi zhào.
dialogue.en: What about the camera function? I usually like taking photos very much.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 那您選這款準沒錯。它有四個鏡頭，支持夜間模式和高清視頻拍攝。
dialogue.py: nà nín xuǎn zhè kuǎn zhǔn méi cuò. tā yǒu sì gè jìng tóu, zhī chí yè jiān mó shì hé gāo qīng shì pín pāi shè.
dialogue.en: Then choosing this one is definitely right. It has four lenses and supports night mode and high-definition video recording.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 聽起來很吸引人。電池容量大嗎？我怕用半天就沒電了。
dialogue.py: tīng qǐ lái hěn xī yǐn rén. diàn chí róng liàng dà ma? wǒ pà yòng bàn tiān jiù méi diàn le.
dialogue.en: Sounds very attractive. Is the battery capacity large? I'm afraid it'll run out of power in half a day.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 這您不用擔心。它支持超級快充，半個小時就能充滿百分之八十的電。
dialogue.py: zhè nín bù yòng dān xīn. tā zhī chí chāo jí kuài chōng, bàn gè xiǎo shí jiù néng chōng mǎn bǎi fēn zhī bā shí de diàn.
dialogue.en: You don't need to worry about that. It supports super-fast charging; 80% can be charged in half an hour.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 太好了。那這兩款的價格差多少？
dialogue.py: tài hǎo le. nà zhè liǎng kuǎn de jià gé chà duō shǎo?
dialogue.en: Great. What's the price difference between these two?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 新款是兩萬五千塊，舊款現在降價了，只要一萬八千塊。
dialogue.py: xīn kuǎn shì liǎng wàn wǔ qiān kuài, jiù kuǎn xiàn zài jiàng jià le, zhǐ yào yī wàn bā qiān kuài.
dialogue.en: The new model is 25,000; the old model has been reduced in price, now only 18,000.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 差距還挺大的。我想考慮一下。
dialogue.py: chā jù hái tǐng dà de. wǒ xiǎng kǎo lǜ yī xià.
dialogue.en: The gap is quite large. I'd like to consider it for a bit.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。您可以先試用一下展台上的真機。
dialogue.py: méi wèn tí. nín kě yǐ xiān shì yòng yī xià zhǎn tái shàng de zhēn jī.
dialogue.en: No problem. You can try out the real device on the display stand first.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好的，謝謝您的建議。
dialogue.py: hǎo de, xiè xie nín de jiàn yì.
dialogue.en: Okay, thanks for your advice.

speaking.part_b: Role-play: 你在買電腦。問店員筆記型電腦和台式機有什麼區別。店員說筆記型電腦方便攜帶，但台式機性能更好且價格更便宜。你選擇了筆記型電腦。
part_c: 你換手機的頻率高嗎？
你買電子產品時最看重什麼？

comprehension.q: 馬克現在看的是幾款手機？
新款手機的螢幕是什麼樣的？
這款拍照功能強大的手機有幾個鏡頭？
手機充電半個小時能充多少電？
兩款手機的價格差距是多少？

true_false.q: 馬克的舊手機還能用。
新款手機運行大型遊戲很卡。
手機支持高清視頻拍攝。
舊款手機現在漲價了。
馬克打算立刻買下新款手機。

passage.title: Buying a Phone Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克的舊手機壞了。他來到一家電子商場。他對新款的手機很感興趣。他在考慮買華為還是蘋果的手機。他比較了性能、拍照效果和價格。
passage.en: Hello! I'd like to see these latest smart phone models. Okay. You're looking at the two best-sellers of this year. This model is the newest; this one came out last month. What's the difference between these two? Which one has better performance? The new model's processor is faster; it runs large games very smoothly. Also, the screen is curved; the visual effect is great. What about the camera function? I usually like taking photos very much. Then choosing this one is definitely right. It has four lenses and supports night mode and high-definition video recording.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: 請寫 3 到 5 句話描述你現在使用的手機或電腦。包含它的品牌、你最喜歡的功能，以及你用了多久。

grammar.explanation: 使用 '哪一個' 詢問選擇。'更 + Adjective' 表程度加深。'V + 滿' 表示動作達到極限 (充滿)。
examples: 哪一個更好？ (Which one is better?)
水充滿了杯子。 (The water filled the cup.)

practice.q: Translate: The battery is fully charged.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 你的新手機真漂亮，在哪裡買的？
expansion_dialogue.py: nǐ de xīn shǒu jī zhēn piào liang, zài nǎ lǐ mǎi de?
expansion_dialogue.en: Your new phone is really beautiful; where did you buy it?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 我在網上訂購的，比實體店便宜兩百塊。
expansion_dialogue.py: wǒ zài wǎng shàng dìng gòu de, bǐ shí tǐ diàn pián yi liǎng bǎi kuài.
expansion_dialogue.en: I ordered it online; it's 200 dollars cheaper than the physical store.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 網購確實划算，但不能試用。
expansion_dialogue.py: wǎng gòu què shí huá suàn, dàn bù néng shì yòng.
expansion_dialogue.en: Online shopping is indeed cost-effective, but you can't try it out.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 沒關係，我先去專賣店看過真機了。
expansion_dialogue.py: méi guān xi, wǒ xiān qù zhuān mài diàn kàn guò zhēn jī le.
expansion_dialogue.en: No problem; I went to the flagship store to see the actual device first.

review.speaking: Compare two electronic devices and ask for recommendations.
review.self_check: 你能用中文描述電子產品的性能、功能和價格嗎？

title: My Computer Is Slow
story_description: 馬克的電腦運行速度變得很慢。他向精通技術的大衛尋求解決建議。
story_intro: 馬克正在用電腦寫報告。
電腦突然卡住了。
他覺得電腦越來越慢。
他問大衛應該怎麼辦。
大衛給了他一些清理和優化的建議。

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 大衛，你有空嗎？我想請教你一個技術問題。
dialogue.py: dà wèi, nǐ yǒu kòng ma? wǒ xiǎng qǐng jiào nǐ yī gè jì shù wèn tí.
dialogue.en: David, are you free? I'd like to ask you a technical question.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 有空，怎麼了？你的電腦又出問題了？
dialogue.py: yǒu kòng, zěn me le? nǐ de diàn nǎo yòu chū wèn tí le?
dialogue.en: Yes, what's up? Problem with your computer again?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 對。它最近運行得非常慢，有時候還會死機。
dialogue.py: duì. tā zuì jìn yùn xíng de fēi cháng màn, yǒu shí hou hái huì sǐ jī.
dialogue.en: Yes. It's been running very slowly recently, and sometimes it even freezes.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 你是不是裝了太多軟體？或者很久沒清理垃圾文件了？
dialogue.py: nǐ shì bù shì zhuāng le tài duō ruǎn tǐ? huò zhě hěn jiǔ méi qīng lǐ lā jī wén jiàn le?
dialogue.en: Have you installed too much software? Or haven't cleaned up junk files for a long time?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我不確定。我有時候會下載一些國外影片看。
dialogue.py: wǒ bù què dìng. wǒ yǒu shí hou huì xià zài yī xiē guó wài yǐng piàn kàn.
dialogue.en: I'm not sure. Sometimes I download foreign videos to watch.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 那可能是硬盤快滿了。你檢查過C盤的剩餘空間嗎？
dialogue.py: nà kě néng shì yìng pán kuài mǎn le. nǐ jiǎn chá guò C pán de shèng yú kōng jiān ma?
dialogue.en: Then maybe the hard drive is almost full. Have you checked the remaining space on the C drive?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我看看...喔，真的快紅了，只剩下2GB了。
dialogue.py: wǒ kàn kàn... ō, zhēn de kuài hóng le, zhǐ shèng xià 2GB le.
dialogue.en: Let me see... oh, it's really almost red (in the bar), only 2GB left.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 難怪會卡。你應該把大文件移動到外接硬盤，或者刪除沒用的軟體。
dialogue.py: nán guài huì kǎ. nǐ yīng gāi bǎ dà wén jiàn yí dòng dào wài jiē yìng pán, huò zhě shān chú méi yòng de ruǎn tǐ.
dialogue.en: No wonder it's lagging. You should move large files to an external hard drive or delete useless software.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 除了清理空間，還有別的辦法嗎？
dialogue.py: chú le qīng lǐ kōng jiān, hái yǒu bié de bàn fǎ ma?
dialogue.en: Besides cleaning up space, are there any other ways?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 你也可以試著重裝系統，或者加一個內存條。
dialogue.py: nǐ yě kě yǐ shì zhe chóng zhuāng xì tǒng, huò zhě jiā yī gè nèi cún tiáo.
dialogue.en: You could also try reinstalling the system or adding a RAM stick.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 加內存條會很貴嗎？
dialogue.py: jiā nèi cún tiáo huì hěn guì ma?
dialogue.en: Is adding RAM expensive?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 不貴，幾百塊就能買到。加了以後，速度會快很多。
dialogue.py: bù guì, jǐ bǎi kuài jiù néng mǎi dào. jiā le yǐ hòu, sù dù huì kuài hěn duō.
dialogue.en: Not expensive; you can buy one for a few hundred dollars. After adding it, the speed will be much faster.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 太好了，那我週末去電腦城看看。謝謝大衛！
dialogue.py: tài hǎo le, nà wǒ zhōu mò qù diàn nǎo chéng kàn kàn. xiè xie dà wèi!
dialogue.en: Great, then I'll go to the computer mall this weekend and take a look. Thanks, David!

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 不客氣。有需要隨時找我。
dialogue.py: bù kè qì. yǒu xū yào suí shí zhǎo wǒ.
dialogue.en: You're welcome. Find me anytime if needed.

key_sentences.en: The computer had a problem again.
The hard drive is almost full.
Move to an external hard drive.

speaking.part_b: Role-play: 你的手機最近很卡。向朋友詢問建議。朋友建議你刪除不常用的軟體並備份照片到雲端。你覺得這個主意很好。
part_c: 你的電腦性能好嗎？
當你遇到技術問題時，你會找誰幫忙？

comprehension.q: 馬克的電腦最近出了什麼問題？
大衛認為電腦慢可能與什麼有關？
options: A. 軟體太多或沒清理垃圾

comprehension.q: 馬克的C盤還剩下多少空間？
大衛建議把大文件移動到哪裡？
大衛建議的解決方案中，哪一個可以顯著提高速度？

true_false.q: 馬克不想打擾大衛。
馬克有時候會下載影片。
加內存條非常昂貴。
馬克打算週末去電腦城。
大衛不願意幫馬克的忙。

fill_blank.q: 把大文件移____到外接硬盤。

passage.title: My Computer Is Slow Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克正在用電腦寫報告。電腦突然卡住了。他覺得電腦越來越慢。他問大衛應該怎麼辦。大衛給了他一些清理和優化的建議。
passage.en: David, are you free? I'd like to ask you a technical question. Yes, what's up? Problem with your computer again? Yes. It's been running very slowly recently, and sometimes it even freezes. Have you installed too much software? Or haven't cleaned up junk files for a long time? I'm not sure. Sometimes I download foreign videos to watch. Then maybe the hard drive is almost full. Have you checked the remaining space on the C drive?
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: 請寫 3 到 5 句話描述一次你遇到的技術問題（如電腦故障、網路中斷、手機沒電）。你是如何解決的？

grammar.explanation: 使用 '又' 表示重複。使用 '越來越...' 表示程度隨時間加深。'隨時' 表示時間不受限制。
examples: 他又遲到了。 (He is late again.)
電腦越來越慢。 (The computer is getting slower and slower.)
有問題隨時問。 (Ask questions anytime.)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 我的網路速度好慢，網頁都打不開。
expansion_dialogue.py: wǒ de wǎng lù sù dù hǎo màn, wǎng yè dōu dǎ bù kāi.
expansion_dialogue.en: My internet speed is so slow; I can't even open webpages.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 你重啟一下路由器試試看。
expansion_dialogue.py: nǐ chóng qǐ yī xià lù yóu qì shì shì kàn.
expansion_dialogue.en: Try restarting the router and see.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 重啟過了，還是不行。可能是網路公司的線路出問題了。
expansion_dialogue.py: chóng qǐ guò le, hái shì bù xíng. kě néng shì wǎng lù gōng sī de xiàn lù chū wèn tí le.
expansion_dialogue.en: Restarted it already; still doesn't work. Maybe it's a problem with the network company's lines.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 那你打電話給客服報修吧，他們應該會派人來檢查。
expansion_dialogue.py: nà nǐ dǎ diàn huà gěi kè fú bào xiū ba, tā men yīng gāi huì pài rén lái jiǎn chá.
expansion_dialogue.en: Then call customer service to report it; they should send someone over to check.

review.speaking: Ask for technology advice and describe computer symptoms.
review.self_check: 你能用中文描述電腦運行慢、死機等常見技術問題嗎？

title: Online Class Problem
story_description: 馬克在參加線上課程時遇到了連接問題。他向老師解釋原因並尋求補救方法。
story_intro: 馬克今天有一節重要的線上課。
他的電腦網路突然斷了。
他沒能按時進入直播間。
他感到很焦急。
他隨後發郵件給老師說明情況。

dialogue.speaker: Mark (Email)
dialogue.zh: 尊敬的王老師：您好！抱歉打擾了。
dialogue.py: zūn jìng de wáng lǎo shī: nín hǎo! bào qiàn dǎ rǎo le.
dialogue.en: Respected Teacher Wang: Hello! Sorry to bother you.

dialogue.speaker: Mark (Email)
dialogue.zh: 我是您的學生馬克。今天上午的線上中文課，我沒能參加。
dialogue.py: wǒ shì nín de xué sheng mǎ kè. jīn tiān shàng wǔ de xiàn shàng zhōng wén kè, wǒ méi néng cān jiā.
dialogue.en: I'm your student, Mark. I wasn't able to attend this morning's online Chinese class.

dialogue.speaker: Mark (Email)
dialogue.zh: 因為我宿舍的網路突然斷了，我一直連不上課程平台。
dialogue.py: yīn wèi wǒ sù shè de wǎng lù tū rán duàn le, wǒ yī zhí lián bù shàng kè chéng píng tái.
dialogue.en: Because my dorm's internet suddenly cut off, and I couldn't connect to the course platform.

dialogue.speaker: Mark (Email)
dialogue.zh: 雖然我嘗試了重啟電腦和手機熱點，但還是沒辦法進入直播間。
dialogue.py: suī rán wǒ cháng shì le chóng qǐ diàn nǎo hé shǒu jī rè diǎn, dàn hái shì méi bàn fǎ jìn rù zhí bō jiān.
dialogue.en: Although I tried restarting the computer and using a phone hotspot, I still couldn't enter the livestream room.

dialogue.speaker: Mark (Email)
dialogue.zh: 我非常遺憾錯過了今天的精彩課程。
dialogue.py: wǒ fēi cháng yí hàn cuò guò le jīn tiān de jīng cǎi kè chéng.
dialogue.en: I'm very regretful to have missed today's brilliant class.

dialogue.speaker: Mark (Email)
dialogue.zh: 請問今天的課程有錄影回放嗎？我想補看課程內容。
dialogue.py: qǐng wèn jīn tiān de kè chéng yǒu lù yǐng huí fàng ma? wǒ xiǎng bǔ kàn kè chéng nèi róng.
dialogue.en: Excuse me, is there a recording playback of today's class? I'd like to catch up on the content.

dialogue.speaker: Mark (Email)
dialogue.zh: 另外，今天的課後作業是什麼？我會按時完成並交給您的。
dialogue.py: lìng wài, jīn tiān de kè hòu zuò yè shì shén me? wǒ huì àn shí wán chéng bìng jiāo gěi nín de.
dialogue.en: Additionally, what's today's homework? I will complete it on time and hand it to you.

dialogue.speaker: Mark (Email)
dialogue.zh: 再次向您表示歉意。祝您身體健康！學生馬克。
dialogue.py: zài cì xiàng nín biǎo shì qiàn yì. zhù nín shēn tǐ jiàn kāng! xué sheng mǎ kè.
dialogue.en: Once again, I express my apologies. Wish you good health! Student Mark.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher Wang (Reply)
dialogue.zh: 馬克，沒關係。網路問題也是沒辦法的事。
dialogue.py: mǎ kè, méi guān xi. wǎng lù wèn tí yě shì méi bàn fǎ de shì.
dialogue.en: Mark, it's okay. Network problems are unavoidable.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher Wang (Reply)
dialogue.zh: 課程錄影已經上傳到平台了，你可以隨時觀看。
dialogue.py: kè chéng lù yǐng yǐ jīng shàng chuán dào píng tái le, nǐ kě yǐ suí shí guān kàn.
dialogue.en: The class recording has been uploaded to the platform; you can watch it anytime.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher Wang (Reply)
dialogue.zh: 作業是寫一篇關於'我的愛好'的短文。不用急，慢慢看。
dialogue.py: zuò yè shì xiě yī piān guān yú 'wǒ de ài hào' de duǎn wén. bù yòng jí, màn màn kàn.
dialogue.en: The assignment is to write a short essay about 'My Hobby'. No rush; take your time watching.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 太好了，謝謝老師！
dialogue.py: tài hǎo le, xiè xie lǎo shī!
dialogue.en: Great, thank you, teacher!

key_sentences.en: Unable to connect to the platform.

speaking.part_b: Role-play: 你在一節線上會議中突然掉線了。重新進去後，向主持人道歉並解釋網路不好。問大家剛才說了什麼重要的事情。
part_c: 你喜歡線上課還是線下課？為什麼？
你的網路速度穩定嗎？

comprehension.q: 馬克為什麼沒能參加今天上午的課？
馬克嘗試過哪些方法解決網路問題？
options: A. 重啟電腦和手機熱點

comprehension.q: 馬克發郵件給誰說明情況？
老師說錄影在哪裡可以看？
今天的課後作業是什麼？

true_false.q: 馬克對錯過課程感到無所謂。
馬克的宿舍網路一直很好。
老師理解馬克的處境。
馬克不打算交今天的作業了。
錄影已經上傳好了。

passage.title: Online Class Problem Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克今天有一節重要的線上課。他的電腦網路突然斷了。他沒能按時進入直播間。他感到很焦急。他隨後發郵件給老師說明情況。
passage.en: Respected Teacher Wang: Hello! Sorry to bother you. I'm your student, Mark. I wasn't able to attend this morning's online Chinese class. Because my dorm's internet suddenly cut off, and I couldn't connect to the course platform. Although I tried restarting the computer and using a phone hotspot, I still couldn't enter the livestream room. I'm very regretful to have missed today's brilliant class. Excuse me, is there a recording playback of today's class? I'd like to catch up on the content.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: 請寫一封電子郵件（40 到 60 個字）向老師解釋你沒交作業的原因（如網路不好、生病、電腦壞了），並詢問補交的期限。

grammar.explanation: 使用 '...不...' 補語表示無法達成 (連不上)。使用 '另外' 添加新信息。信件格式 (尊稱、祝詞)。
examples: 我看不清。 (I can't see [it] clearly.)
另外，我還有個問題。 (Additionally, I have a question.)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 會議室的WiFi密碼是多少？
expansion_dialogue.py: huì yì shì de WiFi mì mǎ shì duō shǎo?
expansion_dialogue.en: What is the WiFi password for the conference room?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.py: shì yī èr sān sì wǔ liù qī bā. nǐ lián shàng le ma?
expansion_dialogue.en: It's 12345678. Did you connect?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 信號挺強的，但還是顯示連接失敗。
expansion_dialogue.py: xìn hào tǐng qiáng de, dàn hái shì xiǎn shì lián jiē shī bài.
expansion_dialogue.en: The signal is quite strong, but it still shows connection failed.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 那你試試重新開關一下WiFi，或者重啟手機。
expansion_dialogue.py: nà nǐ shì shì chóng xīn kāi guān yī xià WiFi, huò zhě chóng qǐ shǒu jī.
expansion_dialogue.en: Then try toggling the WiFi on and off or restarting your phone.

title: Sending an Email
story_description: 馬克需要給學校辦公室發郵件諮詢簽證延期的問題。他在大衛的幫助下寫了一封正式的中文郵件。
story_intro: 馬克的簽證快到期了。
他需要去辦公室申請延期。
他決定先發郵件諮詢流程。
這是一封正式的商務性郵件。
他們練習正式的稱呼、正文和落款。

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 大衛，我想寫封信給留學生辦公室，你能幫我看看嗎？
dialogue.py: dà wèi, wǒ xiǎng xiě fēng xìn gěi liú xué shēng bàn gōng shì, nǐ néng bāng wǒ kàn kàn ma?
dialogue.en: David, I want to write a letter to the international student office; can you help me take a look?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。是關於什麼的？
dialogue.py: méi wèn tí. shì guān yú shén me de?
dialogue.en: No problem. What's it about?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 關於簽證延期。我的簽證下個月就到期了。
dialogue.py: guān yú qiān zhèng yán qī. wǒ de qiān zhèng xià gè yuè jiù dào qī le.
dialogue.en: About visa extension. My visa expires next month.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 正式郵件要注意格式。首先是稱呼，可以用'留學生辦公室負責老師：您好！'。
dialogue.py: zhèng shì yóu jiàn yào zhù yì gé shì. shǒu xiān shì chēng hu, kě yǐ yòng 'liú xué shēng bàn gōng shì fù zé lǎo shī: nín hǎo!'.
dialogue.en: Formal emails should follow the correct format. First is the address; you can use 'Teacher in charge at the International Student Office: Hello!'.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好的，寫好了。接下來怎麼說明我的情況？
dialogue.py: hǎo de, xiě hǎo le. jiē xià lái zěn me shuō míng wǒ de qíng kuàng?
dialogue.en: Okay, written. Next, how do I explain my situation?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 你可以說：'我是美國留學生馬克。我想諮詢一下辦理簽證延期的具體手續。'
dialogue.py: nǐ kě yǐ shuō: 'wǒ shì měi guó liú xué shēng mǎ kè. wǒ xiǎng zī xún yī xià bàn lǐ qiān zhèng yán qī de jù tǐ shǒu xù.'
dialogue.en: You can say: 'I'm Mark, an American international student. I'd like to inquire about the specific procedures for visa extension.'

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 還要問需要什麼材料嗎？
dialogue.py: hái yào wèn xū yào shén me cái liào ma?
dialogue.en: Should I also ask what materials are needed?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 當然。問：'請問需要準備哪些材料？是否需要預約時間？'
dialogue.py: dāng rán. wèn: 'qǐng wèn xū yào zhǔn bèi nǎ xiē cái liào? shì fǒu xū yào yù yuē shí jiān?'
dialogue.en: Of course. Ask: 'Excuse me, what materials need to be prepared? Is an appointment required?'

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 結尾呢？怎麼結束比較禮貌？
dialogue.py: jié wěi ne? zěn me jié shù bǐ jiào lǐ mào?
dialogue.en: And the ending? How to end it politely?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 結尾可以寫：'期待您的回覆，非常感謝。' 最後別忘了寫上你的名字和日期。
dialogue.py: jié wěi kě yǐ xiě: 'qī dài nín de huí fù, fēi cháng gǎn xiè.' zuì hòu bié wàng le xiě shàng nǐ de míng zi hé rì qī.
dialogue.en: The ending can be: 'Looking forward to your reply, thank you very much.' Finally, don't forget to write your name and the date.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好了。我檢查了一遍，沒有錯字。我發出去了。
dialogue.py: hǎo le. wǒ jiǎn chá le yī biàn, méi yǒu cuò zì. wǒ fā chū qù le.
dialogue.en: Done. I've checked it once; no typos. I've sent it out.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 很好，寫得挺專業的。應該很快就有消息了。
dialogue.py: hěn hǎo, xiě de tǐng zhuān yè de. yīng gāi hěn kuài jiù yǒu xiāo xi le.
dialogue.en: Very good; it's written quite professionally. There should be news very soon.

speaking.part_b: Role-play: 你想寫郵件給教授請病假。請朋友大衛幫你修改。大衛告訴你首先要寫上尊敬的某某教授，然後說明生病了不能去上課，最後寫上祝好。你練習讀這封郵件。
part_c: 你寫過正式的中文郵件嗎？
你覺得正式郵件的格式難不難？

comprehension.q: 馬克為什麼要給辦公室發郵件？
馬克的簽證什麼時候到期？
大衛建議郵件的開頭稱呼是什麼？
除了具體手續，馬克還想諮詢什麼？
options: A. 需要哪些材料和是否需要預約

comprehension.q: 馬克在發送郵件前做了什麼？
options: B. 檢查了一遍有沒有錯字

true_false.q: 這是一封寫給朋友的非正式郵件。
馬克不記得簽證到期的時間。
大衛覺得馬克寫得挺專業的。
正式郵件結尾不需要寫名字。
郵件內容包含諮詢是否需要預約時間。

passage.title: Sending an Email Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克的簽證快到期了。他需要去辦公室申請延期。他決定先發郵件諮詢流程。這是一封正式的商務性郵件。他們練習正式的稱呼、正文和落款。
passage.en: David, I want to write a letter to the international student office; can you help me take a look? No problem. What's it about? About visa extension. My visa expires next month. Formal emails should follow the correct format. First is the address; you can use 'Teacher in charge at the International Student Office: Hello!'. Okay, written. Next, how do I explain my situation? You can say: 'I'm Mark, an American international student. I'd like to inquire about the specific procedures for visa extension.'.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: 請寫一封正式的中文郵件（40 到 60 個字）諮詢學校圖書館的開放時間和辦理借書證的要求。包含正式的稱呼和結尾。

grammar.explanation: 使用 '首先'、'接下來'、'最後' 組織段落。正式用語 '是否' 取代 '是不是'。'預約' 的用法。
examples: 首先，我要感謝你。 (First, I want to thank you.)
請告訴我你是否參加。 (Please tell me if you'll attend.)
我預約了下午三點。 (I booked 3 PM.)

practice.q: Complete: 不知道他___否有空。 (If or not...)
Translate: Looking forward to the weekend.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 我的郵件發出去了，你收到了嗎？
expansion_dialogue.py: wǒ de yóu jiàn fā chū qù le, nǐ shōu dào le ma?
expansion_dialogue.en: I've sent my email; did you receive it?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 還沒有，你發到哪個信箱了？
expansion_dialogue.py: hái méi yǒu, nǐ fā dào nǎ gè xìn xiāng le?
expansion_dialogue.en: Not yet; which inbox did you send it to?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 就是你上次給我的那個 Gmail 地址。
expansion_dialogue.py: jiù shì nǐ shàng cì gěi wǒ de nà gè Gmail dì zhǐ.
expansion_dialogue.en: The Gmail address you gave me last time.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 喔，那個地址我好久沒用了。請發到我的公司郵箱吧。
expansion_dialogue.py: ō, nà gè dì zhǐ wǒ hǎo jiǔ méi yòng le. qǐng fā dào wǒ de gōng sī yóu xiāng ba.
expansion_dialogue.en: Oh, I haven't used that address for a long time. Please send it to my company email.

review.speaking: Explain the key components of a formal email in Chinese.
review.self_check: 你能用中文寫出格式正確、語氣禮貌的正式郵件嗎？

title: Joining a Club
story_description: 馬克想加入學校的攝影社。他去諮詢報名要求和活動內容。
story_intro: 學校的社團開始招新了。
馬克對攝影很感興趣。
他來到攝影社的攤位前。
他向社長詢問入社的條件。
他決定填表加入這個有趣的社團。

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 你好！請問這裡是攝影社嗎？我想諮詢一下入社的事。
dialogue.py: nǐ hǎo! qǐng wèn zhè lǐ shì shè yǐng shè ma? wǒ xiǎng zī xún yī xià rù shè de shì.
dialogue.en: Hello! Is this the photography club? I'd like to ask about joining.

dialogue.speaker: President
dialogue.zh: 對，這裡就是攝影社。歡迎！我是社長。你也喜歡攝影嗎？
dialogue.py: duì, zhè lǐ jiù shì shè yǐng shè. huān yíng! wǒ shì shè zhǎng. nǐ yě xǐ huan shè yǐng ma?
dialogue.en: Yes, this is the photography club. Welcome! I'm the president. Do you like photography too?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我很感興趣，但我只是個初學者。請問入社有門檻嗎？
dialogue.py: wǒ hěn gǎn xìng qù, dàn wǒ zhǐ shì gè chū xué zhě. qǐng wèn rù shè yǒu mén kǎn ma?
dialogue.en: I'm very interested, but I'm just a beginner. Are there any requirements/thresholds for joining?

dialogue.speaker: President
dialogue.zh: 沒什麼門檻。只要你有熱情，願意學習，我們都歡迎。你有相機嗎？
dialogue.py: méi shén me mén kǎn. zhǐ yào nǐ yǒu rè qíng, yuàn yì xué xí, wǒ men dōu huān yíng. nǐ yǒu xiàng jī ma?
dialogue.en: No real threshold. As long as you have passion and are willing to learn, we welcome you. Do you have a camera?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我有。入社會員費是多少？
dialogue.py: wǒ yǒu. rù shè huì yuán fèi shì duō shǎo?
dialogue.en: I do. How much is the membership fee?

dialogue.speaker: President
dialogue.zh: 一學期兩百塊。這包括了參加活動和使用暗房的費用。
dialogue.py: yī xué qī liǎng bǎi kuài. zhè bāo kuò le cān jiā huó dòng hé shǐ yòng àn fáng de fèi yòng.
dialogue.en: 200 dollars per semester. This includes the cost of activities and using the darkroom.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 那社團平時都有什麼活動呢？
dialogue.py: nà shè tuán píng shí dōu yǒu shén me huó dòng ne?
dialogue.en: What activities does the club usually have?

dialogue.speaker: President
dialogue.zh: 我們每週三晚上有攝影講座，週末會組織去郊外外拍。
dialogue.py: wǒ men měi zhōu sān wǎn shang yǒu shè yǐng jiǎng zuò, zhōu mò huì zǔ zhī qù jiāo wài wài pāi.
dialogue.en: We have photography lectures every Wednesday night and organize outdoor shoots in the outskirts on weekends.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 聽起來很豐富！外拍是大家一起去嗎？
dialogue.py: tīng qǐ lái hěn fēng fù! wài pāi shì dà jiā yī qǐ qù ma?
dialogue.en: Sounds very rich! Does everyone go together for the outdoor shoots?

dialogue.speaker: President
dialogue.zh: 對，我們會一起出發，互相交流拍照心得。年底還會舉辦攝影展呢。
dialogue.py: duì, wǒ men huì yī qǐ chū fā, hù xiāng jiāo liú pāi zhào xīn dé. nián dǐ hái huì jǔ bàn shè yǐng zhǎn ne.
dialogue.en: Yes, we set off together and exchange photography tips/insights. There's even a photo exhibition at the end of the year.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 太棒了，我也想參加！現在可以填表報名嗎？
dialogue.py: tài bàng le, wǒ yě xiǎng cān jiā! xiàn zài kě yǐ tián biǎo bào míng ma?
dialogue.en: Excellent, I want to participate too! Can I fill out the form and register now?

dialogue.speaker: President
dialogue.zh: 當然可以。請在這張表上寫下你的姓名、系級和聯繫方式。
dialogue.py: dāng rán kě yǐ. qǐng zài zhè zhāng biǎo shàng xiě xià nǐ de xìng míng, xì jí hé lián luò fāng shì.
dialogue.en: Of course. Please write your name, department/year, and contact info on this form.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好的，我這就填。以後請多多指教！
dialogue.py: hǎo de, wǒ zhè jiù tián. yǐ hòu qǐng duō duō zhǐ jiào!
dialogue.en: Okay, I'll fill it out right now. Please give me lots of guidance in the future!

key_sentences.en: How much is the membership fee?

入社需要交多少會員費？

passage.zh: 學校的社團開始招新了。馬克對攝影很感興趣。他來到攝影社的攤位前。他向社長詢問入社的條件。他決定填表加入這個有趣的社團。

I'm very interested, but I'm just a beginner. Are there any requirements/thresholds for joining? No real threshold. As long as you have passion and are willing to learn, we welcome you. Do you have a camera? I do. How much is the membership fee? 200 dollars per semester. This includes the cost of activities and using the darkroom.

grammar.explanation: 使用 '包括了' 表含蓋內容。使用 '...的話' 表話題。謙辭 '指教' 的用法。

有問題的話，問我。 (If [you] have questions, ask me.)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 你是哪個社團的？我看你常拿著球拍。
expansion_dialogue.py: nǐ shì nǎ gè shè tuán de? wǒ kàn nǐ cháng ná zhe qiú pāi.
expansion_dialogue.en: Which club are you in? I see you often carrying a racket.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 我是羽毛球社的。你有興趣嗎？我們正缺人呢。
expansion_dialogue.py: wǒ shì yǔ máo qiú shè de. nǐ yǒu xìng qù ma? wǒ men zhèng quē rén ne.
expansion_dialogue.en: I'm in the badminton club. Are you interested? We're short on people right now.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 我羽毛球打得不好，怕拖大家後腿。
expansion_dialogue.py: wǒ yǔ máo qiú dǎ de bù hǎo, pà tuō dà jiā hòu tuǐ.
expansion_dialogue.en: I don't play badminton well; I'm afraid of holding everyone back.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 沒關係，我們社團有專業教練指導，很快就能提高。
expansion_dialogue.py: méi guān xi, wǒ men shè tuán yǒu zhuān yè jiào liàn zhǐ dǎo, hěn kuài jiù néng tí gāo.
expansion_dialogue.en: No problem; our club has professional coaches guiding us, so you'll improve very quickly.

title: Sports Practice
story_description: 馬克參加了學校籃球隊的訓練。他和隊友商量訓練時間、裝備以及比賽的準備工作。
story_intro: 籃球隊下午有訓練。
馬克換好了運動服來到球場。
隊長正在召集隊員開會。
他們談到了熱身、戰術和比賽時間。
隊長提醒大家帶齊所有的裝備。

dialogue.speaker: Captain
dialogue.zh: 大家集合！訓練馬上開始。都到齊了嗎？
dialogue.py: dà jiā jí hé! xùn liàn mǎ shàng kāi shǐ. dōu dào qí le ma?
dialogue.en: Everyone gather round! Practice starts immediately. Is everyone here?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 隊長，大衛家裡有點事，可能晚到十分鐘。
dialogue.py: duì zhǎng, dà wèi jiā lǐ yǒu diǎn r shì, kě néng wǎn dào shí fēn zhōng.
dialogue.en: Captain, David has something going on at home; he might arrive ten minutes late.

dialogue.speaker: Captain
dialogue.zh: 好的。我們先開始熱身，繞球場跑五圈。
dialogue.py: hǎo de. wǒ men xiān kāi shǐ rè shēn, rào qiú chǎng pǎo wǔ quān.
dialogue.en: Okay. We'll start warming up first; run five laps around the court.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 今天的訓練重點是什麼？
dialogue.py: jīn tiān de xùn liàn zhòng diǎn shì shén me?
dialogue.en: What's the focus of today's practice?

dialogue.speaker: Captain
dialogue.zh: 今天是進攻戰術和投籃練習。下週我們有一場友誼賽，對手很強。
dialogue.py: jīn tiān shì jìn gōng zhàn shù hé tóu lán liàn xí. xià zhōu wǒ men yǒu yī chǎng yǒu yì sài, duì shǒu hěn qiáng.
dialogue.en: Today is offensive tactics and shooting practice. We have a friendly match next week; the opponents are very strong.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 對手是哪個系的？聽說他們的後衛投籃很準。
dialogue.py: duì shǒu shì nǎ gè xì de? tīng shuō tā men de hòu wèi tóu lán hěn zhǔn.
dialogue.en: Which department are the opponents from? I heard their guard shoots very accurately.

dialogue.speaker: Captain
dialogue.zh: 是體育系的。所以我們要加強防守。大家一定要帶齊裝備。
dialogue.py: shì tǐ yù xì de. suǒ yǐ wǒ men yào jiā qiáng fáng shǒu. dà jiā yī dìng yào dài qí zhuāng bèi.
dialogue.en: They're from the PE department. So we need to strengthen our defense. Everyone must bring all their equipment.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 需要帶什麼特別的嗎？我今天只帶了籃球鞋和球衣。
dialogue.py: xū yào dài shén me tè bié de ma? wǒ jīn tiān zhǐ dài le lán qiú xié hé qiú yī.
dialogue.en: Need to bring anything special? I only brought basketball shoes and a jersey today.

dialogue.speaker: Captain
dialogue.zh: 記得帶上護膝和足夠的飲用水。天氣熱，大家要注意補充水分。
dialogue.py: jì de dài shàng hù xī hé zú gòu de yǐn yòng shuǐ. tiān qì rè, dà jiā yào zhù yì bǔ chōng shuǐ fèn.
dialogue.en: Remember to bring knee pads and enough drinking water. The weather is hot; everyone pay attention to replenishing fluids.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 知道了。那訓練什麼時候結束？
dialogue.py: zhī dào le. nà xùn liàn shén me shí hou jié shù?
dialogue.en: Got it. So when does practice end?

dialogue.speaker: Captain
dialogue.zh: 五點半結束。訓練完大家一起去開個短會，總結一下。
dialogue.py: wǔ diǎn bàn jié shù. xùn liàn wán dà jiā yī qǐ qù kāi gè duǎn huì, zǒng jié yī xià.
dialogue.en: Ends at 5:30. After practice, everyone go together for a short meeting to summarize.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好的。大家加油！
dialogue.py: hǎo de. dà jiā jiā yóu!
dialogue.en: Okay. Go for it, everyone!

key_sentences.en: Run five laps around the court.

speaking.part_b: Role-play: 你是隊長，通知隊員明天早上九點在操場集合訓練。提醒大家帶上運動鞋和毛巾。一個隊員問明天會不會有對抗賽。

大衛為什麼晚到？

passage.title: Sports Practice Listening Passage
passage.zh: 籃球隊下午有訓練。馬克換好了運動服來到球場。隊長正在召集隊員開會。他們談到了熱身、戰術和比賽時間。隊長提醒大家帶齊所有的裝備。
passage.en: Everyone gather round! Practice starts immediately. Is everyone here? Captain, David has something going on at home; he might arrive ten minutes late. Okay. We'll start warming up first; run five laps around the court. What's the focus of today's practice? Today is offensive tactics and shooting practice. We have a friendly match next week; the opponents are very strong. Which department are the opponents from? I heard their guard shoots very accurately.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: 請寫下你最喜歡的一種體育運動：說明你通常在那裡練習、和誰一起練習，以及這項運動對你有什麼好處（40 到 60 個字）。

grammar.explanation: 使用 '繞' 表動作路徑。使用 '加強' 表動態提升。數量詞 '五圈'、'一場'。
examples: 繞著操場走。 (Walk around the playground.)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 你的膝蓋怎麼了？貼著膏藥。
expansion_dialogue.py: nǐ de xī gài zěn me le? tiē zhe gāo yao.
expansion_dialogue.en: What happened to your knee? You're wearing a patch.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 昨天打球時不小心撞了一下，有點兒淤青。
expansion_dialogue.py: zuó tiān dǎ qiú shí bù xiǎo xīn zhuàng le yī xià, yǒu diǎn r yū qīng.
expansion_dialogue.en: I accidentally bumped it while playing yesterday; there's a bit of a bruise.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 那今天別參加訓練了，多休息兩天。
expansion_dialogue.py: nà jīn tiān bié cān jiā xùn liàn le, duō xiū xi liǎng tiān.
expansion_dialogue.en: Then don't participate in practice today; rest for a couple more days.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 我也是這麼想的。我就在旁邊看大家練。
expansion_dialogue.py: wǒ yě zhè me xiǎng de. wǒ jiù zài páng biān kàn dà jiā liàn.
expansion_dialogue.en: I was thinking that too. I'll just sit nearby and watch everyone practice.

title: I Hurt My Leg
story_description: 馬克在籃球訓練中不小心受傷了。隊友大衛幫他進行簡單的處理。
story_intro: 籃球訓練正在進行。
馬克在搶球時摔倒了。
他覺得腿很疼。
大衛立刻跑過來查看。
他們練習描述受傷的感覺和簡單的急救。

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 啊！哎喲，好疼啊！
dialogue.py: ā! āi yō, hǎo téng a!
dialogue.en: Ah! Ouch, so painful!

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 馬克，你怎麼了？摔得很嚴重嗎？
dialogue.py: mǎ kè, nǐ zěn me le? shuāi de hěn yán zhòng ma?
dialogue.en: Mark, what's wrong? Did you fall badly?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 不知道，我的右小腿抽筋了，膝蓋也撞破了皮。
dialogue.py: bù zhī dào, wǒ de yòu xiǎo tuǐ chōu jīn le, xī gài yě zhuàng pò le pí.
dialogue.en: I don't know; my right calf has a cramp, and my knee is scraped.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 你先別動，慢慢坐下來。讓我看看。
dialogue.py: nǐ xiān bié dòng, màn màn zuò xià lái. ràng wǒ kàn kàn.
dialogue.en: Don't move for now; sit down slowly. Let me see.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 嘶——輕點兒，那裡很痛。
dialogue.py: sī—— qīng diǎn r, nà lǐ hěn tòng.
dialogue.en: Hiss— gently, it's very painful there.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 膝蓋只是擦傷，流了一點兒血。但是小腿肌肉很硬，應該是過度勞累。
dialogue.py: xī gài zhǐ shì cā shāng, liú le yī diǎn r xuè. dàn shì xiǎo tuǐ jī ròu hěn yìng, yīng gāi shì guò dù láo lèi.
dialogue.en: The knee is just a scrape; bled a little. But the calf muscle is very hard; it should be from over-exertion.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 可能吧，我剛才跑得太猛了。現在怎麼辦？
dialogue.py: kě néng ba, wǒ gāng cái pǎo de tài měng le. xiàn zài zěn me bàn?
dialogue.en: Maybe; I ran too vigorously just now. What should I do now?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 我先幫你噴點兒止痛霧，然後幫你按摩一下小腿。
dialogue.py: wǒ xiān bāng nǐ pēn diǎn r zhǐ tòng wù, rán hòu bāng nǐ àn mó yī xià xiǎo tuǐ.
dialogue.en: I'll spray some painkiller mist for you first, then help massage your calf.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。我覺得好一點兒了，抽筋的感覺沒那麼強了。
dialogue.py: xiè xie. wǒ jué de hǎo yī diǎn r le, chōu jīn de gǎn jué méi nà me qiáng le.
dialogue.en: Thanks. I feel a bit better; the cramp feeling isn't that strong anymore.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 你得去醫務室處理一下膝蓋的傷口。那裡有消毒藥水。
dialogue.py: nǐ děi qù yī wù shì chǔ lǐ yī xià xī gài de shāng kǒu. nà lǐ yǒu xiāo dú yào shuǐ.
dialogue.en: You have to go to the infirmary to handle the knee wound. There's disinfectant solution there.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好。我能自己走過去嗎？
dialogue.py: hǎo. wǒ néng zì jǐ zǒu guò qù ma?
dialogue.en: Okay. Can I walk there by myself?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 我扶著你吧。小心一點兒，別再拉傷了。
dialogue.py: wǒ fú zhe nǐ ba. xiǎo xīn yī diǎn r, bié zài lā shāng le.
dialogue.en: I'll support you. Be careful; don't pull it again.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 大衛，你真專業，謝謝你的幫助。
dialogue.py: dà wèi, nǐ zhēn zhuān yè, xiè xie nǐ de bāng zhù.
dialogue.en: David, you're really professional; thanks for your help.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 小事一樁。以後訓練前一定要做好熱身。
dialogue.py: 小事一樁。以後訓練前一定要做好熱身。
dialogue.en: Small thing. Always do a good warm-up before training in the future.

speaking.part_b: Role-play: 你在跑步時扭傷了腳踝。朋友問你傷得重不重。你描述腳踝很腫，不能走路。朋友提議揹你去醫務室。
part_c: 你運動時受過傷嗎？
你覺得簡單的急救知識重要嗎？

comprehension.q: 馬克在做什麼的時候受傷了？
馬克的受傷具體部位在哪裡？
小腿抽筋的原因可能是什麼？
大衛首先幫馬克做了什麼處理？
處理完膝蓋後，馬克要去哪裡？

true_false.q: 馬克的膝蓋撞破了皮。
馬克的膝蓋流了很多血。
大衛建議馬克以後訓練前要熱身。
馬克可以跑著去醫務室。
大衛覺得幫馬克是小事一樁。

passage.title: I Hurt My Leg Listening Passage
passage.zh: 籃球訓練正在進行。馬克在搶球時摔倒了。他覺得腿很疼。大衛立刻跑過來查看。他們練習描述受傷的感覺和簡單的急救。
passage.en: Ah! Ouch, so painful! Mark, what's wrong? Did you fall badly? I don't know; my right calf has a cramp, and my knee is scraped. Don't move for now; sit down slowly. Let me see. Hiss— gently, it's very painful there. The knee is just a scrape; bled a little. But the calf muscle is very hard; it should be from over-exertion.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: 請寫 3 到 5 句話描述一次你受傷的經歷：傷在哪裡？是怎麼受傷的？最後是怎麼好的？

grammar.explanation: 使用 '哎喲' 表感嘆。'V + 破' 表示損壞 (撞破)。使用 '扶著' 表示持續動作。
examples: 衣服被勾破了。 (Clothes were torn.)
扶著牆走。 (Walk supporting oneself against the wall.)

practice.q: Complete: 他撞____了頭。 (Bumped and broke/bruised...)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 你沒事吧？臉色發青。
expansion_dialogue.py: nǐ méi shì ba? liǎn sè fā qīng.
expansion_dialogue.en: Are you okay? Your face is pale/blueish.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 我可能有點兒中暑，頭暈得厲害。
expansion_dialogue.py: wǒ kě néng yǒu diǎn r zhòng shǔ, tóu yūn de lì hai.
expansion_dialogue.en: I might have a slight heatstroke; my head is spinning badly.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 快到樹蔭下坐一會兒，喝點兒鹽水。
expansion_dialogue.py: kuài dào shù yīn xià zuò yī huì r, hē diǎn r yán shuǐ.
expansion_dialogue.en: Quickly sit under the shade of the tree for a bit and drink some saltwater.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 好，謝謝。今天太陽實在是太毒了。
expansion_dialogue.py: hǎo, xiè xie. jīn tiān tài yáng shí zài shì tài dú le.
expansion_dialogue.en: Okay, thanks. The sun is really too fierce today.

title: At the Park
story_description: 馬克和大衛在週末去公園放鬆。他們討論了公園裡的各種活動並提出建議。
story_intro: 天氣晴朗，馬克和大衛來到市中心公園。
公園裡有很多人在活動。
他們看到有人放風箏、有人跳舞。
他們決定先散步，然後租腳踏車。
他們練習提出建議和描述公園景色。

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 大衛，看！今天的公園真熱鬧啊。
dialogue.py: dà wèi, kàn! jīn tiān de gōng yuán zhēn rè nao a.
dialogue.en: David, look! The park is really lively today.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 是啊。天氣這麼好，大家都出來活動了。那邊有人在放風箏呢。
dialogue.py: shì a. tiān qì zhè me hǎo, dà jiā dōu chū lái huó dòng le. nà biān yǒu rén zài fàng fēng zhēng ne.
dialogue.en: Yeah. The weather is so good, everyone is out for activities. Someone's flying a kite over there.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 哇，風箏飛得真高！我們要不要也買一個來放？
dialogue.py: wa, fēng zhēng fēi de zhēn gāo! wǒ men yào bù yào yě mǎi yī gè lái fàng?
dialogue.en: Wow, the kite is flying so high! Should we also buy one to fly?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 要不先散散步吧？我想去湖邊走走，那裡的風景不錯。
dialogue.py: yào bù xiān sàn san bù ba? wǒ xiǎng qù hú biān zǒu zou, nà lǐ de fēng jǐng bù cuò.
dialogue.en: How about we take a stroll first? I want to walk by the lake; the scenery there is good.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好主意。你看，草地上有很多人在野餐，我們下午也可以試試。
dialogue.py: hǎo zhǔ yì. nǐ kàn, cǎo dì shàng yǒu hěn duō rén zài yě cān, wǒ men xià wǔ yě kě yǐ shì shi.
dialogue.en: Good idea. Look, there are many people picnicking on the grass; we can try that this afternoon too.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。散完步，我們去租兩輛腳踏車騎一圈，好嗎？
dialogue.py: méi wèn tí. sàn wán bù, wǒ men qù zū liǎng liàng jiǎo tà chē qí yī quān, hǎo ma?
dialogue.en: No problem. After the stroll, let's rent two bicycles and ride a lap, okay?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好啊。我聽說這公園的環湖小路騎車很舒服。
dialogue.py: hǎo a. wǒ tīng shuō zhè gōng yuán de huán hú xiǎo lù qí chē hěn shū fu.
dialogue.en: Sure. I heard the lakeside path in this park is very comfortable for cycling.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 那邊還有人在跳廣場舞，音樂聲挺大的。
dialogue.py: nà biān hái yǒu rén zài tiào guǎng chǎng wǔ, yīn yuè shēng tǐng dà de.
dialogue.en: There are also people over there doing square dancing; the music is quite loud.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 那也是公園的一大特色。你看那些老人家跳得多有勁兒！
dialogue.py: nà yě shì gōng yuán de yī dà tè sè. nǐ kàn nà xiē lǎo rén jiā tiào de duō yǒu jìn r!
dialogue.en: That's also a major feature of the park. Look how energetic those elderly people are dancing!

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 對，非常有活力。走吧，我們先去湖邊。
dialogue.py: duì, fēi cháng yǒu huó lì. zǒu ba, wǒ men xiān qù hú biān.
dialogue.en: Yes, very energetic. Let's go; we'll head to the lake first.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好的，出發！今天真是放鬆的好日子。
dialogue.py: hǎo de, chū fā! jīn tiān zhēn shì fàng sōng de hǎo rì zi.
dialogue.en: Okay, let's go! Today is really a good day for relaxing.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 希望以後每週末都能這麼過。
dialogue.py: xī wàng yǐ hòu měi zhōu mò dōu néng zhè me guò.
dialogue.en: I hope every weekend can be spent like this in the future.

key_sentences.en: How about taking a stroll first.
Go for a walk by the lake.

expansion_dialogue.py: nà jiù qù pá shān ba. shān shàng de kōng qì hěn qīng xīn.
expansion_dialogue.en: Then let's go hiking. The air on the mountain is very fresh.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 好，我也想活動一下身體。
expansion_dialogue.py: hǎo, wǒ yě xiǎng huó dòng yī xià shēn tǐ.
expansion_dialogue.en: Okay, I want to move my body a bit too.

review.speaking: Suggest three different outdoor activities to a friend in Chinese.
review.self_check: 你能用中文提出建議並描述戶外景觀和活動嗎？

title: Taking Photos
story_description: 馬克和大衛在公園裡互相拍照。他們討論了姿勢、背景和拍照的技巧。
story_intro: 馬克帶了新買的耳機和相機。
大衛幫馬克拍幾張帥氣的照片。
他們在湖邊和花園裡尋找好的背景。
他們討論了拍照的姿勢和光線。
他們練習給出具體的攝影指令。

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 大衛，這風景太美了。你能幫我拍幾張照片嗎？
dialogue.py: dà wèi, zhè fēng jǐng tài měi le. nǐ néng bāng wǒ pāi jǐ zhāng zhào piàn ma?
dialogue.en: David, this scenery is so beautiful. Can you help me take a few photos?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 沒問題！你想在哪裡拍？
dialogue.py: méi wèn tí! nǐ xiǎng zài nǎ lǐ pāi?
dialogue.en: No problem! Where do you want to take them?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 先在湖邊拍一張吧。我站在這棵樹旁邊。
dialogue.py: xiān zài hú biān pāi yī zhāng ba. wǒ zhàn zài zhè kē shù páng biān.
dialogue.en: Take one by the lake first. I'll stand next to this tree.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 好。你往後退一點兒，把湖面也拍進去。對，就那裡。
dialogue.py: hǎo. nǐ wǎng hòu tuì yī diǎn r, bǎ hú miàn yě pāi jìn qù. duì, jiù zài nà lǐ.
dialogue.en: Okay. Step back a bit, and I'll include the lake surface. Yes, right there.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 現在姿勢可以嗎？我要笑嗎？
dialogue.py: xiàn zài zī shì kě yǐ ma? wǒ yào xiào ma?
dialogue.en: Is the pose okay now? Should I smile?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 自然一點兒就好。看這裡，三、二、一，茄子！
dialogue.py: zì rán yī diǎn r jiù hǎo. kàn zhè lǐ, sān, èr, yī, qié zi!
dialogue.en: Just be natural. Look here, three, two, one, cheese!

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: （看照片）拍得不錯！但光線是不是有點兒暗？
dialogue.py: (kàn zhào piàn) pāi de bù cuò! dàn guāng xiàn shì bù shì yǒu diǎn r àn?
dialogue.en: (Looking at photo) Not bad! But is the light a bit dim?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 是有點兒。你背對著陽光了，所以臉部有點兒黑。
dialogue.py: shì yǒu diǎn r. nǐ bèi duì zhe yáng guāng le, suǒ yǐ liǎn bù yǒu diǎn r hēi.
dialogue.en: A bit. You're facing away from the sun, so your face is a bit dark.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 那我們換個方向，去那個花壇旁邊拍吧。那裡光線好。
dialogue.py: wǒ men huàn gè fāng xiàng, qù nà gè huā tán páng biān pāi ba. nà lǐ guāng xiàn hǎo.
dialogue.en: Let's change direction and go over to that flower bed. The light is good there.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 好。這次你側過身去，假裝在看花。
dialogue.py: hǎo. zhè cì nǐ cè guò shēn qù, jiǎ zhuāng zài kàn huā.
dialogue.en: Okay. This time turn your body to the side and pretend to be looking at the flowers.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 這樣嗎？手要放在哪裡？
dialogue.py: zhè yàng ma? shǒu yào fàng zài nǎ lǐ?
dialogue.en: Like this? Where should I put my hands?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 手輕輕摸一下花瓣。對，別動！這張感覺非常好。
dialogue.py: shǒu qīng qīng mō yī xià huā bàn. duì, bié dòng! zhè zhāng gǎn jué fēi cháng hǎo.
dialogue.en: Gently touch the petals. Yes, don't move! This one feels very good.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 太棒了！我也幫你拍幾張。換你站過去了。
dialogue.py: tài bàng le! wǒ yě bāng nǐ pāi jǐ zhāng. huàn nǐ zhàn guò qù le.
dialogue.en: Great! I'll take a few for you too. Your turn to stand over there.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 行，我們多拍幾張留念。
dialogue.py: xíng, wǒ men duō pāi jǐ zhāng liú niàn.
dialogue.en: Fine; let's take a few more as souvenirs.

key_sentences.en: The light is a bit dim.
Pretend to be looking at flowers.

vocabulary.meaning: to keep as a souvenir / keepsake

speaking.part_b: Role-play: 你想讓路人幫你拍照。告訴他背景要噴泉（pēn quán）。請他多拍幾張，橫著拍一張，豎著拍一張。最後謝謝路人。
part_c: 你喜歡自拍嗎？
你拍照時最常做的姿勢是什麼？

comprehension.q: 馬克想在哪裡拍第一張照片？
大衛建議馬克怎麼做來拍到湖面？

在大衛的指導下，第二張照片馬克做了什麼動作？
他們為什麼要多拍幾張照片？

true_false.q: 馬克覺得今天的風景不漂亮。
拍照時大家常喊'茄子'。
第二個拍照地點在花壇旁邊。
馬克不願意幫大衛拍照。
大衛覺得拍照姿勢要自然。

passage.title: Taking Photos Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克帶了新買的耳機和相機。大衛幫馬克拍幾張帥氣的照片。他們在湖邊和花園裡尋找好的背景。他們討論了拍照的姿勢和光線。他們練習給出具體的攝影指令。
passage.en: David, this scenery is so beautiful. Can you help me take a few photos? No problem! Where do you want to take them? Take one by the lake first. I'll stand next to this tree. Okay. Step back a bit, and I'll include the lake surface. Yes, right there. Is the pose okay now? Should I smile? Just be natural. Look here, three, two, one, cheese!
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: 請寫 3 到 5 句話描述你手機裡最喜歡的一張照片。它是什麼時候、在哪裡拍的？照片裡有誰？你為什麼喜歡它？

grammar.explanation: 使用 '...著' 表示狀態的持續 (背對著)。趨向補語 'V + 進去'。動詞短語 '拍一張'、'拍幾張'。
examples: 把話聽進去。 (Listen to the words [and absorb them].)
合影留念 (Take a photo as souvenir)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 你的攝影技術進步很大啊！這幾張大片很有意境。
expansion_dialogue.py: nǐ de shè yǐng jì shù jìn bù hěn dà a! zhè jǐ zhāng dà piàn hěn yǒu yì jìng.
expansion_dialogue.en: Your photography skills have improved a lot! These shots are very atmospheric.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 哪裡，主要是環境好，光線也給力。
expansion_dialogue.py: nǎ lǐ, zhǔ yào shì huán jìng hǎo, guāng xiàn yě gěi lì.
expansion_dialogue.en: Not at all; it's mainly that the environment is good and the lighting is helpful.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 你用的是單反相機還是手機？
expansion_dialogue.py: nǐ yòng de shì dān fǎn xiàng jī hái shì shǒu jī?
expansion_dialogue.en: Are you using a DSLR camera or a phone?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 這幾張是用新款手機拍的。現在的手機功能真的很強大。
expansion_dialogue.py: zhè jǐ zhāng shì yòng xīn kuǎn shǒu jī pāi de. xiàn zài de shǒu jī gōng néng zhēn de hěn qiáng dà.
expansion_dialogue.en: These few were taken with the new phone. Phone functions are really powerful now.

review.speaking: Give instructions for taking a photo (pose, background, countdown).

title: Review Story: Problems and Solutions
story_description: 馬克回顧了他在 Stage 3 遇到的一些小麻煩和他是如何解決這些問題的。他學會了預約、修東西、寄包裹等生活技能。
story_intro: 馬克在日記裡總結了這幾週的生活。
他遇到過牙痛、手機沒電、電腦變慢等問題。
他學會了如何尋求幫助和辦理各種手續。
他覺得自己的中文溝通能力變強了。
他準備迎接更高難度的挑戰。

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 這幾週的生活真是充滿挑戰，但也學到了很多。
dialogue.py: zhè jǐ zhōu de shēng huó zhēn shì chōng mǎn tiǎo zhàn, dàn yě xué dào le hěn duō.
dialogue.en: Life these few weeks has really been full of challenges, but I've also learned a lot.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 首先，我學會了怎麼預約看病。上次牙疼，我成功打電話預約了牙醫。
dialogue.py: shǒu xiān, wǒ xué huì le zěn me yù yuē kàn bìng. shàng cì yá téng, wǒ chéng gōng dǎ diàn huà yù yuē le yá yī.
dialogue.en: First, I learned how to make medical appointments. When I had a toothache last time, I successfully called to book a dentist.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 雖然中途因為考試更改了時間，但手續辦得很順利。
dialogue.py: suī rán zhōng tú yīn wèi kǎo shì gēng gǎi le shí jiān, dàn shǒu xù bàn de hěn shùn lì.
dialogue.en: Although I changed the time halfway because of an exam, the procedures went smoothly.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 另外，我還去銀行開了戶，還學會了在郵局寄包裹。
dialogue.py: lìng wài, wǒ hái qù yín háng kāi le hù, hái xué huì le zài yóu jú jì bāo guǒ.
dialogue.en: Additionally, I went to the bank to open an account and learned how to send packages at the post office.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 寄到加拿大的包裹雖然是普通空運，但也準時送到了。
dialogue.py: jì dào jiā ná dà de bāo guǒ suī rán shì pǔ tōng kōng yùn, dàn yě zhǔn shí sòng dào le.
dialogue.en: The package sent to Canada arrived on time, even though it was regular airmail.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 最難忘的是有一次手機沒電，我急著聯繫大衛。
dialogue.py: zuì nán wàng de shì yǒu yī cì shǒu jī méi diàn, wǒ jí zhe lián xì dà wèi.
dialogue.en: The most unforgettable was when my phone died and I was in a hurry to contact David.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 幸好遇到一位熱心人，借我手機打電話，真的太感謝他了。
dialogue.py: xìng hǎo yù dào yī wèi rè xīn rén, jiè wǒ shǒu jī dǎ diàn huà, zhēn de tài gǎn xiè tā le.
dialogue.en: Luckily I met a warm-hearted person who lent me a phone; I'm really so thankful to him.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 還有在市場買菜，我現在已經學會講價和稱重量了。
dialogue.py: hái yǒu zài shì chǎng mǎi cài, wǒ xiàn zài yǐ jīng xué huì jiǎng jià hé chēng zhòng liàng le.
dialogue.en: Also buying food at the market; I've now learned to bargain and weigh things.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 這讓我感受到地道的市井生活，挺有意思的。
dialogue.py: zhè ràng wǒ gǎn shòu dào dì dào de shì jǐng shēng huó, tǐng yǒu yì si de.
dialogue.en: This let me experience authentic market life; it's quite interesting.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 雖然生活中總有各種各樣的小問題，但只要冷靜面對，總能找到解決辦法。
dialogue.py: suī rán shēng huó zhōng zǒng yǒu gè zhǒng gè yàng de xiǎo wèn tí, dàn zhǐ yào lěng jìng miàn duì, zǒng néng zhǎo dào jiě jué bàn fǎ.
dialogue.en: Although there are always various small problems in life, as long as you face them calmly, you can always find a solution.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我的中文也在這一個個'解決問題'的過程中進步了。
dialogue.py: wǒ de zhōng wén yě zài zhè yī gè gè 'jiě jué wèn tí' de guò chéng zhōng jìn bù le.
dialogue.en: My Chinese has also improved through this process of 'solving problems' one by one.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 繼續努力，Stage 4，我來了！
dialogue.py: jì xù nǔ lì, Stage 4, wǒ lái le!
dialogue.en: Keep working hard; Stage 4, here I come!

passage.title: Review Story: Problems and Solutions Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克在日記裡總結了這幾週的生活。他遇到過牙痛、手機沒電、電腦變慢等問題。他學會了如何尋求幫助和辦理各種手續。他覺得自己的中文溝通能力變強了。他準備迎接更高難度的挑戰。
passage.en: Life these few weeks has really been full of challenges, but I've also learned a lot. First, I learned how to make medical appointments. When I had a toothache last time, I successfully called to book a dentist. Although I changed the time halfway because of an exam, the procedures went smoothly. Additionally, I went to the bank to open an account and learned how to send packages at the post office. The package sent to Canada arrived on time, even though it was regular airmail. The most unforgettable was when my phone died and I was in a hurry to contact David.

grammar.explanation: Review Stage 3: '首先...另外...' (listing), '雖然...但...' (contrast), '幸好' (luckily), '只要...就...' (condition).
examples: 首先是聽力，另外是閱讀。 (First listening, additionally reading.)
雖然難，但我喜歡。 (Hard, but I like it.)

practice.q: Complete: ___要你來，我就去。 (As long as...)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 恭喜你完成了 Stage 3！你覺得收穫最大的是什麼？
expansion_dialogue.py: gōng xǐ nǐ wán chéng le Stage 3! nǐ jué de shōu huò zuì dà de shì shén me?
expansion_dialogue.en: Congratulations on finishing Stage 3! What do you think is your greatest gain?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 謝謝！我覺得現在處理日常瑣事自信多了，不再害怕開口說話。
expansion_dialogue.py: xiè xie! wǒ jué de xiàn zài chǔ lǐ rì cháng suǒ shì zì xìn duō le, bù zài hài pà kāi kǒu shuō huà.
expansion_dialogue.en: Thanks! I feel much more confident handling daily chores now and am no longer afraid to speak out.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 這就是進步。下一階段我們會學更多表達觀點的內容。
expansion_dialogue.py: zhè jiù shì jìn bù. xià yī jiē duàn wǒ men huì xué gèng duō biǎo dá guān diǎn de nèi róng.
expansion_dialogue.en: That is progress. In the next stage, we will learn more about expressing viewpoints.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 太好了，我已經準備好迎接新的挑戰了！
expansion_dialogue.py: tài hǎo le, wǒ yǐ jīng zhǔn bèi hǎo yíng jiē xīn de tiǎo zhàn le!
expansion_dialogue.en: Great; I'm already prepared to meet new challenges!

title: Planning a Trip to Japan
story_description: 馬克和大衛計劃暑假去日本旅行。他們正在討論機票、住宿和行程安排。
story_intro: 暑假快到了。
馬克想去日本旅遊。
大衛對日本的文化和美食很感興趣。
他們決定一起制定一份詳細的旅遊計劃。
他們練習討論預算、時間和景點。

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 大衛，暑假你有什麼打算？要不要跟我一起去日本旅遊？
dialogue.py: dà wèi, shǔ jià nǐ yǒu shén me dǎ suàn? yào bù yào gēn wǒ yī qǐ qù rì běn lǚ yóu?
dialogue.en: David, what are your plans for summer vacation? Do you want to go to Japan for a trip with me?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 好啊！我一直想去京都看看。那裡的古建築很有名。
dialogue.py: hǎo a! wǒ yī zhí xiǎng qù jīng dū kàn kàn. nà lǐ de gǔ jiàn zhù hěn yǒu míng.
dialogue.en: Sure! I've always wanted to visit Kyoto. The ancient architecture there is very famous.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我也是。那我們得先看看機票，聽說早點兒訂能便宜不少。
dialogue.py: wǒ yě shì. nà wǒ men děi xiān kàn kàn jī piào, tīng shuō zǎo diǎn r dìng néng pián yi bù shǎo.
dialogue.en: Me too. Then we have to look at flight tickets first; I heard booking early can be quite a bit cheaper.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 對。除了機票，住宿也是個大問題。你預算多少？
dialogue.py: duì. chú le jī piào, zhù sù yě shì gè dà wèn tí. nǐ yù suàn duō shǎo?
dialogue.en: Right. Besides tickets, accommodation is also a big issue. What's your budget?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我希望住宿費能控制在每天三千台幣以內。住青年旅館也可以。
dialogue.py: wǒ xī wàng zhù sù fèi néng kòng zhì zài měi tiān sān qiān tái bì yǐ nèi. zhù qīng nián lǚ guǎn yě kě yǐ.
dialogue.en: I hope the accommodation fee can be controlled within 3000 NTD per day. Staying in a youth hostel is also fine.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 青年旅館挺好的，還能認識來自世界各地的朋友。我們要在那裡待多久？
dialogue.py: qīng nián lǚ guǎn tǐng hǎo de, hái néng rèn shi lái zì shì jiè gè dì de péng you. wǒ men yào zài nà lǐ dāi duō jiǔ?
dialogue.en: Youth hostels are quite good; you can also meet friends from all over the world. How long are we going to stay there?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 大概十天吧。我想去東京、京都和大阪。
dialogue.py: dà gài shí tiān ba. wǒ xiǎng qù dōng jīng, jīng dū hé dà bǎn.
dialogue.en: About ten days. I want to go to Tokyo, Kyoto, and Osaka.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 行程會不會太趕了？日本的交通很發達，但景點也很多。
dialogue.py: xíng chéng huì bù huì tài gǎn le? rì běn de jiāo tōng hěn fā dá, dàn jǐng diǎn yě hěn duō.
dialogue.en: Will the itinerary be too rushed? Japan's transportation is developed, but there are also many attractions.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 那我們就精簡一下行程。你最想吃什麼？壽司還是拉麵？
dialogue.py: nà wǒ men jiù jīng jiǎn yī xià xíng chéng. nǐ zuì xiǎng chī shén me? shòu sī hái shì lā miàn?
dialogue.en: Then we'll simplify the itinerary a bit. What do you want to eat most? Sushi or ramen?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 我都要試試！聽說大阪的章魚燒也很地道。
dialogue.py: wǒ dōu yào shì shi! tīng shuō dà bǎn de zhāng yú shāo yě hěn dì dào.
dialogue.en: I want to try both! I heard Osaka's takoyaki is also very authentic.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好，那一言為定。我們這週末就把機票和酒店訂好。
dialogue.py: hǎo, nà yī yán wéi dìng. wǒ men zhè zhōu mò jiù bǎ jī piào hé jiǔ diàn dìng hǎo.
dialogue.en: Okay, then it's a deal. We'll book the tickets and hotels this weekend.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，我已經開始期待了！
dialogue.py: méi wèn tí, wǒ yǐ jīng kāi shí qī dài le!
dialogue.en: No problem; I've already started looking forward to it!

speaking.part_b: Role-play: 你想和朋友去台南旅行。討論先去哪裡（古蹟），然後吃什麼（牛肉湯）。朋友擔心預算不夠，你提議住便宜的民宿。
part_c: 你喜歡自助旅行還是跟團旅行？
你出國旅遊最看重什麼？

comprehension.q: 馬克和大衛計劃什麼時候去日本？
大衛為什麼想去京都？
馬克希望每天的住宿費控制在多少台幣以內？
大衛對行程安排有什麼擔憂？
他們打算什麼時候訂機票和酒店？

true_false.q: 馬克覺得早點訂機票可以省錢。
大衛不願意住青年旅館。
他們計劃在日本待半個月。
大衛想吃大阪的章魚燒。
他們最後達成了一致意見。

fill_blank.q: 住宿費能控____在三千以內。

passage.title: Planning a Trip to Japan Listening Passage
passage.zh: 暑假快到了。馬克想去日本旅遊。大衛對日本的文化和美食很感興趣。他們決定一起制定一份詳細的旅遊計劃。他們練習討論預算、時間和景點。
passage.en: David, what are your plans for summer vacation? Do you want to go to Japan for a trip with me? Sure! I've always wanted to visit Kyoto. The ancient architecture there is very famous. Me too. Then we have to look at flight tickets first; I heard booking early can be quite a bit cheaper. Right. Besides tickets, accommodation is also a big issue. What's your budget? I hope the accommodation fee can be controlled within 3000 NTD per day. Staying in a youth hostel is also fine. Youth hostels are quite good; you can also meet friends from all over the world. How long are we going to stay there? About ten days. I want to go to Tokyo, Kyoto, and Osaka.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: 請寫 3 到 5 句話描述你的一次旅遊計劃：目的地在哪裡？預算大約是多少？你最想去哪個景點？

grammar.explanation: 使用 '...以內' 表示範圍。'不少' 表示很多。使用 '趕' 描述時間緊迫。成語 '一言為定'。
examples: 學了不少新詞。 (Learned quite a few new words.)
我得快走，時間太趕了。 (I have to go fast; time is too tight.)
期待旅行 (Looking forward to trip)

practice.q: Translate: The itinerary is too rushed.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 去日本需要辦簽證嗎？
expansion_dialogue.py: qù rì běn xū yào bàn qiān zhèng ma?
expansion_dialogue.en: Do we need a visa for Japan?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 大部分國家免簽，但最好還是查一下官網。
expansion_dialogue.py: dà bù fèn guó jiā miǎn qiān, dàn zuì hǎo hái shì chá yī xià guān wǎng.
expansion_dialogue.en: Most countries are visa-free, but it's best to check the official website.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 官網顯示現在可以申請電子簽證了，挺方便的。
expansion_dialogue.py: guān wǎng xiǎn shì xiàn zài kě yǐ shēn qǐng diàn zǐ qiān zhèng le, tǐng fāng biàn de.
expansion_dialogue.en: The website shows e-visas can be applied for now; it's quite convenient.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 那就好。證件一定要提前準備好，免得麻煩。
expansion_dialogue.py: nà jiù hǎo. zhèng jiàn yī dìng yào tí qián zhǔn bèi hǎo, miǎn de má fan.
expansion_dialogue.en: That's good. Documents must be prepared in advance to avoid trouble.

review.speaking: Discuss a travel budget and itinerary with a partner.
review.self_check: 你能用中文討論旅遊預算、住宿和行程安排嗎？

title: Checking into a Hotel
story_description: 馬克抵達了日本的酒店。他正在前台辦理入住手續，並詢問酒店設施。
story_intro: 馬克抵達了東京。
他拖著行李來到酒店。
他在前台出示了預訂信息。
他向工作人員詢問早餐和WiFi。
他拿到了房卡並上樓休息。

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.zh: 您好！歡迎光臨。請問有預訂嗎？
dialogue.py: nín hǎo! huān yíng guāng lín. qǐng wèn yǒu yù dìng ma?
dialogue.en: Hello! Welcome. Do you have a reservation?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 有的。我姓馬，叫馬克。這是在網上預訂的確認單。
dialogue.py: yǒu de. wǒ xìng mǎ, jiào mǎ kè. zhè shì zài wǎng shàng yù dìng de què rèn dān.
dialogue.en: Yes. My last name is Mark, full name Mark. This is the confirmation slip from the online booking.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.zh: 好的，馬克先生。請出示您的護照，我們需要登記一下。
dialogue.py: hǎo de, mǎ kè xiān sheng. qǐng chū shì nín de hù zhào, wǒ men xū yào dēng jì yī xià.
dialogue.en: Okay, Mr. Mark. Please show your passport; we need to register it.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 給您。請問我預訂的是大床房還是雙人房？
dialogue.py: gěi nín. qǐng wèn wǒ yù dìng de shì dà chuáng fáng hái shì shuāng rén fáng?
dialogue.en: Here you go. Did I book a king room or a twin room?

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.zh: 您預訂的是大床房，禁菸型，在八樓。這是您的房卡。
dialogue.py: nín yù dìng de shì dà chuáng fáng, jìn yān xíng, zài bā lóu. zhè shì nín de fáng kǎ.
dialogue.en: You booked a king room, non-smoking, on the 8th floor. Here is your room card.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。請問早餐在幾點？在哪裡吃？
dialogue.py: xiè xie. qǐng wèn zǎo fàn zài jǐ diǎn? zài nǎ lǐ chī?
dialogue.en: Thanks. What time is breakfast? Where is it served?

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.zh: 早餐在二樓餐廳，從早上七點到十點提供。是自助餐形式。
dialogue.py: zǎo fàn zài èr lóu cān tīng, cóng zǎo shang qī diǎn dào shí diǎn tí gōng. shì zì zhù cān xíng shì.
dialogue.en: Breakfast is in the 2nd-floor restaurant, served from 7:00 to 10:00 AM. It's buffet style.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 明白了。房間裡有免費的WiFi嗎？密碼是什麼？
dialogue.py: míng bai le. fáng jiān lǐ yǒu miǎn fèi de WiFi ma? mì mǎ shì shén me?
dialogue.en: Understood. Is there free WiFi in the room? What's the password?

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.zh: 有的。WiFi密碼印在房卡套上，您可以看一下。
dialogue.py: yǒu de. WiFi mì mǎ yìn zài fáng kǎ tào shàng, nín kě yǐ kàn yī xià.
dialogue.en: Yes. The WiFi password is printed on the room card holder; you can take a look.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 喔，看到了。另外，請問附近有推薦的便利商店嗎？
dialogue.py: ō, kàn dào le. lìng wài, qǐng wèn fù jìn yǒu tuī jiàn de biàn lì shāng diàn ma?
dialogue.en: Oh, I see it. Additionally, is there a recommended convenience store nearby?

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.zh: 出酒店大門右轉，走五十米就有一家 7-11。
dialogue.py: chū jiǔ diàn dà mén yòu zhuǎn, zǒu wǔ shí mǐ jiù yǒu yī jiā 7-11.
dialogue.en: Turn right out of the main hotel door; there's a 7-11 after walking 50 meters.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 太好了，謝謝。麻煩幫我把行李送到房間可以嗎？
dialogue.py: tài hǎo le, xiè xie. má fan bāng wǒ bǎ xíng li sòng dào fáng jiān kě yǐ ma?
dialogue.en: Great, thanks. Could you help me send the luggage to the room, please?

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。服務員一會兒就幫您送上去。祝您入住愉快！
dialogue.py: méi wèn tí. fú wù yuán yī huì r jiù bāng nín sòng shàng qù. zhù nín rù zhù yú kuài!
dialogue.en: No problem. The bellhop will send it up for you in a bit. Enjoy your stay!

speaking.part_b: Role-play: 你到酒店了。前台說查不到你的預訂。你拿出確認單並解釋是三天前訂的。最後前台查到了，並幫你升級了房間。
part_c: 你住酒店最在意什麼（價格、地點、服務）？
你喜歡吃酒店的自助早餐嗎？

comprehension.q: 馬克是用什麼方式向工作人員證明他有預訂的？
options: B. 出示網上預訂確認單

comprehension.q: 馬克預訂的是什麼類型的房間？
早餐在酒店的第幾層？
酒店的WiFi密碼在哪裡可以找到？
距離酒店最近的便利商店大約有多遠？

true_false.q: 馬克的護照不需要出示。
馬克的房間在八樓。
早餐是送餐到房間的形式。
酒店大門右轉有 7-11。
馬克需要自己把行李提上樓。

passage.title: Checking into a Hotel Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克抵達了東京。他拖著行李來到酒店。他在前台出示了預訂信息。他向工作人員詢問早餐和WiFi。他拿到了房卡並上樓休息。
passage.en: Hello! Welcome. Do you have a reservation? Yes. My last name is Mark, full name Mark. This is the confirmation slip from the online booking. Okay, Mr. Mark. Please show your passport; we need to register it. Here you go. Did I book a king room or a twin room? You booked a king room, non-smoking, on the 8th floor. Here is your room card. Thanks. What time is breakfast? Where is it served? Breakfast is in the 2nd-floor restaurant, served from 7:00 to 10:00 AM. It's buffet style.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: 請寫 3 到 5 句話描述你的一次酒店入住經歷。你對房間和服務滿意嗎？為什麼？

grammar.explanation: 使用 '從...到...' 表示時間範圍。'V + 上去/下來' 的複合趨向補語。'印在...' 表示結果位置。
examples: 把行李送上去。 (Send the luggage up.)
把字印在衣服上。 (Print characters on the clothes.)

practice.q: Complete: 服務員幫他送____去了。 (Send it up...)
Complete: 密碼印在房卡套____。 (On the card holder.)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 你好，我想退房。這是我的房卡。
expansion_dialogue.py: nǐ hǎo, wǒ xiǎng tuì fáng. zhè shì wǒ de fáng kǎ.
expansion_dialogue.en: Hello, I'd like to check out. Here is my room card.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 好的。您在房間裡有其他的消費嗎？比如迷你吧？
expansion_dialogue.py: hǎo de. nín zài fáng jiān lǐ yǒu qí tā de xiāo fèi ma? bǐ rú mí nǐ ba?
expansion_dialogue.en: Okay. Did you have any other charges in the room? Like the mini-bar?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 沒有。我只喝了免費的瓶裝水。
expansion_dialogue.py: méi yǒu. wǒ zhǐ hē le miǎn fèi de píng zhuāng shuǐ.
expansion_dialogue.en: No. I only drank the free bottled water.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 好的。押金我們會退回到您的信用卡。祝您旅途愉快！
expansion_dialogue.py: hǎo de. yā jīn wǒ men huì tuì huí dào nín de xìn yòng kǎ. zhù nín lǚ tú yú kuài!
expansion_dialogue.en: Okay. We will refund the deposit to your credit card. Have a nice trip!

review.speaking: Check into a hotel and ask about breakfast and WiFi in Chinese.
review.self_check: 你能用中文辦理入住、退房並詢問酒店服務設施嗎？

title: Taking the Shinkansen
story_description: 馬克要從東京坐新幹線去京都。他在車站買票並尋找月台。
story_intro: 馬克來到繁忙的東京車站。
他需要買一張去京都的新幹線車票。
他在自動售票機前操作。
他向工作人員詢問乘車的月台。
他順利登上了列車。

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，請問去京都的新幹線在哪裡買票？
dialogue.py: bù hǎo yì si, qǐng wèn qù jīng dū de xīn gàn xiàn zài nǎ lǐ mǎi piào?
dialogue.en: Excuse me, where do I buy tickets for the Shinkansen to Kyoto?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.zh: 那邊有綠色的自動售票機，或者您可以去人工窗口。
dialogue.py: nà biān yǒu lǜ sè de zì dòng shòu piào jī, huò zhě nín kě yǐ qù rén gōng chuāng kǒu.
dialogue.en: There are green automatic ticket machines over there, or you can go to the manned counter.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我想試試自動售票機。這台機器有中文界面嗎？
dialogue.py: wǒ xiǎng shì shi zì dòng shòu piào jī. zhè tái jī qì yǒu zhōng wén jiè miàn ma?
dialogue.en: I'd like to try the automatic machine. Does this machine have a Chinese interface?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.zh: 有的。請點擊屏幕右上角的'語言'按鈕選擇中文。
dialogue.py: yǒu de. qǐng diǎn jī píng mù yòu shàng jiǎo de 'yǔ yán' àn niǔ xuǎn zé zhōng wén.
dialogue.en: Yes. Please click the 'Language' button in the top right corner of the screen to select Chinese.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 看到了。我要買一張去京都的單程票。要指定席還是自由席？
dialogue.py: kàn dào le. wǒ yào mǎi yī zhāng qù jīng dū de dān chéng piào. yào zhǐ dìng xí hái shì zì yóu xí?
dialogue.en: I see it. I want to buy a one-way ticket to Kyoto. Reserved seat or unreserved seat?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.zh: 現在是旅遊旺季，建議您買指定席，保證有座位。
dialogue.py: xiàn zài shì lǚ yóu wàng jì, jiàn yì nín mǎi zhǐ dìng xí, bǎo zhèng yǒu zuò wèi.
dialogue.en: It's peak tourist season now; I suggest you buy a reserved seat to guarantee a seat.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好。買一張指定席，一共是一萬四千日元。可以用信用卡付嗎？
dialogue.py: hǎo. mǎi yī zhāng zhǐ dìng xí, yī gòng shì yī wàn sì qiān rì yuán. kě yǐ yòng xìn yòng kǎ fù ma?
dialogue.en: Okay. One reserved seat; total is 14,000 Yen. Can I pay by credit card?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.zh: 可以。票出了，請拿好。您的發車時間是十點半。
dialogue.py: kě yǐ. piào chū le, qǐng ná hǎo. nín de fā chē shí jiān shì shí diǎn bàn.
dialogue.en: Yes. The ticket is out; please take it. Your departure time is 10:30.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。請問去京都要在哪個月台乘車？
dialogue.py: xiè xie. qǐng wèn qù jīng dū yào zài nǎ gè yuè tái chéng chē?
dialogue.en: Thanks. Excuse me, which platform do I board for Kyoto?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.zh: 在十六號月台。請跟著地上的藍色指示標誌走。
dialogue.py: zài shí liù hào yuè tái. qǐng gēn zhe dì shàng de lán sè zhǐ shì biāo zhì zǒu.
dialogue.en: At platform 16. Please follow the blue directional signs on the floor.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 十六號月台...好的，離這裡遠嗎？
dialogue.py: shí liù hào yuè tái... hǎo de, lí zhè lǐ yuǎn ma?
dialogue.en: Platform 16... okay, is it far from here?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.zh: 不遠，走五分鐘就到了。祝您旅途愉快！
dialogue.py: bù yuǎn, zǒu wǔ fēn zhōng jiù dào le. zhù nín lǚ tú yú kuài!
dialogue.en: Not far; five minutes' walk. Have a nice trip!

speaking.part_b: Role-play: 你在台北車站。想買兩張去高雄的高鐵票。你問售票員最快的一班車是幾點。售票員說十一點。你買了兩張並問是在幾號月台。
part_c: 你喜歡坐火車還是飛機旅行？為什麼？
你覺得自動售票機方便嗎？

comprehension.q: 工作人員建議馬克去哪裡買票？
options: A. 綠色自動售票機或人工窗口

comprehension.q: 馬克要買去哪裡的車票？
為什麼工作人員建議買'指定席'？
options: B. 現在是旅遊旺季，為了保證有座位

comprehension.q: 馬克的車票一共多少錢？
馬克應該在哪個號碼的月台等車？

true_false.q: 自動售票機沒有中文語言。
馬克買的是往返票。
馬克可以用信用卡付費。
發車時間是早上九點半。
馬克需要跟著藍色的指示標誌走。

passage.title: Taking the Shinkansen Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克來到繁忙的東京車站。他需要買一張去京都的新幹線車票。他在自動售票機前操作。他向工作人員詢問乘車的月台。他順利登上了列車。
passage.en: Excuse me, where do I buy tickets for the Shinkansen to Kyoto? There are green automatic ticket machines over there, or you can go to the manned counter. I'd like to try the automatic machine. Does this machine have a Chinese interface? Yes. Please click the 'Language' button in the top right corner of the screen to select Chinese. I see it. I want to buy a one-way ticket to Kyoto. Reserved seat or unreserved seat? It's peak tourist season now; I suggest you buy a reserved seat to guarantee a seat. Okay. One reserved seat; total is 14,000 Yen. Can I pay by credit card?
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

grammar.explanation: 使用 '...還是...' 表二選一。'跟著' 表跟隨。'出' 作為結果補語 (票出了)。

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A

expansion_dialogue.py: huǒ chē kuài kāi le, wǒ men kuài diǎn r jiǎn piào jìn zhàn ba.
expansion_dialogue.en: The train is about to leave; let's hurry and check our tickets to enter the station.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B

expansion_dialogue.py: bié jí, wǒ de shēn fèn zhèng zhǎo bù dào le, děng wǒ yī xià!
expansion_dialogue.en: Don't worry; I can't find my ID card; wait for me a bit!

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 在你的大衣口袋裡嗎？或者在包的最下面？
expansion_dialogue.py: zài nǐ de dà yī kǒu dài lǐ ma? huò zhě zài bāo de zuì xià mian?
expansion_dialogue.en: Is it in your coat pocket? Or at the very bottom of the bag?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B

expansion_dialogue.py: ō, zhǎo dào le! zài qián bāo jiá céng lǐ. xià sǐ wǒ le.
expansion_dialogue.en: Oh, found it! In the wallet layer. Scared me to death.

title: Finding My Way in Kyoto
story_description: 馬克抵達了京都。他想去金閣寺，但地圖導航出了點問題。他向路人問路。
story_intro: 馬克走在京都古老的街道上。
他的手機信號不太穩定。
他想去著名的景點'金閣寺'。
他不確定該坐哪路公車。
他禮貌地向一位當地人尋求指引。

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，打擾一下。請問去金閣寺應該怎麼走？
dialogue.py: bù hǎo yì si, dǎ rǎo yī xià. qǐng wèn qù jīn gé sì yīng gāi zěn me zǒu?
dialogue.en: Excuse me, sorry to bother you. May I ask how to get to Kinkaku-ji?

dialogue.speaker: Local
dialogue.zh: 金閣寺離這裡有一段距離。你是想走路還是坐車？
dialogue.py: jīn gé sì lí zhè lǐ yǒu yī duàn jù lí. nǐ shì xiǎng zǒu lù hái shì zuò chē?
dialogue.en: Kinkaku-ji is quite a distance from here. Do you want to walk or take a vehicle?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我想坐公車。請問應該坐哪一路？
dialogue.py: wǒ xiǎng zuò gōng chē. qǐng wèn yīng gāi zuò nǎ yī lù?
dialogue.en: I want to take a bus. Which one should I take?

dialogue.speaker: Local
dialogue.zh: 你可以坐 205 路或者 101 路。公車站就在前面的十字路口左轉。
dialogue.py: nǐ kě yǐ zuò èr líng wǔ lù huò zhě yī líng yī lù. gōng chē zhàn jiù zài qián mian de shí zì lù kǒu zuǒ zhuǎn.
dialogue.en: You can take bus 205 or 101. The bus stop is just ahead at the intersection, turn left.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 十字路口左轉...好的。坐公車大概要多久？
dialogue.py: shí zì lù kǒu zuǒ zhuǎn... hǎo de. zuò gōng chē dà gài yào duō jiǔ?
dialogue.en: Turn left at the intersection... okay. Roughly how long does the bus take?

dialogue.speaker: Local
dialogue.zh: 大約三十分鐘吧。如果你怕坐過站，可以留意車上的電子屏幕。
dialogue.py: dà yuē sān shí fēn zhōng ba. rú guǒ nǐ pà zuò guò zhàn, kě yǐ liú yì chē shàng de diàn zǐ píng mù.
dialogue.en: About thirty minutes. If you're afraid of missing your stop, watch the electronic screen on the bus.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好的。公車票價是多少？可以用交通卡嗎？
dialogue.py: hǎo de. gōng chē piào jià shì duō shǎo? kě yǐ yòng jiāo tōng kǎ ma?
dialogue.en: Okay. How much is the bus fare? Can I use a transit card?

dialogue.speaker: Local
dialogue.zh: 成人票價是 230 日元。可以用西瓜卡或者其他通用的交通卡。
dialogue.py: chéng rén piào jià shì èr bǎi sān shí rì yuán. kě yǐ yòng xī guā kǎ huò zhě qí tā tōng yòng de jiāo tōng kǎ.
dialogue.en: Adult fare is 230 Yen. You can use Suica or other universal transit cards.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 明白了。下車後還要走很久嗎？
dialogue.py: míng bai le. xià chē hòu hái yào zǒu hěn jiǔ ma?
dialogue.en: Understood. After getting off, do I still have to walk long?

dialogue.speaker: Local
dialogue.zh: 不遠。下車後跟著人流走，大約五分鐘就能看到金閣寺的大門。
dialogue.py: bù yuǎn. xià chē hòu gēn zhe rén liú zǒu, dà yuē wǔ fēn zhōng jiù néng kàn dào jīn gé sì de dà mén.
dialogue.en: Not far. Follow the crowd after getting off; you'll see the gate of Kinkaku-ji in about five minutes.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 太感謝你了！你幫了大忙。
dialogue.py: tài gǎn xiè nǐ le! nǐ bāng le dà máng.
dialogue.en: Thank you so much! You've been a big help.

dialogue.speaker: Local
dialogue.zh: 不客氣。祝你在京都玩得開心！
dialogue.py: bù kè qì. zhù nǐ zài jīng dū wán de kāi xīn!
dialogue.en: You're welcome. Have a happy time in Kyoto!

key_sentences.en: Sorry to bother you / Excuse me.
Afraid of missing the stop (riding past).

passage.zh: 馬克走在京都古老的街道上。他的手機信號不太穩定。他想去著名的景點'金閣寺'。他不確定該坐哪路公車。他禮貌地向一位當地人尋求指引。

grammar.explanation: 使用 'V + 過' 表示動作超過限度 (坐過站)。'跟著' 導引動作。'一段' 描述距離或時間。

跟著音樂跳舞。 (Dance following the music.)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 請問這附近有洗手間嗎？
expansion_dialogue.py: qǐng wèn zhè fù jìn yǒu xǐ shǒu jiān ma?
expansion_dialogue.en: Excuse me, is there a restroom nearby?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 有的。往前走，過兩個店鋪，在拐角處就有一個公用洗手間。
expansion_dialogue.py: yǒu de. wǎng qián zǒu, guò liǎng gè diàn pù, zài guǎi jiǎo chù jiù yǒu yī gè gōng yòng xǐ shǒu jiān.
expansion_dialogue.en: Yes. Walk straight, pass two shops, and there's a public restroom at the corner.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 看到了。謝謝。那邊要收費嗎？
expansion_dialogue.py: kàn dào le. xiè xie. nà biān yào shōu fèi ma?
expansion_dialogue.en: I see it. Thanks. Does it charge a fee over there?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 不收費，是免費開放的。
expansion_dialogue.py: bù shōu fèi, shì miǎn fèi kāi fàng de.
expansion_dialogue.en: No charge; it's open for free.

title: Souvenir Shopping
story_description: 馬克在京都的一家手工藝品店挑選紀念品。他想給家人和朋友帶一些有日本特色的禮物。
story_intro: 馬克走進一家精美的商店。
店裡有很多漂亮的扇子和和服。
他想買一些輕便且有紀念意義的東西。
他向店員詢問產品的製作過程。
他最終挑選了幾樣滿意的禮物。

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 你好！這些手工扇子真精緻。是這裡製作的嗎？
dialogue.py: nǐ hǎo! zhè xiē shǒu gōng shàn zi zhēn jīng zhì. shì zhè lǐ zhì zuò de ma?
dialogue.en: Hello! These handmade fans are really exquisite. Are they made here?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 是的。我們店已經有兩百年的歷史了，所有扇子都是老師傅手工繪製的。
dialogue.py: shì de. wǒ men diàn yǐ jīng yǒu liǎng bǎi nián de lì shǐ le, suǒ yǒu shàn zi dōu shì lǎo shī fu shǒu gōng huì zhì de.
dialogue.en: Yes. Our shop has a 200-year history; all fans are hand-painted by old masters.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 難怪圖案看起來這麼生動。這把畫著櫻花的多少錢？
dialogue.py: nán guài tú àn kàn qǐ lái zhè me shēng dòng. zhè bǎ huà zhe yīng huā de duō shǎo qián?
dialogue.en: No wonder the patterns look so vivid. How much is this one with cherry blossoms painted on it?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 這把是真絲做的，價格是四千五百日元。送人的話，我們有精美的木盒包裝。
dialogue.py: zhè bǎ shì zhēn sī zuò de, jià gé shì sì qiān wǔ bǎi rì yuán. sòng rén de huà, wǒ men yǒu jīng měi de mù hé bāo zhuāng.
dialogue.en: This one is made of real silk; the price is 4,500 Yen. If it's a gift, we have exquisite wooden box packaging.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我也想買一些適合送給同學的小東西。你有什麼推薦嗎？
dialogue.py: wǒ yě xiǎng mǎi yī xiē shì hé sòng gěi tóng xué de xiǎo dōng xi. nǐ yǒu shén me tuī jiàn ma?
dialogue.en: I also want to buy some small things suitable for classmates. Do you have any recommendations?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 您可以看看這些陶瓷杯墊，或者精緻的御守。它們既便宜又好拿。
dialogue.py: nín kě yǐ kàn kàn zhè xiē táo cí bēi diàn, huò zhě jīng zhì de yù shǒu. tā men jì pián yi yòu hǎo ná.
dialogue.en: You can look at these ceramic coasters or exquisite omamori (charms). They're both cheap and easy to carry.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 御守是什麼意思？上面寫著不同的字。
dialogue.py: yù shǒu shì shén me yì si? shàng miàn xiě zhe bù tóng de zì.
dialogue.en: What does omamori mean? There are different words written on them.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 御守代表好運和保護。比如這款是祝學業進步的，這款是保佑健康的。
dialogue.py: yù shǒu dài biǎo hǎo yùn hé bǎo hù. bǐ rú zhè kuǎn shì zhù xué yè jìn bù de, zhè kuǎn shì bǎo yòu jiàn kāng de.
dialogue.en: Omamori represent good luck and protection. For example, this one is for academic progress, and this one is for health.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 太有意義了。我要五個'學業進步'的，還有三個'健康'的。
dialogue.py: tài yǒu yì yì le. wǒ yào wǔ gè 'xué yè jìn bù' de, hái yǒu sān gè 'jiàn kāng' de.
dialogue.en: That's very meaningful. I'll take five for 'academic progress' and three for 'health'.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 好的。還需要這把櫻花扇子嗎？
dialogue.py: hǎo de. hái xū yào zhè bǎ yīng huā shàn zi ma?
dialogue.en: Okay. Still want this cherry blossom fan?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 要的。一共多少錢？買這麼多有優惠嗎？
dialogue.py: yào de. yī gòng duō shǎo qián? mǎi zhè me duō yǒu yōu huì ma?
dialogue.en: Yes. How much total? Is there a discount for buying so many?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 總共是一萬零兩百日元。給您打個九折，算九千一百塊吧。
dialogue.py: zǒng gòng shì yī wàn líng liǎng bǎi rì yuán. gěi nín dǎ gè jiǔ zhé, suàn jiǔ qiān yī bǎi kuài ba.
dialogue.en: The total is 10,200 Yen. I'll give you a 10% discount; let's call it 9,100 Yen.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 太感謝了！幫我包裝好，謝謝。
dialogue.py: tài gǎn xiè le! bāng wǒ bāo zhuāng hǎo, xiè xie.
dialogue.en: Thank you so much! Please wrap them for me, thanks.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 不客氣。希望您的朋友會喜歡。
dialogue.py: bù kè qì. xī wàng nín de péng you huì xǐ huan.
dialogue.en: You're welcome. I hope your friends will like them.

key_sentences.en: Both cheap and easy to carry.

part_c: 你旅行時喜歡買什麼樣的紀念品？
