title: At the Airport Check-in
story_description: 馬克準備結束日本旅行回國。他在機場辦理登機手續並託運行李。
story_intro: 馬克來到成田機場。
他找到航空公司的櫃檯。
他需要換取登機證。
他向工作人員詢問行李規定。
他順利完成了登機手續並通過安檢。

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 你好，我想辦理去台北的登機手續。這是我的護照。
dialogue.py: nǐ hǎo, wǒ xiǎng bàn lǐ qù tái běi de dēng jī shǒu xù. zhè shì wǒ de hù zhào.
dialogue.en: Hello, I'd like to check in for the flight to Taipei. Here is my passport.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.zh: 好的，馬克先生。請問您有幾件行李需要託運？
dialogue.py: hǎo de, mǎ kè xiān sheng. qǐng wèn nín yǒu jǐ jiàn xíng li xū yào tuō yùn?
dialogue.en: Okay, Mr. Mark. How many pieces of luggage do you need to check in?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我有一件大行李箱。請問可以手提這兩個小包上飛機嗎？
dialogue.py: wǒ yǒu yī jiàn dà xíng li xiāng. qǐng wèn kě yǐ shǒu tí zhè liǎng gè xiǎo bāo shàng fēi jī ma?
dialogue.en: I have one large suitcase. May I carry these two small bags onto the plane?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.zh: 手提行李每人限重七公斤。您的行李箱重二十三公斤，剛好沒超重。
dialogue.py: shǒu tí xíng li měi rén xiàn zhòng qī gōng jīn. nín de xíng li xiāng zhòng èr shí sān gōng jīn, gāng hǎo méi chāo zhòng.
dialogue.en: Carry-on luggage is limited to 7kg per person. Your suitcase weighs 23kg, just right and not overweight.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 太好了。請問這班飛機準時起飛嗎？
dialogue.py: tài hǎo le. qǐng wèn zhè bān fēi jī zhǔn shí qǐ fēi ma?
dialogue.en: Great. Does this flight take off on time?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.zh: 目前顯示準時。這是您的登機證，請拿好。
dialogue.py: mù qián xiǎn shì zhǔn shí. zhè shì nín de dēng jī zhèng, qǐng ná hǎo.
dialogue.en: It currently shows on time. Here is your boarding pass, please take it.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 在哪個登機門？幾點開始登機？
dialogue.py: zài nǎ gè dēng jī mén? jǐ diǎn kāi shǐ dēng jī?
dialogue.en: At which boarding gate? What time does boarding start?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.zh: 在五十六號登機門。下午一點半開始登機。請提前半小時到達登機口。
dialogue.py: zài wǔ shí liù hào dēng jī mén. xià wǔ yī diǎn bàn kāi shǐ dēng jī. qǐng tí qián bàn xiǎo shí dào dá dēng jī kǒu.
dialogue.en: At gate 56. Boarding starts at 1:30 PM. Please arrive at the gate half an hour in advance.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 明白了。安檢在那邊嗎？
dialogue.py: míng bai le. ān jiǎn zài nà biān ma?
dialogue.en: Understood. Is security over there?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.zh: 對。請注意，液體、火機等違禁品不能帶上飛機。
dialogue.py: duì. qǐng zhù yì, yè tǐ, huǒ jī děng wéi jìn pǐn bù néng dài shàng fēi jī.
dialogue.en: Yes. Please note that liquids, lighters, and other prohibited items cannot be taken on board.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好的，我會注意的。謝謝！
dialogue.py: hǎo de, wǒ huì zhù yì de. xiè xie!
dialogue.en: Okay, I'll pay attention. Thanks!

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.zh: 不客氣。祝您航程愉快！
dialogue.py: bù kè qì. zhù nín háng chéng yú kuài!
dialogue.en: You're welcome. Have a pleasant flight!

vocabulary.example: 這部電梯限重一千公斤。
這家航空公司服務很好。

speaking.part_b: Role-play: 你在機場櫃檯。告訴工作人員你有兩件行李要託運。工作人員說你的行李超重了兩公斤，需要補交錢。你問可不可以拿出一些東西手提。
part_c: 你喜歡坐飛機旅行嗎？
你出國旅行通常帶幾件行李？

comprehension.q: 馬克要去哪個城市？
馬克的行李箱重多少公斤？
手提行李的限重是多少？
馬克在哪個號碼的登機門上飛機？
什麼時候開始登機？

true_false.q: 馬克的行李超重了。
飛機目前顯示會誤點。
馬克可以帶液體上飛機。
工作人員建議提前半小時到達登機口。
馬克辦理的是登機手續。

passage.title: At the Airport Check-in Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克來到成田機場。他找到航空公司的櫃檯。他需要換取登機證。他向工作人員詢問行李規定。他順利完成了登機手續並通過安檢。
passage.en: Hello, I'd like to check in for the flight to Taipei. Here is my passport. Okay, Mr. Mark. How many pieces of luggage do you need to check in? I have one large suitcase. May I carry these two small bags onto the plane? Carry-on luggage is limited to 7kg per person. Your suitcase weighs 23kg, just right and not overweight. Great. Does this flight take off on time? It currently shows on time. Here is your boarding pass, please take it. At which boarding gate? What time does boarding start?
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: 請寫 3 到 5 句話描述你的一次機場經歷。你當時去哪裡？手續辦得順利嗎？心情怎麼樣？

grammar.explanation: 使用 '剛好' 表示巧合或正好。'限重' 作為複合動詞。數量詞 '幾件'、'二十三公斤'。
examples: 這雙鞋剛好合腳。 (These shoes fit perfectly.)
這台電梯限重十人。 (This elevator is limited to 10 people.)
換取門票 (Exchange for a ticket)

practice.q: Translate: Just right, not too big.
Complete: 行李限____二十公斤。 (Limit weight...)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 請問換錢櫃檯在哪裡？我想換點兒日元。
expansion_dialogue.py: qǐng wèn huàn qián guì tái zài nǎ lǐ? wǒ xiǎng huàn diǎn r rì yuán.
expansion_dialogue.en: Excuse me, where is the currency exchange counter? I want to exchange some Yen.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 就在安檢口旁邊。現在匯率還不錯。
expansion_dialogue.py: jiù zài ān jiǎn kǒu páng biān. xiàn zài huì lǜ hái bù cuò.
expansion_dialogue.en: Right next to the security check. The exchange rate is not bad now.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 謝謝。那邊人多嗎？
expansion_dialogue.py: xiè xie. nà biān rén duō ma?
expansion_dialogue.en: Thanks. Are there many people there?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 不多，你現在去不用排隊。
expansion_dialogue.py: bù duō, nǐ xiàn zài qù bù yòng pái duì.
expansion_dialogue.en: Not many; you won't need to queue if you go now.

review.speaking: Inquire about baggage weight limits and boarding procedures at an airport.
review.self_check: 你能用中文辦理登機、託運行李並詢問登機口信息嗎？

title: Through Customs
story_description: 馬克回到台北後，正在通過海關。他如實申報了行李中的物品，並回答了工作人員的問題。
story_intro: 馬克抵達了桃園機場。
他排隊等候入關。
他準備好了申報單。
海關人員詢問他的旅行目的和行李內容。
他順利通過了海關檢查。

dialogue.speaker: Officer
dialogue.zh: 您好！請出示您的護照和海關申報單。
dialogue.py: nín hǎo! qǐng chū shì nín de hù zhào hé hǎi guān shēn bào dān.
dialogue.en: Hello! Please show your passport and customs declaration form.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 給您。這是我在日本買的一些紀念品。
dialogue.py: gěi nín. zhè shì wǒ zài rì běn mǎi de yī xiē jì niàn pǐn.
dialogue.en: Here you go. These are some souvenirs I bought in Japan.

dialogue.speaker: Officer
dialogue.zh: 您這次旅行的目的是什麼？是商務還是旅遊？
dialogue.py: nín zhè cì lǚ xíng de mù dì shì shén me? shì shāng wù hái shì lǚ yóu?
dialogue.en: What was the purpose of your trip this time? Business or tourism?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 是旅遊。我剛去京都和東京玩了十天。
dialogue.py: shì lǚ yóu. wǒ gāng qù jīng dū hé dōng jīng wán le shí tiān.
dialogue.en: Tourism. I just went to Kyoto and Tokyo for ten days.

dialogue.speaker: Officer
dialogue.zh: 除了紀念品，您的行李中還有煙、酒或者超過限額的現金嗎？
dialogue.py: chú le jì niàn pǐn, nín de xíng li zhōng hái yǒu yān, jiǔ huò zhě chāo guò xiàn é de xiàn jīn ma?
dialogue.en: Besides souvenirs, are there cigarettes, alcohol, or cash exceeding the limit in your luggage?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 沒有煙酒。現金大約有五萬日元，應該沒超過限額吧？
dialogue.py: méi yǒu yān jiǔ. xiàn jīn dà gài yǒu wǔ wàn rì yuán, yīng gāi méi chāo guò xiàn é ba?
dialogue.en: No cigarettes or alcohol. I have about 50,000 Yen in cash; that shouldn't exceed the limit, right?

dialogue.speaker: Officer
dialogue.zh: 五萬日元沒問題。這些扇子是木頭做的嗎？
dialogue.py: wǔ wàn rì yuán méi wèn tí. zhè xiē shàn zi shì mù tou zuò de ma?
dialogue.en: 50,000 Yen is fine. Are these fans made of wood?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 有一部分是木質的，還有一部分是竹子和紙做的。需要檢查嗎？
dialogue.py: yǒu yī bù fèn shì mù zhì de, hái yǒu yī bù fèn shì zhú zi hé zhǐ zuò de. xū yào jiǎn chá ma?
dialogue.en: Some are wooden, and some are made of bamboo and paper. Do they need to be inspected?

dialogue.speaker: Officer
dialogue.zh: 如果是加工過的工藝品，通常沒問題。請把箱子放在X光機上。
dialogue.py: rú guǒ shì jiā gōng guò de gōng yì pǐn, tōng cháng méi wèn tí. qǐng bǎ xiāng zi fàng zài X guāng jī shàng.
dialogue.en: If they are processed handicrafts, they are usually fine. Please put the suitcase on the X-ray machine.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好的。（機器檢查中）
dialogue.py: hǎo de. (jī qì jiǎn chá zhōng)
dialogue.en: Okay. (Machine inspecting)

dialogue.speaker: Officer
dialogue.zh: 沒問題了。謝謝您的配合。歡迎回到台北！
dialogue.py: méi wèn tí le. xiè xie nín de pèi hé. huān yíng huí dào tái běi!
dialogue.en: No problems. Thank you for your cooperation. Welcome back to Taipei!

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 謝謝！辛苦了。
dialogue.py: xiè xie! xīn kǔ le.
dialogue.en: Thanks! Thanks for your hard work.

speaking.part_b: Role-play: 你正在過海關。官員問你箱子裡是什麼，你說是一些茶葉和衣服。官員問你有沒有帶肉類產品，你說沒有。官員請你配合檢查。
part_c: 你覺得過海關緊張嗎？
你出國旅行會幫朋友帶東西嗎？

comprehension.q: 馬克從哪裡回到台北？
馬克這次旅行的主要目的是什麼？
馬克的行李裡有煙和酒嗎？
馬克帶了多少日元現金？
官員最後對馬克說了什麼？

true_false.q: 馬克需要填寫海關申報單。
馬克在東京待了一個月。
木製工藝品通常可以帶入關。
馬克拒絕配合海關人員。
馬克如實報告了行李內容。

passage.title: Through Customs Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克抵達了桃園機場。他排隊等候入關。他準備好了申報單。海關人員詢問他的旅行目的和行李內容。他順利通過了海關檢查。
passage.en: Hello! Please show your passport and customs declaration form. Here you go. These are some souvenirs I bought in Japan. What was the purpose of your trip this time? Business or tourism? Tourism. I just went to Kyoto and Tokyo for ten days. Besides souvenirs, are there cigarettes, alcohol, or cash exceeding the limit in your luggage? No cigarettes or alcohol. I have about 50,000 Yen in cash; that shouldn't exceed the limit, right? 50,000 Yen is fine. Are these fans made of wood?
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: 請寫 3 到 5 句話描述你的一次出國回來的經歷：你買了什麼？過海關時官員問了你什麼？手續辦得快嗎？

grammar.explanation: 使用 '...過的' 表示已完成的處理 (加工過的)。'超過' 表示數額過大。'除了...還有...' 的遞進結構。
examples: 吃過飯的人 (People who have eaten)
除了米飯，我還有菜。 (Besides rice, I also have dishes.)

practice.q: Complete: 除了他，____有人去。 (Besides him, someone else is going...)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 請問肉類產品可以帶回國嗎？
expansion_dialogue.py: qǐng wèn ròu lèi chǎn pǐn kě yǐ dài huí guó ma?
expansion_dialogue.en: Excuse me, can meat products be brought back to the country?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 絕對不行。為了防疫，所有肉類和水果都不能入關。
expansion_dialogue.py: jué duì bù xíng. wèi le fáng yì, suǒ yǒu ròu lèi hé shuǐ guǒ dōu bù néng rù guān.
expansion_dialogue.en: Absolutely not. For disease prevention, all meat and fruit are banned from entering.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 那加工過的牛肉乾也不行嗎？
expansion_dialogue.py: nà jiā gōng guò de niú ròu gān yě bù xíng ma?
expansion_dialogue.en: What about processed beef jerky, is that also not allowed?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 也不行。如果被發現了會被罰款，金額很高。
expansion_dialogue.py: yě bù xíng. rú guǒ bèi fā xiàn le huì bèi fá kuǎn, jīn é hěn gāo.
expansion_dialogue.en: Also no. If discovered, you will be fined; the amount is quite high.

review.speaking: Declare luggage contents to a customs officer in Chinese.

title: University Orientation
story_description: 馬克參加了大學的新生說明會。他在會上了解了學校的設施、選課流程和社團活動。
story_intro: 今天是新生入學的第一天。
禮堂裡坐滿了來自各地的學生。
校長和教授們在台上講話。
馬克拿到了校園地圖和學生手冊。
他對未來的大學生活充滿了好奇。

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.zh: 各位同學，歡迎來到本校。請大家先領取這本學生手冊。
dialogue.py: gè wèi tóng xué, huān yíng lái dào běn xiào. qǐng dà jiā xiān lǐng qǔ zhè běn xué sheng shǒu cè.
dialogue.en: Class, welcome to this university. Please first claim this student handbook.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 你好。請問這本手冊裡有校園地圖嗎？我怕迷路。
dialogue.py: nǐ hǎo. qǐng wèn zhè běn shǒu cè lǐ yǒu xiào yuán dì tú ma? wǒ pà mí lù.
dialogue.en: Hello. Does this handbook contain a campus map? I'm afraid of getting lost.

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.zh: 有的。第三頁就是詳細的校園地圖。包括教學樓、圖書館和學生餐廳的位置。
dialogue.py: yǒu de. dì sān yè jiù shì xiáng xì de xiào yuán dì tú. bāo kuò jiào xué lóu, tú shū guǎn hé xué sheng cān tīng de wèi zhi.
dialogue.en: Yes. Page 3 is a detailed campus map. It includes locations of teaching buildings, the library, and student cafeterias.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。那選課手續是在網上辦理還是在辦公室辦理？
dialogue.py: xiè xie. nà xuǎn kè shǒu xù shì zài wǎng shàng bàn lǐ hái shì zài bàn gōng shì bàn lǐ?
dialogue.en: Thanks. Are the course selection procedures handled online or at the office?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.zh: 大部分手續都在校務系統上辦理。登錄賬號是你的學號。
dialogue.py: dà bù fèn shǒu xù dōu zài xiào wù xì tǒng shàng bàn lǐ. dēng lù zhàng hào shì nǐ de xué hào.
dialogue.en: Most procedures are handled on the school administration system. The login account is your student ID.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 明白了。聽說下午還有社團招新活動，是在哪裡舉行？
dialogue.py: míng bai le. tīng shuō xià wǔ hái yǒu shè tuán zhāo xīn huó dòng, shì zài nǎ lǐ jǔ xíng?
dialogue.en: Understood. I heard there's a club recruitment event this afternoon; where is it held?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.zh: 在體育館大廳。那裡會有很多有趣的社團，你可以去看看。
dialogue.py: zài tǐ yù guǎn dà tīng. nà lǐ huì yǒu hěn duō yǒu qù de shè tuán, nǐ kě yǐ qù kàn kàn.
dialogue.en: In the gym lobby. There will be many interesting clubs; you can go and take a look.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我想加入籃球社或者攝影社。還有，學生證什麼時候能拿到？
dialogue.py: tài hǎo le, wǒ xiǎng jiā rù lán qiú shè huò zhě shè yǐng shè. hái yǒu, xué sheng zhèng shén me shí hou néng ná dào?
dialogue.en: Great; I want to join the basketball or photography club. Also, when can I get the student ID?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.zh: 如果你已經上傳了照片，下週一就可以來二樓辦公室領取。
dialogue.py: rú guǒ nǐ yǐ jīng shàng chuán le zhào piàn, xià zhōu yī jiù kě yǐ lái èr lóu bàn gōng shì lǐng qǔ.
dialogue.en: If you've already uploaded a photo, you can come to the 2nd-floor office to claim it next Monday.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好的，非常感謝您的回答。祝您今天愉快！
dialogue.py: hǎo de, fēi cháng gǎn xiè nín de huí dá. zhù nín jīn tiān yú kuài!
dialogue.en: Okay, thank you very much for your answers. Have a nice day!

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.zh: 不客氣。也祝你在校園生活愉快！
dialogue.py: bù kè qì. yě zhù nǐ zài xiào yuán shēng huó yú kuài!
dialogue.en: You're welcome. Wish you a happy campus life too!

speaking.part_b: Role-play: 你是一個新生，正在詢問如何辦理學生證。工作人員告訴你先填表，然後上傳照片，最後下週來領取。你問學生證是不是也可以當交通卡用。
part_c: 你喜歡參加新生的說明會嗎？
你對大學生活最感興趣的是什麼？

comprehension.q: 工作人員請大家先領取什麼？
校園地圖在哪個位置？
選課手續通常在哪裡辦理？
社團招新活動在哪裡舉行？
馬克什麼時候能拿到學生證？

true_false.q: 馬克不怕迷路。
學生手冊裡沒有地圖。
登錄系統需要用到學號。
馬克想加入攝影社。
工作人員祝馬克生活愉快。

fill_blank.q: 下週一就可以領____學生證。

passage.title: University Orientation Listening Passage
passage.zh: 今天是新生入學的第一天。禮堂裡坐滿了來自各地的學生。校長和教授們在台上講話。馬克拿到了校園地圖和學生手冊。他對未來的大學生活充滿了好奇。
passage.en: Class, welcome to this university. Please first claim this student handbook. Hello. Does this handbook contain a campus map? I'm afraid of getting lost. Yes. Page 3 is a detailed campus map. It includes locations of teaching buildings, the library, and student cafeterias. Thanks. Are the course selection procedures handled online or at the office? Most procedures are handled on the school administration system. The login account is your student ID. Understood. I heard there's a club recruitment event this afternoon; where is it held? In the gym lobby. There will be many interesting clubs; you can go and take a look.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: 請寫 3 到 5 句話描述你入學第一天的情景：你領取了什麼？看到了什麼？心情怎麼樣？

grammar.explanation: 使用 '包括' 列舉內容。'登錄' 與 '賬號' 的搭配。'V + 完/到' 表結果 (拿到、辦完)。
examples: 這家店包括咖啡和茶。 (This shop includes coffee and tea.)
我登錄了我的郵箱。 (I logged into my email.)
我拿到了我的學生證。 (I got my student ID.)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 你是哪個系的學生？我讀的是中文系。
expansion_dialogue.py: nǐ shì nǎ gè xì de xué sheng? wǒ dú de shì zhōng wén xì.
expansion_dialogue.en: Which department are you in? I'm studying in the Chinese department.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 我是電腦科學系的。很高興認識你。
expansion_dialogue.py: wǒ shì diàn nǎo kē xué xì de. hěn gāo xìng rèn shi nǐ.
expansion_dialogue.en: I'm in the Computer Science department. Nice to meet you.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 電腦科學系很難學吧？
expansion_dialogue.py: diàn nǎo kē xué xì hěn nán xué ba?
expansion_dialogue.en: Computer science is hard to study, right?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 是有點兒累，但非常有前途。
expansion_dialogue.py: shì yǒu diǎn r lèi, dàn fēi cháng yǒu qián tú.
expansion_dialogue.en: It is a bit tiring, but it has a very good future.

review.speaking: Ask about school administration systems and student ID collection in Chinese.
review.self_check: 你能用中文諮詢選課手續、社團活動並領取相關證件嗎？

title: Registering for Classes
story_description: 選課系統開放了。馬克和大衛正在電腦前搶課，他們討論了課程的時間和老師的評價。
story_intro: 今天是網上選課的第一天。
系統非常繁忙。
馬克想選一門有趣的選修課。
大衛幫他查看課程表。
他們練習討論時間衝突和課程評價。

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 糟了，選課系統又卡住了！大家都在搶課嗎？
dialogue.py: zāo le, xuǎn kè xì tǒng yòu kǎ zhù le! dà jiā dōu zài qiǎng kè ma?
dialogue.en: Oh no, the course registration system is stuck again! Is everyone scrambling for classes?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 別急。每學期一開始都這樣。你想選哪門課？
dialogue.py: bié jí. měi xué qī yī kāi shǐ dōu zhè yàng. nǐ xiǎng xuǎn nǎ mén kè?
dialogue.en: Don't worry. It's like this at the beginning of every semester. Which course do you want to select?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我想選王教授的'中國藝術史'，聽說他的課很有趣。
dialogue.py: wǒ xiǎng xuǎn wáng jiào shòu de 'zhōng guó yì shù shǐ', tīng shuō tā de kè hěn yǒu qù.
dialogue.en: I want to select Professor Wang's 'Chinese Art History'; I heard his class is very interesting.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 王教授的課確實很好，但是名額有限，很難搶到。
dialogue.py: wáng jiào shòu de kè què shí hěn hǎo, dàn shì míng é yǒu xiàn, hěn nán qiǎng dào.
dialogue.en: Professor Wang's class is indeed good, but places are limited; it's hard to get in.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: （刷新頁面）進去了！但是他的課在週二下午，跟我必修的經濟學衝突了。
dialogue.py: (shuā xīn yè miàn) jìn qù le! dàn shì tā de kè zài zhōu èr xià wǔ, gēn wǒ bì xiū de jīng jì xué chōng tū le.
dialogue.en: (Refreshing page) I'm in! But his class is on Tuesday afternoon, it conflicts with my compulsory Economics class.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 那太可惜了。那你要不要看看李老師的選修課？內容也差不多。
dialogue.py: nà tài kě xī le. nà nǐ yào bù yào kàn kàn lǐ lǎo shī de xuǎn xiū kè? nèi róng yě chà bù duō.
dialogue.en: That's a pity. Then do you want to look at Teacher Li's elective? The content is similar.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 李老師的評價怎麼樣？嚴不嚴？
dialogue.py: lǐ lǎo shī de píng jià zěn me yàng? yán bù yán?
dialogue.en: How is Teacher Li's evaluation? Is she strict?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 她對學生挺嚴的，作業不少，但給分很公平。
dialogue.py: tā duì xué sheng tǐng yán de, zuò yè bù shǎo, dàn gěi fēn hěn gōng píng.
dialogue.en: She's quite strict with students, has a lot of homework, but her grading is very fair.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好吧。我先把它加進課表，試聽一下再決定。
dialogue.py: hǎo ba. wǒ xiān bǎ tā jiā jìn kè biǎo, shì tīng yī xià zài jué dìng.
dialogue.en: Okay. I'll add it to the schedule first, audit it once and then decide.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 記得在週五前提交，否則就選不成了。
dialogue.py: jì de zài zhōu wǔ qián tí jiāo, fǒu zé jiù xuǎn bù chéng le.
dialogue.en: Remember to submit before Friday, otherwise you won't be able to select it.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 知道了。希望我們這學期都能選到心儀的課。
dialogue.py: zhī dào le. xī wàng wǒ men zhè xué qī dōu néng xuǎn dào xīn yí de kè.
dialogue.en: Got it. I hope we can both get the classes we desire this semester.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 加油！
dialogue.py: jiā yóu!
dialogue.en: Good luck!

你喜歡必修課還是選修課？為什麼？

馬克打算先試聽一下再做決定。
週五後系統還會開放選課。
大衛在幫馬克查看課程。

practice.q: Complete: 我選____了這門課。 (Selected successfully...)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 這門課可以退選嗎？我覺得太難了。
expansion_dialogue.py: zhè mén kè kě yǐ tuì xuǎn ma? wǒ jué de tài nán le.
expansion_dialogue.en: Can this course be dropped? I find it too difficult.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 可以。退選截止日期是下週三下午五點。
expansion_dialogue.py: kě yǐ. tuì xuǎn jié zhǐ rì qī shì xià zhōu sān xià wǔ wǔ diǎn.
expansion_dialogue.en: Yes. The deadline for dropping a course is next Wednesday at 5:00 PM.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 好的。我想換一門比較輕鬆的體育課。
expansion_dialogue.py: hǎo de. wǒ xiǎng huàn yī mén bǐ jiào qīng sōng de tǐ yù kè.
expansion_dialogue.en: Okay. I want to switch to an easier PE class.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 你可以看看瑜伽課，評價挺好的。
expansion_dialogue.py: nǐ kě yǐ kàn kàn yú jiā kè, píng jià tǐng hǎo de.
expansion_dialogue.en: You can check out Yoga class; the evaluations are quite good.

title: Review Story: Travel and University Life
story_description: 馬克完成了他的日本之旅，回到了台北的大學校園。他回顧了這段時間的經歷，並開始為新學期做準備。
story_intro: 馬克坐在咖啡店裡。
他剛從日本旅行回來。
他正在整理旅遊的照片和心得。
他同時也在忙著處理大學新生的入學事宜。
他覺得生活充滿了新的開始。

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 這個夏天真的很難忘。在日本的十天，我學會了怎麼訂房和買票。
dialogue.py: zhè ge xià tiān zhēn de hěn nán wàng. zài rì běn de shí tiān, wǒ xué huì le zěn me dìng fáng hé mǎi piào.
dialogue.en: This summer was really unforgettable. During the ten days in Japan, I learned how to book rooms and buy tickets.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 雖然中途遇到過迷路的情況，但也讓我更有勇氣去問路。
dialogue.py: suī rán zhōng tú yù dào guò mí lù de qíng kuàng, dàn yě ràng wǒ gèng yǒu yǒng qì qù wèn lù.
dialogue.en: Although I encountered situations where I got lost halfway, it also gave me more courage to ask for directions.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 現在回到了台北，我的大學生活也要正式開始了。
dialogue.py: xiàn zài huí dào le tái běi, wǒ de dà xué shēng huó yě yào zhèng shì kāi shǐ le.
dialogue.en: Now that I'm back in Taipei, my university life is also about to officially begin.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 新生說明會讓我了解了校園的環境。地圖真的很詳細。
dialogue.py: xīn shēng shuō míng huì ràng wǒ liǎo jiě le xiào yuán de huán jìng. dì tú zhēn de hěn xiáng xì.
dialogue.en: The freshman orientation let me understand the campus environment. The map is really detailed.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我已經拿到了我的學號，並在網上成功辦理了選課手續。
dialogue.py: wǒ yǐ jīng ná dào le wǒ de xué hào, bìng zài wǎng shàng chéng gōng bàn lǐ le xuǎn kè shǒu xù.
dialogue.en: I've already gotten my student ID number and successfully handled the course registration online.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 雖然選課的時候系統有點兒卡，但我還是選到了心儀的課程。
dialogue.py: suī rán xuǎn kè de shí hou xì tǒng yǒu diǎn r kǎ, dàn wǒ hái shì xuǎn dào le xīn yí de kè chéng.
dialogue.en: Although the system was a bit laggy during registration, I still managed to select the courses I desired.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我很期待王教授的藝術史課。這學期我打算加強我的中文口語。
dialogue.py: wǒ hěn qī dài wáng jiào shòu de yì shù shǐ kè. zhè xué qī wǒ dǎ suàn jiā qiáng wǒ de zhōng wén kǒu yǔ.
dialogue.en: I'm looking forward to Professor Wang's Art History class. This semester I plan to strengthen my spoken Chinese.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 大衛說他會幫我。我們還約好了一起去參加攝影社的活動。
dialogue.py: dà wèi shuō tā huì bāng wǒ. wǒ men hái yuē hǎo le yī qǐ qù cān jiā shè yǐng shè de huó dòng.
dialogue.en: David said he would help me. We also agreed to go to the photography club's activities together.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 大學生活看起來會比以前更忙，但也更有趣。
dialogue.py: dà xué shēng huó kàn qǐ lái huì bǐ yǐ qián gèng máng, dàn yě gèng yǒu qù.
dialogue.en: University life looks like it will be busier than before, but also more interesting.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 只要保持熱情，努力學習，我一定能過得非常充實。
dialogue.py: zhǐ yào bǎo chí rè qíng, nǔ lì xué xí, wǒ yī dìng néng guò de fēi cháng chōng shí.
dialogue.en: As long as I maintain passion and study hard, I can definitely have a very productive time.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 加油吧！這是一個新的起點。
dialogue.py: jiā yóu ba! zhè shì yī gè xīn de qǐ diǎn.
dialogue.en: Go for it! This is a new starting point.

key_sentences.en: Have the courage to ask directions.

expansion_dialogue.en: I was thinking that too. Shall we go for a walk in the park next weekend?
